fields.title: Ku Kufuuka Omuntu
fields.subtitle: Kyavvuunulwa Archibald Robertson
fields.description: Ennyinnyonnyola ey’edda ennyo ku nsonga lwaki Katonda yafuuka omuntu, eyawandiikibwa omudyankoni omuvubuka ow’e Alegezanderiya eyandimaze emyaka kkumi n’musanvu egy’oluvannyuma mu bwangange olw’okukkiriza kuno. Athanasius awoza nti Omutonzi yekka ye yali ayinza okuzza obuggya ebitonde ebyali bigenda bivunda, era nti yakikola ng’atwala omubiri ogwa ddala n’afa okufa okwa ddala. Olunyiriri lwakyo olusinga okujuliziddwa, nti yafuulibwa omuntu ffe tulyoke tufuulibwe ab’obwakatonda, lubumbye engeri ekkanisa gy’eyogera ku bulokozi okuva olwo.
fields.about_html:
Ekiwandiiko ekimpi ku kibuuzo kimu: lwaki Katonda yafuuka omuntu? Athanasius takiddamu ng’ekikokko kya kugonjoola, wabula ng’okununula. Omuntu yatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda era yali agenda aseeyeeyera okudda mu butabaawo mwe yava; tewali n’omu yali ayinza okuzzaawo ekifaananyi ekyo okuggyako Kigambo eyakikola, era teyandisobodde kukizzaawo ng’ali bweru. Kale n’atwala omubiri — era ekiwandiiko kigoberera ensonga eyo okuyita mu musaalaba, okuzuukira, n’ekintu ekyewuunyisa nti Abakristaayo aba bulijjo ab’omu mulembe gwe baali balekedde awo okutya okufa.

Ddi lwe kyawandiikibwa tekinnakakasibwa. Abayivu bakiteeka wonna okuva awo nga mu 318 okutuuka mu myaka gya 330, era obuzibu obwo bwennyini bulina kye bulaga: ekitabo tekyogera ku Arius n’akatono. Oluyombo olwamalawo obulamu bwa Athanasius obwasigalawo — okugobebwa mu nsi emirundi etaano, emyaka amakumi n’amakumi egy’okukubaganya ebirowoozo obanga Omwana wa butonde bumu ne Kitaffe — terulina kabonero kalulaga ku mpapula zino. Ekiriwo mu kifo ky’ekyo y’ensonga ey’okunyweza, eyawozebwa olutalo nga terunnatandika oba nga teyeetabamu, oboolyawo kye kyagiwangaaza okusinga olutalo.

Gwe mulyango ogusinga obulungi okuyingira mu kkanisa ey’edda eri omusomi atannaggulawo kitabo kya Kitaffe w’ekkanisa n’omu: kimpi, tekiyanguyiriza, era kyawandiikibwa mu Luyonaani oluvvuunulwa mu ngeri ennyangu. Ennyanjula ya C. S. Lewis ku kufulumya okw’Olungereza okwa 1944 — ekiwandiiko ekiwoza nti ebitabo eby’edda byangu, so si bizibu, okusinga ebipya — yawandiikirwa kino, era yasindika emirembe n’emirembe gy’abasomi b’Olungereza gye kiri.

qa.question: Ekitabo Ku Kufuuka Omuntu kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kiddamu ekibuuzo kimu: lwaki Katonda yafuuka omuntu? Athanasius akitwala nga si kikokko kya bufirosoofo, wabula ng’okununula. Omuntu, eyatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, yali agenda aseeyeeyera okudda mu butabaawo mwe yatondebwa okuva, era tewali n’omu yali ayinza okuzzaawo ekifaananyi ekyo okuggyako Kigambo eyasooka okukikola — era teyandisobodde kukizzaawo ng’ali bweru. Kale n’atwala omubiri ogwa ddala, era ekiwandiiko kigoberera ensonga eyo okuyita mu musaalaba, okuzuukira, n’obutatya okufa okupya okw’Abakristaayo aba bulijjo.

qa.question: Athanasius yali ani?
qa.answer: Yali mudyankoni omuvubuka, era oluvannyuma omulabirizi, ow’e Alegezanderiya mu kyasa eky’okuna, eyandimaze emyaka nga kkumi n’musanvu egy’oluvannyuma mu bwangange olw’okulwanirira obwakatonda obujjuvu obwa Kristo ng’awakanya enjigiriza ya Arius. Yawandiika ekiwandiiko kino ng’akyali muto, ng’ennyinnyonnyola ey’okunyweza okukkiriza kw’ekkanisa mu Kigambo eyafuuka omuntu — okwatula kwe yandimaze obulamu bwe obwasigalawo ng’akulwanirira.

qa.question: Okusinziira ku Athanasius, lwaki Katonda yalina okufuuka omuntu?
qa.answer: Kubanga ekizibu kyali kya mirundi ebiri: omuntu yali wansi w’omusango gw’okufa n’okuvunda Katonda gw’ataandiggyeewo bwereere olw’obwesigwa bwe yennyini, era ekifaananyi kya Katonda mu muntu kyali kigenda kisangulibwa. Kigambo yekka, ye kennyini ekifaananyi, ye yali ayinza okukizza obuggya mu ffe, era ng’atwala omubiri ogufa yekka ye yali ayinza okusasula ebbanja ly’okufa ku lwaffe. Okwenenya kwokka tekwandisobodde kuggyawo kuvunda; kyetaagisa Nnannyini bulamu okukuyingiramu.

qa.question: Kigambo ki ekimanyiddwa ennyo okuva mu kitabo kino?
qa.answer: Athanasius awandiika nti Kigambo yafuuka omuntu ffe tulyoke tufuulibwe ab’obwakatonda — nti yatwala ekyaffe atuwe ekikye. Ebigambo ebyo byafuuka ennyimpi y’okuyigiriza kw’Ekikristaayo kwonna ku bulokozi: si nti tufuuka Katonda mu butonde, wabula nti mu Kristo abantu basitulibwa mu bulamu bwa Katonda, ne bagabana ku bw’ekisa ekyo Omwana ky’ali ku bw’obwannannyini.

qa.question: Kyawandiikibwa ddi?
qa.answer: Olunaku terunnakakasibwa — abayivu bakiteeka wonna okuva awo nga mu 318 okutuuka mu myaka gya 330. Obuzibu obwo bwennyini bulina kye bulaga: ekitabo tekyogera ku Arius n’akatono, oluyombo lwe olwali lugenda okumalawo obulamu bwa Athanasius mu bbanga ttono. Kisomebwa ng’ennyinnyonnyola y’okukkiriza okwaliwo ng’okukubaganya ebirowoozo okunene tekunnatandika, era kino kye kimu ku kyakifuula eky’omuwendo ng’eddirisa erirambulukufu ku kukkiriza okwali kukkalidde mu kkanisa ey’edda.

qa.question: Ekitabo kiwoza ku kuzuukira?
qa.answer: Yee — Athanasius alaga obujulirwa obweyoleka obw’omu mulembe gwe: nti Abakristaayo aba bulijjo, nga mw’otwalidde abaana n’abakazi, baali tebakyatya kufa wabula nga bakusisinkana mu mirembe, ne n’essanyu. Omuntu afudde tayinza kukola kino eri abagoberezi be; Mukama omulamu ayinza. Atwala enkyukakyuka y’engeri Abakristaayo gye batunuuliramu okufa ng’obukakafu obulabika nti oyo eyafa mulamu.

qa.question: Kizibu okusoma eri omusomi ow’omulembe guno?
qa.answer: Kimpi nnyo era kitegeerekeka bulungi ku kiwandiiko eky’eby’eddiini — eyo y’emu ku nsonga lwaki kitera okuwabulwa ng’ekiwandiiko ekisooka okusoma ku Bakitaffe b’ekkanisa. C. S. Lewis, eyawandiika ennyanjula emanyiddwa ennyo ku kuvvuunula okumu, yakubiriza abasomi b’ebitabo eby’edda okutandikira wano kubanga kitegeerekeka, era yawoza nti obuggya bwakyo eri amatu ag’omulembe guno kye kimu ku bikifuula eky’omuwendo.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanye kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa; ekiwandiiko kigendereddwamu okusomebwa omulundi gumu okutuuka ku nkomerero ng’ensonga emu. Goberera ensonga yaakyo okuva ku kutondebwa kw’omuntu mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, okuyita mu kizibu ky’okuvunda, okutuuka ku kutwala omubiri n’okuwangulwa kw’okufa. Bwe kisomebwa bwe kityo, si kibinja kya njigiriza, wabula ennyinnyonnyola emu etasalako ku nsonga lwaki okukkiriza kwonna kuyimirira oba kugwa okusinziira ku mazima g’okufuuka omuntu kw’Omwana wa Katonda.

fields.title: Ennyanjula
fields.body_html:
§1. Ennyanjula.—Ensonga y’ekitabo kino: okwetoowaza n’okufuuka omuntu kwa Kigambo. Kyesigamye ku njigiriza y’Okutonda, era nti okutonda kwakolebwa Kigambo. Kitaffe yalokola ensi ng’ayita mu oyo gwe yasooka okugitondesa.

Nga bwe tumaze mu kitabo ekisooka okunnyonnyola—nga tulonzeemu ensonga ntono mu nnyingi—ebimala ku bukyamu bw’abakaafiiri ku bifaananyi ebisinzibwa, ne ku kusinza ebifaananyi, ne bwe byasooka okuyiiyizibwa; kwe kugamba, engeri abantu gye beeyiiyiza okusinza ebifaananyi olw’obubi bwabwe: era nga bwe tumaze, olw’ekisa kya Katonda, okwogerako katono ne ku bwakatonda bwa Kigambo kya Kitaffe, ne ku kulabirira kwe okw’ensi yonna n’obuyinza bwe, era nti Kitaffe Omulungi ng’ayita mu ye alagira ebintu byonna, era ebintu byonna bitambuzibwa ye, era mu ye mwe bifunira obulamu: kale jjangu kaakano, Makaliyo (asaanira erinnya eryo), omwagazi wa Kristo ow’amazima, tugoberere okukkiriza kw’eddiini yaffe, era tunnyonnyole n’ebikwata ku Kigambo okufuuka omuntu, ne ku kulabika kwe okw’obwakatonda mu ffe, Abayudaaya kwe bavvoola n’Abayonaani kwe basekerera, naye ffe kwe tusinza; olyoke, olw’obwetoowaze bwa Kigambo obulabika, okutya kwo Katonda gy’ali kweyongere nnyo okusingawo era kwaze. 2. Kubanga gy’akoma okujoogebwa mu batakkiriza, gy’akoma okuwa obujulirwa ku bwakatonda bwe; kubanga si kuba nti ye kennyini alaga nti kisoboka ekyo abantu kye balowooza mu bukyamu nti tekisoboka kyokka, naye n’ekyo abantu kye basekerera nga tekisaana, ye olw’obulungi bwe akyambaza obusaanire, n’ekyo abantu, mu kwerowooza nti bagezi, kye basekerera nga kya buntu bwokka, ye olw’obuyinza bwe akiraga nti kya bwakatonda, ng’awangula okwekulumbaza kw’ebifaananyi olw’okwetoowaza kwe okulowoozebwa—olw’Omusaalaba—n’abo abajooga ne batakkiriza ng’abawangula mu ngeri etalabika ne bategeera obwakatonda bwe n’obuyinza bwe. 3. Naye okwogera ku nsonga eno kyetaagisa okujjukira ebyogeddwa edda; oleme kubulwa kumanya nsonga lwaki Kigambo kya Kitaffe, omukulu bw’atyo era ow’ekitiibwa bw’atyo, yalabika mu mubiri, era oleme kulowooza nti Omulokozi yayambala omubiri olw’obutonde bwe yennyini; wabula nti, newaakubadde mu butonde bwe talina mubiri, era nga ye Kigambo okuva ku lubereberye, yalabisibwa gye tuli mu mubiri gw’omuntu olw’okwagala n’obulungi bwa Kitaawe, tulyoke tulokolebwe. 4. Kale kitusaanira okutandika okwogera ku nsonga eno nga twogera ku kutondebwa kw’ensi yonna, ne ku Katonda Omukozi waayo, kitegeerekeke bulungi nti okuzza obuggya ebitonde gwali mulimu gwa Kigambo oyo yennyini eyabitonda ku lubereberye. Kubanga kirirabika nga tekikontana Kitaffe okukola obulokozi bwabyo mu oyo gwe yakozesa okubitonda.

fields.title: Endowooza enkyamu ku Kutonda zigaanibwa
fields.body_html:
§2. Endowooza enkyamu ku Kutonda zigaanibwa. (1) Abagoberezi ba Epikulo (ebintu okujjawo mu butanwa). Naye enjawulo y’emibiri n’ebitundu byagyo eraga nti waliwo amagezi agaabitonda. (2.) Abagoberezi ba Plato (ekintu ekyasooka okubaawo.) Naye kino kissa Katonda wansi w’obunafu bw’abantu, ne kimufuula omukozi w’emikono bukozi so si Mutonzi. (3) Abagnostiki (Omukozi omulala omugwira). Bigaanibwa Ebyawandiikibwa.

Ku kukolebwa kw’ensi yonna n’okutondebwa kw’ebintu byonna, bangi balina endowooza ez’enjawulo, era buli muntu ateeseewo etteeka nga bw’ayagadde. Kubanga abamu bagamba nti ebintu byonna byajjawo byokka, mu ngeri ya butanwa; okugeza, abagoberezi ba Epikulo, abatugamba, mu kwenyooma kwabwe, nti okulabirira kw’ensi yonna tekuliiwo, nga boogera nga bakontana butereevu n’ebyo ebirabikira ddala n’ebyo abantu bye bayitamu. 2. Kubanga singa, nga bwe bagamba, buli kintu kyatandika kyokka, awatali kigendererwa, kyandiddiridde nti buli kintu kyajjawo bujji, ne kifaanagana nga tewali njawulo. Kubanga olw’obumu bw’omubiri, kyandiddiridde nti buli kintu kibeere njuba oba mwezi, ate ku bantu kyandiddiridde nti omubiri gwonna gubeere mukono, oba liiso, oba kigere. Naye nga bwe kiri, si bwe kityo. Wabula tulaba enjawulo wakati w’enjuba, omwezi n’ensi; era ne ku mibiri gy’abantu, wakati w’ekigere, omukono n’omutwe. Kale entegeka eyawukana bw’etyo tetubuulira nti byajjawo byokka, wabula eraga nti waliwo ensibuko eyabisooka; era okuva mu nsibuko eyo kisoboka okutegeera ne Katonda nti ye Mukozi era Omutegesi wa byonna.

3. Naye abalala, nga mw’otwalidde ne Plato, ali mu kitiibwa ekinene bwe kityo mu Bayonaani, bagamba nti Katonda yakola ensi okuva mu kintu ekyaliwo edda era ekitaalina ntandikwa. Kubanga Katonda teyandisobodde kukola kintu na kimu singa ekintu ekyo tekyasooka kubaawo; ng’emiti bwe giteekwa okusooka okubaawo nga gyetegefu eri omubazzi, alyoke asobole okukola. 4. Naye mu kwogera bwe batyo tebamanyi nti bambaza Katonda obunafu. Kubanga oba nga ye kennyini si y’ensibuko y’ekintu ekyo, naye akola ebintu mu kintu ekyaliwo edda kyokka, alabika nga munafu, kubanga tasobola kukola kintu na kimu ky’akola awatali kintu ekyo; nga bwe kiri obunafu obutabuusibwabuusibwa omubazzi obutasobola kukola kintu kyonna ekyetaagibwa awatali mbaawo ze. Kubanga, ex hypothesi, singa ekintu ekyo tekyaliwo, Katonda teyandikoze kintu na kimu. Kale olwo yandiyitiddwa atya Omukozi era Omutonzi, oba nga obusobozi bwe obw’okukola abuggya walala—kwe kugamba, mu kintu ekyo? N’olwekyo oba nga bwe kiri bwe kityo, Katonda mu ndowooza yaabwe aliba mukozi wa mikono bukozi, so si Mutonzi atonda okuva mu bwereere; kwe kugamba, oba ng’akola ku kintu ekyaliwo, naye ye kennyini si y’ensibuko yaakyo. Kubanga teyandiyitiddwa Mutonzi mu ngeri yonna okuggyako nga ye Mutonzi w’ekintu ekyo ebintu ebyatondebwa mwe byakolebwa. 5. Naye abakyamu beefumiitiriza omukozi omulala ow’ebintu byonna, atali Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, nga bazibe ddala n’okutuuka ku bigambo bye bakozesa. 6. Kubanga Mukama bw’agamba Abayudaaya nti: “Temusomanga nti, ‘Okuva ku lubereberye Katonda yatonda omusajja n’omukazi,’ era nti, ‘Omusajja anaalekanga kitaawe ne nnyina, ne yeegatta ne mukazi we. Nabo banaabanga omuntu omu’?” ate ng’ayogera ku Mutonzi, n’agamba nti, “Noolwekyo Katonda be yagatta awamu, omuntu tabaawukanyanga:” abantu bano bagamba batya nti okutonda tekukwatagana na Kitaffe? Oba, ng’ebigambo bya Yokaana bwe biri, oyo agamba awatali kuggyako, nti “Ebintu byonna byatondebwa ku lulwe,” era nti “tewaliiwo kintu na kimu ekyatondebwa nga taliiwo,” omukozi yandibadde atya omulala, ow’enjawulo ku Kitaawe wa Kristo?

fields.title: Enjigiriza ey’amazima
fields.body_html:
§3. Enjigiriza ey’amazima. Okutonda okuva mu bwereere, olw’obugabi bwa Katonda obungi obw’okubaawo. Omuntu yatondebwa ng’asinga ebirala, naye nga tasobola kunywerera ku bubwe. N’olwekyo ekirabo eky’enjawulo era ekisukka obutonde, eky’okubeera mu Kifaananyi kya Katonda, n’ekisuubizo ky’essanyu singa anywerera mu kisa.

Bwe batyo bwe beefumiitiriza obwereere. Naye enjigiriza ey’okutya Katonda n’okukkiriza okw’omu Kristo bivumirira ebigambo byabwe eby’obusirusiru nti bwe butatya Katonda. Kubanga bimanyi nti ensi teyajjawo yokka, kubanga okulowooleza edda tekubulawo; era teyakolebwa mu kintu ekyaliwo, kubanga Katonda si munafu; wabula nti okuva mu bwereere, era nga tewaliiwo kintu na kimu ekyasooka okubaawo, Katonda yatonda ensi yonna okubaawo ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye, nga bw’agamba, okusooka ng’ayita mu Musa nti: “Ku lubereberye Katonda yatonda eggulu n’ensi;” ekyokubiri, mu kitabo ekizimba ennyo ekiyitibwa Omusumba, “Okusookera ddala kkiriza nti Katonda ali omu, eyatonda era eyategeka ebintu byonna, n’abireeta okubaawo okuva mu bwereere.” 2. Ekyo Pawulo ky’ayogerako bw’agamba nti, “Olw’okukkiriza tumanyi ng’ensi yatondebwa na kigambo kya Katonda, ebirabika kyebyava bikolebwa nga biggibwa mu bitalabika.” 3. Kubanga Katonda mulungi, oba okusingawo, ye nsibuko y’obulungi mu butonde bwe: era omulungi tasobola kukodowala ku kintu kyonna: n’olwekyo, nga tagaanyi kintu na kimu kubaawo, yatonda ebintu byonna okuva mu bwereere ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye, Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe. Era mu bino, ng’asaasidde nnyo, okusinga ebintu byonna ebiri ku nsi, eggwanga ly’abantu, era ng’alabye obutasobola bwalyo, olw’embeera y’ensibuko yaalyo, okunywerera mu mbeera emu, yabawa ekirabo ekirala, era teyatonda butonzi muntu nga bwe yatonda ebitonde byonna ebitalina magezi ku nsi, wabula yabakola mu kifaananyi kye, ng’abawa n’ekitundu ku buyinza bwa Kigambo kye; balyoke, nga balina ng’ekifaananyi ekimu ekya Kigambo, era nga baakolebwa nga balina amagezi, basobole okubeera mu ssanyu emirembe gyonna, nga babeera mu bulamu obw’amazima obw’abatukuvu mu Lusuku lwa Katonda. 4. Naye ate ng’amanyi nti okwagala kw’omuntu kuyinza okukyukira ku ludda olumu oba olulala, yasooka n’anyweza ekisa kye yabawa ng’ayita mu tteeka ne mu kifo kye yabateekamu. Kubanga yabaleeta mu nnimiro ye, n’abawa etteeka: balyoke, singa bakuuma ekisa ne basigala nga balungi, basigale nga balina obulamu mu Lusuku lwa Katonda awatali nnaku, wadde obulumi, wadde okweraliikirira, ate nga balina n’ekisuubizo ky’obutavunda mu ggulu; naye singa basobya ne bakyuka ne bafuuka babi, bamanye nti beereetera okuvunda mu kufa okwali okwabwe mu butonde: nga tebakyabeera mu Lusuku lwa Katonda, wabula nga bagobeddwa mu lwo okuva olwo okufa n’okusigala mu kufa ne mu kuvunda. 5. Kino kye kyo Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu kye birabula, nga byogera mu kamwa ka Katonda nti: “Emiti gyonna egy’omu nnimiro olyangako, naye omuti ogw’okumanya ekirungi n’ekibi ogwo togulyangako, kubanga lw’oligulyako tolirema kufa.” Naye “tolirema kufa,” kiyinza kutegeeza ki ekirala, okuggyako obutakoma ku kufa kwokka, naye n’okusigala emirembe gyonna mu kuvunda kw’okufa?

fields.title: Okutondebwa kwaffe n’Okufuuka omuntu kwa Katonda bikwatagana nnyo
fields.body_html:
§4. Okutondebwa kwaffe n’Okufuuka omuntu kwa Katonda bikwatagana nnyo. Nga Kigambo bwe yayita omuntu okuva mu butabaawo n’ajja mu kubaawo, era omuntu n’afuna n’ekisa ky’obulamu obw’obwakatonda, bwe batyo olw’ensobi emu eyabafiiriza obulamu obwo ne baddamu okwereetako okuvunda, era ekibi n’ennaku ebitayogerekeka ne bijjula ensi.

Oboolyawo oyewuunya lwaki, nga twagenderera okwogera ku Kufuuka omuntu kwa Kigambo, kaakano twogera ku nsibuko y’abantu. Naye kino nakyo kituukirawo ddala ku kigendererwa ky’ekitabo kyaffe. 2. Kubanga mu kwogera ku kulabika kw’Omulokozi mu ffe, kitwetaagisa okwogera ne ku nsibuko y’abantu, olyoke omanye nti ensonga y’okukka kwe yali ffe, era nti okusobya kwaffe kwe kwaleeta okwagala n’ekisa kya Kigambo, Mukama alyoke ayanguwe okutuyamba era alabike mu bantu. 3. Kubanga ffe twali ensonga y’okufuuka kwe omuntu, era olw’obulokozi bwaffe yatwagala nnyo n’atuuka n’okulabika n’okuzaalibwa mu mubiri gw’omuntu. 4. Bw’atyo Katonda yakola omuntu, n’ayagala abeere mu butavunda; naye abantu, bwe baanyooma ne bagaana okufumiitiriza ku Katonda, ne beeyiiyiza era ne beeteekerateekera obubi (nga bwe kyayogerwa mu kitabo ekyasooka), baasalirwa omusango gw’okufa gwe baali balabuddwa; era okuva olwo tebaasigala nga bwe baatondebwa, wabula baali bagenda bavunda okusinziira ku bye beeyiiyiza; era okufa ne kubafuga nga kabaka. Kubanga okusobya ku kiragiro kwali kubazza mu mbeera yaabwe ey’obutonde, balyoke, nga bwe baava mu bwereere ne babaawo, bwe batyo, nga bwe kyandisuubiriddwa, balindirire okuvunda okudda mu bwereere ng’ekiseera kigenda. 5. Kubanga oba nga, okuva mu mbeera yaabwe eyasooka ey’obutabaawo, baayitibwa okubaawo olw’okubeerawo n’okwagala n’ekisa kya Kigambo, kyaddirira mu butonde nti abantu bwe baafiirwa okumanya Katonda ne bazzibwa mu ekyo ekitaliiwo (kubanga ekibi tekiriiwo, naye ekirungi kye kiriwo), bandifiiriddwa emirembe gyonna n’okubaawo kwennyini, kubanga okubaawo kwabwe kuva eri Katonda ALIWO; mu bigambo ebirala, nti bandisaanuuse ne basigala mu kufa ne mu kuvunda. 6. Kubanga omuntu mu butonde bwe wa kufa, kubanga yakolebwa okuva mu ekyo ekitaliiwo; naye olw’okufaanana Oyo Aliwo (era singa yali akyakuuma okufaanana okwo ng’amukuuma mu kumanya kwe) yandiyimirizza okuvunda kwe okw’obutonde, n’asigala nga tavunda; ng’ekitabo ky’Amagezi bwe kigamba nti: “Okukuuma amateeka ge kwe kukakasa obutafa;” naye bw’aba nga tavunda, yandibadde mulamu okuva olwo nga Katonda, era ndowooza kino Ebyawandiikibwa eby’obwakatonda kye byogerako, bwe bigamba nti: “Njogedde nti, Muli bakatonda, era mwenna muli baana b’oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo. Naye mugenda kufa ng’abantu obuntu; muliggwaawo ng’abafuzi abalala bonna bwe baggwaawo.”

fields.title: Kubanga Katonda teyakoma ku kutukola okuva mu bwereere
fields.body_html:
§5. Kubanga Katonda teyakoma ku kutukola okuva mu bwereere; naye yatuwa bwereere, olw’Ekisa kya Kigambo, obulamu obukwatagana ne Katonda. Naye abantu, bwe baagaana ebintu eby’olubeerera, ne bakyukira, olw’okuteesa kwa Setaani, ebintu eby’okuvunda, ne beereetera bokka okuvunda mu kufa, nga mu butonde bwabwe, nga bwe nnayogedde edda, bavunda, naye nga baali bategekeddwa, olw’ekisa ekiva mu kugabana ku Kigambo, okuwona embeera yaabwe ey’obutonde, singa baasigala nga balungi. 2. Kubanga olwa Kigambo okubeera nabo, n’okuvunda kwabwe okw’obutonde tekwabasemberera, nga n’ekitabo ky’Amagezi bwe kigamba nti: “Katonda yatonda omuntu olw’obutavunda, era ng’ekifaananyi ky’obutaggwaawo bwe yennyini; naye olw’obuggya bwa Setaani okufa ne kujja mu nsi.” Naye ekyo bwe kyamala okutuukawo, abantu ne batandika okufa, era okuvunda okuva olwo ne kubawangula, nga kufuna amaanyi agasinga n’ag’obutonde bwakwo ku ggwanga lyonna, kubanga, olw’okusobya ku kiragiro, kwalina okulabula kwa Katonda ng’ekyongera okubanyigiriza.

3. Kubanga ne mu bikolwa byabwe ebibi abantu tebaakoma ku nsalo yonna eteereddwawo; wabula nga bagenda beeyongerayo mpolampola, baasukka ekipimo kyonna: nga okusooka baali bayiiya obubi ne beereetako okufa n’okuvunda; ate oluvannyuma, bwe baakyamira mu bitali bya butuukirivu ne basukkuluma ku bujeemu bwonna, nga tebakoma ku kibi kimu wabula nga bayiiya ebibi ebipya ebya buli ngeri kimu ku kimu, ne bafuuka abatakkuta kwonoona. 4. Kubanga obwenzi bwali buli wamu n’obubbi, era ensi yonna yali ejjudde obutemu n’okunyaga. Era ku by’okuvunda n’okukola ebibi, tewaali afaayo ku tteeka, naye emisango gyonna gyali gikolebwa buli wamu, omuntu kinnoomu era n’abantu nga bali wamu. Ebibuga byalwananga n’ebibuga, n’amawanga ne gagolokokera amawanga; era ensi yonna yali eyuzibwayuzibwa obutabanguko n’entalo; buli muntu ng’avuganya ne banne mu bikolwa eby’obujeemu. 8. Era n’ebibi ebikontana n’obutonde tebyali wala nabo, naye, ng’Omutume era omujulirwa wa Kristo bw’agamba nti: “Abakazi baabwe baawanyisa enkolagana yaabwe ey’obuzaaliranwa n’abasajja, ne bakola ebitali bya buzaaliranwa. Abasajja nabo baalekayo okwegatta ne bakazi baabwe mu ngeri ey’obuzaaliranwa, ne bajjuzibwa obukaba ne beegatta ne basajja bannaabwe. N’ekyava mu bikolwa ebyo eby’obugwagwa, kwe kusasulibwa empeera esaanira okwonoona kwabwe.”

fields.title: Eggwanga ly’abantu lyali liggwaawo
fields.body_html:
§6. Eggwanga ly’abantu lyali liggwaawo, ekifaananyi kya Katonda kyali kisangulwa, n’omulimu gwe nga gwonooneka. Kale oba Katonda yandirese ekigambo kye yayogera, ekyaleetera omuntu okuzikirira; oba ekyo ekyagabana ku kubaawo kwa Kigambo kyandiddidde mu kuzikirira, era olwo ekigendererwa kya Katonda kyandiremeddwa. Kale olwo? Obulungi bwa Katonda bwandigumiikirizza kino? Naye bwe kiba bwe kityo, omuntu yandibadde atondebwa lwaki? Kyandibadde bunafu, so si bulungi ku ludda lwa Katonda.

Olw’ensonga eno, kale, okufa nga kweyongedde okufuga abantu, n’okuvunda nga kubasigaddeko, eggwanga ly’abantu lyali lizikirira; omuntu alina amagezi eyakolebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda yali abula, n’omulimu gw’emikono gya Katonda gwali gusaanuuka. 2. Kubanga okufa, nga bwe nnayogedde waggulu, kwafuna okuva olwo obuyinza obw’amateeka ku ffe, era tekyasoboka kwewala tteeka, kubanga lyali liteereddwawo Katonda olw’okusobya, era ekyavaamu ddala kyali kibi nnyo era nga tekisaana. 3. Kubanga kyandibadde kibi nnyo, okusooka, Katonda, ng’amaze okwogera, okulabika ng’omulimba—nti, bwe yamala okulagira nti omuntu, bw’alisobya ku kiragiro, alifa okufa, oluvannyuma lw’okusobya omuntu aleme okufa, naye ekigambo kya Katonda kimenyebwe. Kubanga Katonda teyandibadde wa mazima, singa, bwe yamala okugamba nti tulifa, omuntu n’atafa. 4. Era, tekyandisaanidde ebitonde ebyakolebwa nga birina amagezi, era ebyagabana ku Kigambo, okuzikirira, ne biddayo eri obutabaawo mu kkubo ly’okuvunda. 5. Kubanga tekyandigwanidde bulungi bwa Katonda ebintu bye yakola okuggwaawo, olw’obulimba Setaani bwe yalimba abantu. 6. Okusingira ddala tekyandisaanidde n’akatono omulimu gw’emikono gya Katonda mu bantu okuggibwawo, oba olw’obulagajjavu bwabwe bo, oba olw’obulimba bw’emyoyo emibi.

7. Kale, ng’ebitonde ebirina amagezi bwe byali biggwaawo n’emirimu egy’engeri eyo nga gyonooneka, Katonda mu bulungi bwe yandikoze ki? Okuleka okuvunda kubawangule n’okufa kubakwate? Kale omugaso gw’okubatonda ku lubereberye gwandibadde ki? Kubanga kyandisinze obutabatonda n’akatono, okusinga okubatonda ate ne balekebwa mu bulagajjavu n’okuzikirira. 8. Kubanga obulagajjavu bulaga bunafu, so si bulungi ku ludda lwa Katonda—kwe kugamba, singa aleka omulimu gwe okwonooneka ng’amaze okugukola—okusinga singa teyakola muntu n’akatono. 9. Kubanga singa teyabakola, tewandibaddewo amulumiriza bunafu; naye bwe yamala okubakola, n’abatonda okuva mu bwereere, kyandibadde kibi nnyo ddala omulimu okwonooneka, era ekyo mu maaso g’Omukozi waagwo. 10. Kale tekyasoboka n’akatono kuleka bantu mu mukoka gw’okuvunda; kubanga kino tekyandisaanidde, era tekyandigwanidde bulungi bwa Katonda.

fields.title: Ku ludda olulala waaliwo obutakyukakyuka bw’obutonde bwa Katonda
fields.body_html:
§7. Ku ludda olulala waaliwo obutakyukakyuka bw’obutonde bwa Katonda, obutasaana kuweebwayo olw’omugaso gwaffe. Kale abantu bandiyitiddwa okwenenya? Naye okwenenya tekuyinza kuziyiza kutuukirizibwa kwa tteeka; ate n’okusingawo tekuyinza kuwonya butonde obwagwa. Twereetako okuvunda era twetaaga okuzzibwa mu Kisa ky’Ekifaananyi kya Katonda. Tewaali yandizzizza buggya okuggyako Oyo eyatonda. Ye yekka yali asobola (1) okutonda byonna obuggya, (2) okubonaabona ku lwa bonna, (3) okukiikirira bonna eri Kitaffe.

Naye nga ekyo bwe kyali kiteekwa okubaawo, bwe kityo ku ludda olulala ebisaanira Katonda mu bwenkanya byali bikiziyiza: nti Katonda alabike nga wa mazima eri etteeka lye yateekawo ku kufa. Kubanga kyandibadde kibi nnyo Katonda, Kitaffe ow’amazima, okulabika ng’omulimba olw’omugaso gwaffe n’okutukuuma. 2. Kale wano, nate, Katonda yandikoze ki? Okusaba abantu okwenenya olw’okusobya kwabwe? Kubanga kino omuntu yandigambye nti kisaanira Katonda; nga bwe kiri nti, ng’abantu bwe baakyukira okuvunda olw’okusobya, bwe batyo olw’okwenenya bayinza okuddamu okuteekebwa mu kkubo ly’obutavunda. 3. Naye okwenenya, okusooka, tekwandikuumye bisaanira Katonda mu bwenkanya. Kubanga teyandibadde wa mazima n’akatono, singa abantu tebaasigala mu mukono gw’okufa; era, ekyokubiri, okwenenya tekuzza bantu kuva mu ekyo kye bali mu butonde bwabwe—kubaziyiza buziyiza okukola ebibi. 4. Kale singa ekyali kirimu kyali kisobyo kyokka, so si kuvunda okukiddirira, okwenenya kwandibadde kumala. Naye singa, okusobya bwe kwamala okutandika, abantu ne bayingira mu kuvunda okwali mu butonde bwabwe, ne baggibwako ekisa kye baalina, nga bali mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, kiki ekirala ekyali kyetaagisa? oba kiki ekyali kyetaagibwa olw’ekisa ekyo n’okuzzibwa okwo, okuggyako Kigambo kya Katonda, eyali yakola ebintu byonna okuva mu bwereere ku lubereberye? 5. Kubanga kyali kikye nate okuleeta ekivunda mu butavunda, n’okukuuma nga tebikutuse ebisaanira Kitaffe mu bwenkanya ku bonna. Kubanga, nga ye Kigambo kya Kitaffe, era ng’asinga byonna, ye yekka, olw’okusaanira okw’obutonde bwe, yali asobola okutonda byonna obuggya, era yali asaanidde okubonaabona ku lwa bonna n’okubeera omubaka wa bonna eri Kitaffe.

fields.title: Kale Kigambo n’akyalira ensi eyo gye yali abeeramu bulijjo
fields.body_html:
§8. Kale Kigambo n’akyalira ensi eyo gye yali abeeramu bulijjo ; n’alaba obubi buno bwonna. Yeetwalira omubiri ogw’obutonde bwaffe, era omubiri ogwo nga guva mu Mbeerera etaliiko bbala, mu lubuto lwe mwe yagufuulira ogugwe, alyoke yeeragiremu, awangule okufa, era azzeewo obulamu.

Olw’ekigendererwa kino, kale, Kigambo kya Katonda atalina mubiri, atavunda era atali wa kintu kya nsi, ajja mu kitundu kyaffe, newaakubadde nga teyali wala naffe edda. Kubanga tewali kitundu kya bitonde ekiri ekyereere nga taliimu: Ajjuzizza ebintu byonna buli wamu, ng’asigala ali wamu ne Kitaawe. Naye ajja ng’akkakkana okutulaga okwagala n’ekisa, n’okutukyalira. 2. Era bwe yalaba eggwanga ly’ebitonde ebirina amagezi nga liri mu kkubo ly’okuzikirira, n’okufa nga kubafuga olw’okuvunda; era bwe yalaba nti okulabula ku kusobya kwali kunywezezza okuvunda okwali ku ffe, era nti kyandibadde kibi nnyo etteeka okugwa nga terinnatuukirizibwa: bwe yalaba, nate, obutasaana bw’ekyali kituuseewo: nti ebintu bye yali yakola yennyini byali biggwaawo: bwe yalaba, era, obubi obungi ennyo obw’abantu, n’engeri gye baali bagenda babwongera mpolampola okutuuka ku kigero ekitagumiikirizika ku bo bennyini: era bwe yalaba, ekisembayo, nti abantu bonna baali wansi w’ekibonerezo ky’okufa: n’asaasira eggwanga lyaffe, n’akwatirwa obunafu bwaffe ekisa, n’akkakkana okutuuka ku kuvunda kwaffe, era, olw’obutasobola kugumiikiriza kufa kufuga—ekitonde kireme okuzikirira, n’omulimu gw’emikono gya Kitaawe mu bantu guleme kuggwaawo bwereere—Yeetwalira omubiri, era omubiri ogutali gwa ngeri ndala okuva ku gwaffe. 3. Kubanga teyayagala bwagazi kufuna mubiri, wadde okulabika obulabisi. Kubanga singa yayagala okulabika obulabisi, yandisobodde okulabika mu bwakatonda bwe mu ngeri endala esinga obukulu. Naye yeetwalira omubiri ogw’engeri yaffe, era si ekyo kyokka, wabula okuva mu mbeerera etaliiko bbala wadde kamogo, atamanyi musajja, omubiri omuyonjo era omulongoofu ddala ogutaakwatibwako kwegatta kwa bantu. Kubanga, nga ye kennyini wa maanyi, era Omukozi wa buli kintu, ateekateeka omubiri mu Mbeerera nga yeekaalu ye, era agufuula ogugwe ddala ng’ekikozesebwa, ng’alabisibwa mu gwo, era ng’abeera mu gwo. 4. Era bw’atyo, bwe yeetwalira okuva mu mibiri gyaffe omubiri ogw’obutonde bwe bumu, kubanga bonna baali wansi w’ekibonerezo ky’okuvunda kw’okufa, yaguwaayo eri okufa mu kifo kya bonna, n’aguwaayo eri Kitaffe—ng’akola kino, era, olw’okwagala kwe n’ekisa, olw’ekigendererwa nti, okusooka, bonna bwe babalibwa nga baafiira mu ye, etteeka eryaleeta okuzikirira kw’abantu liggibweewo (kubanga amaanyi gaalyo gaggwerawo ddala mu mubiri gwa Mukama, era nga terikyalina we lisinziira ku bantu, banne), era nti, ekyokubiri, ng’abantu bwe baali bakyukidde okuvunda, abakyuse nate abazze eri obutavunda, era abazuukize okuva mu kufa olw’okwefuulira omubiri n’olw’ekisa ky’Okuzuukira, ng’agoba okufa okuva ku bo ng’essubi bwe liggwaawo mu muliro.

fields.title: Kigambo, olw’okuba okufa kwokka kwe kwali kusobola okuyimiriza kawumpuli
fields.body_html:
§9. Kigambo, olw’okuba okufa kwokka kwe kwali kusobola okuyimiriza kawumpuli, yeetwalira omubiri ogufa, ogwo, nga gwegasse naye, gwandigasizza bonna, era olw’okugabana ku butafa bwe gwandiyimirizza okuvunda kw’Eggwanga. Olw’okusinga byonna, yafuula Omubiri gwe ekiweebwayo ku lw’emmeeme zaffe; olw’okubeera omu naffe ffenna, yatwambaza obutafa. Ekyokulabirako ekinnyonnyola kino.

Kubanga Kigambo, bwe yategeera nti okuvunda kw’abantu tekwandiggiddwawo mu ngeri ndala yonna okuggyako okufa, ng’ekyetaagisa, ate nga tekyasoboka Kigambo kufa, kubanga tafa, era ye Mwana wa Kitaffe; olw’ensonga eno yeetwalira omubiri ogusobola okufa, gulyoke, olw’okugabana ku Kigambo asinga byonna, gusaanire okufa mu kifo kya bonna, era, olwa Kigambo eyali azze okugubeeramu, gusigale nga tegukwatibwa kuvunda, era okuva olwo okuvunda kuziyizibwe ku bonna olw’Ekisa ky’Okuzuukira. N’olwekyo, bwe yawaayo eri okufa omubiri gwe yali yeetwalidde, ng’ekiweebwayo era ssaddaaka etaliiko bbala lyonna, amangu ago n’aggyawo okufa ku banne bonna olw’okuwaayo ekyenkanankana. 2. Kubanga, nga asinga byonna, Kigambo kya Katonda, mu ngeri esaanira, bwe yawaayo yeekaalu ye n’ekikozesebwa kye eky’omubiri ku lw’obulamu bwa bonna, yasasula ebbanja olw’okufa kwe. Era bw’atyo ye, Omwana wa Katonda atavunda, ng’agattiddwa ku bonna olw’obutonde obufaanagana, mu ngeri esaanira yayambaza bonna obutavunda, olw’ekisuubizo ky’okuzuukira. Kubanga okuvunda kwennyini mu kufa tekukyalina we kusinziira ku bantu, olwa Kigambo, eyazze okubeera mu bo olw’omubiri gwe ogumu. 3. Era nga kabaka omukulu bw’ayingira mu kibuga ekinene n’abeera mu emu ku nnyumba ezirimu, ekibuga ekyo kiweebwa ekitiibwa ekinene ennyo, era tewali mulabe wadde omubbi akyakirumba n’akiwamba; wabula, kirowoozebwa nti kisaanira okulabirirwa ennyo, olwa kabaka okubeera mu nnyumba emu yokka eyo: bwe kityo, ne ku Kabaka wa byonna bwe kyali. 4. Kubanga kaakano ng’azze mu kitundu kyaffe, n’abeera mu mubiri gumu mu banne, okuva kati olukwe lwonna olw’omulabe ku bantu luziyiziddwa, n’okuvunda kw’okufa okwali kubawangula edda kuggiddwawo. Kubanga eggwanga ly’abantu lyandizikiridde, singa Mukama era Omulokozi wa bonna, Omwana wa Katonda, teyajja mu ffe okusisinkana enkomerero y’okufa.

fields.title: Ekyokulabirako ekirala ekifaanana, kiraga obutuufu bw’omulimu gw’okununula
fields.body_html:
§10. Ekyokulabirako ekirala ekifaanana, kiraga obutuufu bw’omulimu gw’okununula. Engeri Kristo gye yasangulamu okuzikirira kwaffe, n’ateekawo eddagala lyakwo olw’okuyigiriza kwe. Obukakafu obuva mu Byawandiikibwa ku Kufuuka omuntu kwa Kigambo, ne ku Ssaddaaka gye yawaayo.

Mazima omulimu guno omunene gwali gusaanira ddala obulungi bwa Katonda. 1. Kubanga singa kabaka, bw’amala okuzimba ennyumba oba ekibuga, nga kirumbiddwa abanyazi olw’obulagajjavu bw’abakibeeramu, takirekerera mu ngeri yonna, naye akiwolerera era akikomyawo ng’omulimu gwe, nga tafaayo ku bulagajjavu bw’abakibeeramu, wabula ku kimusaanira ye; okusingawo nnyo Katonda Kigambo kya Kitaffe omulungi ennyo teyalekerera ggwanga lya bantu, omulimu gwe, nga ligenda livunda: naye, bwe yasangula okufa okwali kuzze olw’okuwaayo omubiri gwe, yalongoosa obulagajjavu bwabwe olw’okuyigiriza kwe, ng’azzaawo byonna ebyali eby’omuntu olw’obuyinza bwe. 2. Era kino omuntu ayinza okukikakasa okuva mu bawandiisi b’Omulokozi abaali baluŋŋamizibwa, singa asanga ebiwandiiko byabwe, we bagamba nti: “Kubanga okwagala kwa Katonda kutuwaliriza, ng’omu bwe yafiirira bonna, bonna kyebaava bafa. Yafiirira abantu bonna; abalamu balemenga okubeera abalamu ku bwabwe bokka, wabula ku bw’oyo eyabafiirira era n’azuukira,” Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Era, nate: “Naye tulaba Yesu eyassibwa wansi wa bamalayika okumala akaseera akatono. Olw’ekisa kya Katonda, yabonaabona n’afa, alyoke alege ku kufa ku lwa buli muntu, n’atikkirwa engule ey’ekitiibwa n’ettendo.” 3. Ate era alaga ensonga lwaki kyali kyetaagisa obutaba mulala, wabula Katonda Kigambo yennyini, okufuuka omuntu; bwe kiti: “Katonda oyo eyatonderwa ebintu byonna, era mu oyo Yesu Kristo ebintu byonna mwe byatonderwa, eyalondebwa okuleeta abaana abangi mu kitiibwa. Era kyasaanira Yesu okubonyaabonyezebwa, ng’omukulembeze omutuukirivu, okubaleetera obulokozi;” ebigambo ebyo bitegeeza nti tekyali kya mulala yenna okukomyawo omuntu okuva mu kuvunda okwali kutandise, okuggyako Kigambo kya Katonda, eyali yabakola ku lubereberye. 4. Era nti Kigambo yennyini yeetwalira omubiri olwa ssaddaaka ku lw’emibiri egifaanana ng’ogugwe, ku kino nakyo boogerako mu bigambo bino: “Olw’okubanga abaana balina omubiri n’omusaayi, naye yalina omubiri n’omusaayi, alyoke azikirize oyo alina amaanyi ag’okufa, ye Setaani. Yakikola alyoke awe eddembe abo bonna abaali bamaze obulamu bwabwe bwonna mu buddu olw’entiisa y’okufa.” 5. Kubanga olwa ssaddaaka y’omubiri gwe, yakomya etteeka eryali litulumiriza, era n’atuteerawo entandikwa empya ey’obulamu, olw’essuubi ly’okuzuukira ly’atuwadde. Kubanga okufa bwe kwafuga abantu nga kuva mu muntu, olw’ensonga eyo, mu ngeri ekyuuse, Kigambo kya Katonda bwe yafuuka omuntu, okuzikirizibwa kw’okufa n’okuzuukira kw’obulamu ne bijja; ng’omuntu eyasitula Kristo bw’agamba nti: “Kuba ng’okufa bwe kwaleetebwa omuntu, era n’okuzuukira kw’abafu kwaleetebwa muntu. Kuba ng’abantu bonna bwe baafa olwa Adamu, era bwe batyo bonna balifuulibwa abalamu olwa Kristo:” n’ebirala. Kubanga kaakano tetukyafa ng’abasaliddwa omusango; wabula ng’abantu abazuukira okuva mu bafu tulindirira okuzuukira okw’awamu okwa bonna, “kw’aliraga mu ntuuko zaakwo,” ye Katonda, eyakukola era n’akutuwa. 6. Eno nno y’ensonga esooka ey’Omulokozi okufuuka omuntu. Naye omuntu ayinza okulaba okuva mu nsonga zino eziddako nti okujja kwe okw’ekisa mu ffe kwali kusaanidde okubaawo.

fields.title: Ensonga ey’okubiri ey’Okufuuka omuntu
fields.body_html:
§11. Ensonga ey’okubiri ey’Okufuuka omuntu. Katonda, ng’amanyi nti omuntu mu butonde bwe teyali amala kumumanya, yamuwa okumanya Katonda yennyini, alyoke afune omugaso mu kubaawo kwe. Yabakola mu Kifaananyi kya Kigambo, balyoke bwe batyo bamanye Kigambo, era nga bayita mu ye bamanye Kitaffe. Naye omuntu, bwe yanyooma kino, n’agwa mu kusinza ebifaananyi, n’aleka Katonda atalabika n’akwata eby’obulogo n’okulagulira ku mmunyeenye; era bino byonna newaakubadde nga Katonda yali yeeyolese mu ngeri nnyingi.

Katonda, alina obuyinza ku bintu byonna, bwe yali atonda eggwanga ly’abantu ng’ayita mu Kigambo kye, bwe yalaba obunafu bw’obutonde bwabwe, nti tebwamala bwokka kumanya Mutonzi waabwo, wadde okufuna endowooza yonna ku Katonda; kubanga ye nga si mutonde, ate ebitonde byakolebwa okuva mu bwereere, era ye nga talina mubiri, ate abantu baakolebwa mu ngeri eya wansi mu mubiri, era kubanga mu buli ngeri ebintu ebyakolebwa byali wala nnyo okusobola okutegeera n’okumanya Omutonzi waabyo—ng’asaasira, nkiddamu, eggwanga ly’abantu, kubanga mulungi, teyabaleka nga tebalina kumanya ye, baleme okubulwa omugaso gwonna mu kubaawo. 2. Kubanga ebitonde byandiganyuddwa ki singa tebaamanya Mutonzi waabwe? oba bandibadde batya n’amagezi awatali kumanya Kigambo kya Kitaffe (era Amagezi ge), mwe baafunira okubaawo kwabwe kwennyini? Kubanga tewandibaddewo kibaawula wadde ku nsolo ezitalina magezi singa tebaalina kumanya kintu kirala okuggyako eby’oku nsi. Nedda, lwaki Katonda yandibakoze n’akatono, oba nga teyayagala kumanyibwa bo? 3. N’olwekyo, kino kireme kubaawo, ng’ali mulungi, abawa omugabo mu Kifaananyi kye yennyini, Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, era abakola mu Kifaananyi kye ne mu kufaanana kwe: balyoke olw’ekisa ekyo, bwe bategeera Ekifaananyi, kwe kugamba, Kigambo kya Kitaffe, basobole nga bayita mu ye okufuna endowooza ku Kitaffe, era nga bamanyi Omutonzi waabwe, babeere mu bulamu obw’essanyu era obw’omukisa ddala. 4. Naye abantu nate mu bukyamu bwabwe bwe baanyooma, newaakubadde nga waaliwo bino byonna, ekisa kye baaweebwa, baagaana ddala Katonda, ne bakwasa emmeeme yaabwe ekizikiza, n’okutuusa obutakoma ku kwerabira ndowooza yaabwe ku Katonda, naye ne beeyiiyiza n’ebintu kimu ku kirala. Kubanga tebaakoma ku kwekolera bifaananyi bye bayola, mu kifo ky’amazima, n’okussa ekitiibwa mu bintu ebitaliiwo okusinga Katonda omulamu, “ne baweereza ebitonde, mu kifo ky’okusinza eyabitonda,” naye, ekisinga obubi, baatwala ekitiibwa kya Katonda ne bakiwa emiti n’amayinja ne buli kintu eky’ensi n’abantu, ne beeyongerayo n’okusinga awo, nga bwe twayogera mu kitabo ekyasooka. 5. Obutatya Katonda bwabwe bwatuuka wala nnyo, ne batandika okusinza dayimooni, ne bazirangirira nga bakatonda, nga batuukiriza okwegomba kwabwe. Kubanga baawangayo, nga bwe kyayogeddwa waggulu, ebiweebwayo by’ensolo ezitalina magezi, ne ssaddaaka z’abantu, nga bwe kyabasaanira, ne beesiba bokka ennyo okusingawo wansi w’okuluŋŋamizibwa kwabwe okw’eddalu. 6. Eno y’ensonga lwaki era eby’obulogo byayigirizibwa mu bo, n’ebifo by’okulaguza mu bitundu eby’enjawulo ne bikyamya abantu, era abantu bonna ne batwalira emmunyeenye n’ebintu byonna eby’omu ggulu ebiva mu kuzaalibwa kwabwe n’okubaawo kwabwe, nga tebalowooza ku kintu kyonna ekisukka ku birabika. 7. Era, mu bigambo ebitono, buli kintu kyali kijjudde obutatya Katonda n’obujeemu, era Katonda yekka, ne Kigambo kye, ye yali tamanyiddwa, newaakubadde nga teyali yeekwese okuva mu maaso g’abantu, wadde okuwa okumanya ye mu ngeri emu yokka; wabula, okwawukana ku ekyo, yali abakibikkulidde mu bifaananyi bingi ne mu makubo mangi.

fields.title: Kubanga newaakubadde omuntu yatondebwa mu kisa
fields.body_html:
§12. Kubanga newaakubadde omuntu yatondebwa mu kisa, Katonda, bwe yalaba edda nti yandyerabidde, yateekawo n’emirimu gy’okutonda okujjukiza omuntu ku ye. Era okusingawo, yateekawo Etteeka ne Bannabbi, obuweereza bwabwe nga bwali bwa nsi yonna. Naye abantu baafaayo ku kwegomba kwabwe kwokka.

Kubanga newaakubadde ekisa ky’Ekifaananyi kya Katonda kyali kimala kyokka okumanyisa Katonda Kigambo, era nga bayita mu ye, Kitaffe; naye Katonda, ng’amanyi obunafu bw’abantu, yateekateeka ne ku bulagajjavu bwabwe: balyoke, singa tebaafaayo kumanya Katonda bokka, basobozesebwe okuyita mu mirimu gy’okutonda obutabulwa kumanya Mutonzi. 2. Naye olw’okuba obulagajjavu bw’abantu, mpolampola, bukka mu bintu ebya wansi, Katonda yateekateeka, nate, ne ku bunafu buno bwabwe, ng’abaweereza etteeka, ne bannabbi, abantu be baali bamanyi, balyoke, newaakubadde nga tebeetegefu kutunula waggulu mu ggulu ne bamanya Omutonzi waabwe, bayigirizibwe abo abali okumpi nabo. Kubanga abantu basobola okuyiga okuva ku bantu mu ngeri ennyangu ebikwata ku bintu ebya waggulu. 3. Bwe kityo baali basobola, nga batunula mu bugulumivu bw’eggulu, ne bategeera okukwatagana kw’ebitonde, okumanya Omufuzi wabyo, Kigambo kya Kitaffe, oyo, olw’okulabirira kwe ku bintu byonna, amanyisa Kitaffe eri bonna, era olw’ensonga eno atambuza ebintu byonna, bonna balyoke bamanye Katonda nga bayita mu ye. 4. Oba, singa kino kyali kibasukkiridde, baali basobola okusisinkana waakiri abantu abatukuvu, era nga bayita mu bo okuyiga ku Katonda, Omutonzi wa byonna, Kitaawe wa Kristo; era nti okusinza ebifaananyi bwe butatya Katonda, era kujjudde obubi bwonna. 5. Oba baali basobola, ne mu kumanya etteeka, okulekayo obujeemu bwonna ne babeera mu bulamu obw’empisa ennungi. Kubanga etteeka teryali lya Bayudaaya bokka, era ne Bannabbi tebaatumibwa gye bali bokka, naye, newaakubadde nga baatumibwa eri Abayudaaya era nga bayigganyizibwa Abayudaaya, baali ssomero ettukuvu eri ensi yonna ery’okumanya Katonda n’okutambuza emmeeme. 6. Kale obulungi bwa Katonda n’okwagala kwe n’ekisa nga bingi bwe bityo—abantu wabula, nga bawanguddwa amasanyu ag’akaseera n’ebirowoozo ebikyamu n’obulimba ebiva eri dayimooni, tebaayimusa mitwe gyabwe eri amazima, wabula beetikka nnyo okusingawo obubi n’ebibi, n’okutuusa obutaddamu kulabika ng’abalina amagezi, wabula olw’empisa zaabwe ne babalibwa ng’abatalina magezi.

fields.title: Wano nate, Katonda yandisirise?
fields.body_html:
§13. Wano nate, Katonda yandisirise? okuleka bakatonda ab’obulimba okufuna okusinza kwe yatukolera okumuwa ye? Kabaka abantu be bwe bamujeemera, bw’amala okuweereza amabaluwa n’obubaka, yandigenze gye bali ye kennyini. Kale okusingawo nnyo Katonda alizzaawo mu ffe ekisa ky’ekifaananyi kye. Kino abantu, bo bennyini nga bifaananyi bufaananyi, tebaasobola kukikola. N’olwekyo Kigambo yennyini yalina okujja (1) okutonda obuggya, (2) okuzikiriza okufa mu Mubiri.

Kale nno, abantu bwe baafuuka ng’ensolo bwe batyo, n’obulimba bwa dayimooni nga bubikka buli kifo bwe butyo, era nga bukweka okumanya Katonda ow’amazima, Katonda yandikoze ki? Okusirika busirisi ku kintu ekinene bwe kityo, n’okuleka abantu okukyamizibwa dayimooni ne batamanya Katonda? 2. Era omugaso gwali ki ogw’omuntu okusooka okukolebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda? Kubanga kyandisinze akolebwe bukolebwa ng’ensolo, okusinga, ng’amaze okukolebwa ng’alina amagezi, okubeera mu bulamu bw’ensolo. 3. Oba kyali kyetaagisa ki n’akatono okufuna endowooza ku Katonda okuva ku lubereberye? Kubanga oba nga tasaanira kugifuna ne kaakano, kyandisinze singa teyagiweebwa ku lubereberye. 4. Oba Katonda eyabakola yandiganyuddwa ki, oba ekitiibwa ki kye yandifunye, singa abantu, be yakola, tebamusinza, naye ne balowooza nti abalala be baabakola? Kubanga bw’atyo Katonda alabika ng’eyakolera bano abalala mu kifo ky’okubakolera ye. 5. Nate, kabaka obuntu taleka nsi ze yateekamu abantu be kugenda mu balala n’okubaweereza, oba kugenda eri abantu abalala; naye abalabula mu mabaluwa, era emirundi mingi abatumira mikwano gye, oba, bwe kiba kyetaagisa, ajja ye kennyini, okubanenya ku nkomerero olw’okubeerawo kwe, baleme okuweereza abalala n’omulimu gwe guleme kuggwaawo bwereere. 6. Katonda tasinga nnyo kusaasira bitonde bye, bireme kukyamizibwa okumuvaako ne biweereza ebitaliimu? okusingira ddala kubanga okukyama okwo kwe kuvaako okuzikirira kwabyo n’okuggwaawo kwabyo, era kubanga tekyasaana abo okuzikirira abaali bagabanye ku kifaananyi kya Katonda. 7. Kale Katonda yandikoze ki? oba kiki ekyandikoleddwa okuggyako okuzza obuggya ekyo ekyali mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, abantu balyoke basobole okuddamu okumumanya nga bayita mu kyo? Naye kino kyandisobose kitya okutuukirira okuggyako olw’okubeerawo kw’Ekifaananyi kya Katonda kyennyini, Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo? Kubanga mu bantu tekyasoboka, kubanga bo baakolebwa bukolebwa mu kifaananyi; era ne bamalayika tebaasobola, kubanga nabo si bifaananyi (bya Katonda). N’olwekyo Kigambo kya Katonda yajja ye kennyini, alyoke, nga ye Kifaananyi kya Kitaffe, asobole okutonda obuggya omuntu eyakolebwa mu kifaananyi. 8. Naye, nate, kino tekyandisobose kubaawo singa okufa n’okuvunda tebyaggibwawo. 9. N’olwekyo yeetwalira, mu ngeri esaanira, omubiri ogufa, alyoke ng’okufa kuggibwawo mu gwo omulundi gumu ogw’enkomerero, abantu abaakolebwa mu Kifaananyi kye basobole okuddamu okufuulibwa abaggya. Kale tewaali mulala eyali amala olw’obwetaavu buno, okuggyako Ekifaananyi kya Kitaffe.

fields.title: Ekifaananyi ekyonoonese kiddamu okukubibwa okuva ku nnannyini kyo
fields.body_html:
§14. Ekifaananyi ekyonoonese kiddamu okukubibwa okuva ku nnannyini kyo. Bw’atyo Omwana wa Kitaffe n’ajja okunoonya, okulokola n’okuzza obuggya. Tewaali kkubo ddala. Omuntu, olw’okuba yali muzibe ye kennyini, teyasobola kulaba okusobola okuwonya. Obujulirwa bw’ebitonde bwali bulemereddwa okumukuuma, era tebwasobola kumukomyawo. Kigambo yekka ye yali asobola okukikola. Naye mu ngeri ki? Mu kweraga ng’Omuntu kyokka.

Kubanga nga bwe kiba, ekifaananyi ekyasiigibwa ku lubaawo bwe kizikizibwa amabala agava ebweru, oyo nnannyini kifaananyi kimugwanira okujja nate, ekifaananyi kiryoke kiddemu okukolebwa obuggya ku lubaawo lwe lumu: kubanga olw’ekifaananyi kye, n’olubaawo lwokka lwe kyasiigibwako terusuulibwa, wabula ensalo zaakyo ziddamu okukubibwa ku lwo; 2. mu ngeri y’emu n’Omwana wa Kitaffe omutukuvu ennyo, ng’ye Kifaananyi kya Kitaffe, yajja mu kitundu kyaffe okuzza obuggya omuntu eyatondebwa edda mu kifaananyi kye, n’okumuzuula, ng’oyo eyali abuze, mu kusonyiyibwa kw’ebibi; nga bw’ayogera ye kennyini mu Njiri nti: “Najja kunoonya n’okulokola abaabula.” Kyeyava n’agamba n’Abayudaaya nti: “Omuntu bw’atazaalibwa mulundi gwakubiri,” nga tategeeza, nga bo bwe baalowooza, kuzaalibwa mu mukazi, wabula ng’ayogera ku mmeeme ezaalibwa n’etondebwa obuggya mu kufaanana kw’ekifaananyi kya Katonda. 3. Naye okuva ensi bwe yali ejjudde okusinza ebifaananyi okw’ekikaawa n’obutatya Katonda, era okumanya Katonda nga kukwekeddwa, ani eyali agwanidde okuyigiriza ensi ebikwata ku Kitaffe? Omuntu, omuntu ayinza okugamba? Naye tekyali mu buyinza bw’omuntu okutuuka buli wantu wansi w’enjuba; kubanga tebaalina maanyi ga mubiri kudduka wala bwe kityo, era tebandisobodde kukkirizibwa mu nsonga eno, era tebaali na busobozi ku bwabwe kulwanyisa bulimba n’obukuusa bw’emizimu emibi. 4. Kubanga bonna bwe baali nga bakubiddwa era nga batabuddwa mu mmeeme olw’obulimba bwa dayimooni n’obutaliimu bw’ebifaananyi, bandisobodde batya okukyusa emmeeme y’omuntu n’amagezi g’omuntu—so nga n’okubirabako tebayinza? Oba omuntu ayinza atya okukyusa ekyo ky’atalaba? 5. Naye oboolyawo omuntu ayinza okugamba nti ebitonde byali bimala; naye singa ebitonde byali bimala, ebibi bino ebinene tebyandibaddewo n’akatono. Kubanga ebitonde byali biriwo dda, era wadde kyali kityo, abantu baali bewalula mu nsobi y’emu ku bikwata ku Katonda. 6. Kale ani eyali yeetaagibwa, okuggyako Kigambo kya Katonda, alaba emmeeme n’amagezi, era awa ebintu byonna mu bitonde okutambula, era ng’ayita mu byo amanyisa Kitaffe? Kubanga oyo eyali ayigiriza abantu ebikwata ku Kitaffe ng’ayita mu kulabirira kwe n’okutegeka kwe ebintu byonna, ye yali asobola okuzza obuggya okuyigiriza okwo kwe kumu. 7. Kale kino kyandikoleddwa kitya? Oboolyawo omuntu ayinza okugamba nti engeri ze zimu zaali zikyaliwo nga bwe zaali edda, alyoke alage nate amazima agakwata ku Kitaffe ng’ayita mu mulimu gw’obutonzi. Naye eno teyali nate ngeri ekakafu. Nedda ddala; kubanga abantu baali tebaagirabye edda, ne bakyusa amaaso gaabwe, nga tebakyatunula waggulu wabula wansi. 8. Kyeyava, nga bwe kyali kisaanira, bwe yayagala okugasa abantu, n’abeera wano ng’omuntu, ng’yeetwalira omubiri ng’egy’abalala, era okuva mu bintu eby’oku nsi, kwe kugamba mu mirimu gy’omubiri gwe [n’abayigiriza], abo abaali batayagala kumumanya okuva mu kulabirira kwe n’obufuzi bwe ku bintu byonna, balyoke bamanye, okuva mu mirimu egyakolebwa omubiri gwe gwennyini, Kigambo kya Katonda ali mu mubiri, era okuyita mu ye bamanye Kitaffe.

fields.title: Bw’atyo Kigambo n’akka okutuuka ku muntu eyali amaliddwa ebintu eby’omubiri
fields.body_html:
§15. Bw’atyo Kigambo n’akka okutuuka ku muntu eyali amaliddwa ebintu eby’omubiri, n’okutuuka n’okwetwalira omubiri. Obulombolombo bwonna obw’abantu yabusisinkana wakati mu kkubo; abantu ne bwe baali baagala okusinza Obutonde, Omuntu, Dayimooni oba abafu, yeeraga nga ye Mukama w’ebyo byonna.

Kubanga ng’omusomesa ow’ekisa afaayo ku bayigirizwa be, abamu ku bo bwe baba tebasobola kuganyulwa mu by’okuyiga ebya waggulu, akka ku mutendera gwabwe, n’abayigiriza waakiri mu ngeri ennyangu; bw’atyo ne Kigambo kya Katonda bwe yakola. Nga Pawulo bw’agamba nti: “Kubanga Katonda, mu magezi ge, yalaba ng’ensi teyinza kumumanya ng’eyita mu kutegeera kwayo. Katonda kyeyava asiima okuyita mu busirusiru bw’okubuulira Enjiri okulokola abakkiriza.” 2. Kubanga abantu, bwe baagaana okufumiitiriza ku Katonda, ne batunula wansi, ng’abaabbira mu buziba, ne banoonya Katonda mu butonde ne mu nsi ey’ebirabika, nga beekolera bakatonda okuva mu bantu abafa ne mu dayimooni; olw’ekyo Omulokozi w’abantu bonna ow’okwagala, Kigambo kya Katonda, yeetwalira omubiri, n’atambula ng’Omuntu mu bantu, n’asisinkana obusimu bw’abantu bonna wakati mu kkubo, abo, nkiddamu, abalowooza nti Katonda wa mubiri, balyoke bategeere amazima okuva mu ebyo Mukama by’akola ng’ayita mu mubiri gwe, era okuyita mu ye bamanye Kitaffe. 3. Kale, nga bwe baali abantu, era ab’obuntu mu birowoozo byabwe byonna, buli kye baasimbangako amaaso gaabwe, eyo gye baasanga nga basisinkanibwa wakati mu kkubo, ne bayigirizibwa amazima okuva ku buli ludda. 4. Kubanga bwe baatunuuliranga Ebitonde n’entiisa, baalaba nga bwe byayatula Kristo nga Mukama; oba amagezi gaabwe bwe gaawugulirwanga eri abantu, ne babalowooza okuba bakatonda, naye okuva mu mirimu gy’Omulokozi, singa bagigeraageranya, Omulokozi yekka mu bantu ye yalabika nga Mwana wa Katonda; kubanga tewaali mirimu egyenkana egyo egyakolebwa mu balala ng’egyo egyakolebwa Kigambo kya Katonda. 5. Oba bwe baali basikiriziddwa eri emizimu emibi, naye bwe baagiraba nga egobebwa Kigambo, baalina okumanya nti ye yekka, Kigambo kya Katonda, ye Katonda, era nti emizimu si bakatonda. 6. Oba amagezi gaabwe bwe gaali gakkiridde dda okutuuka ku bafu, ne basinza abazira, ne bakatonda aboogerwako abayiiya ennyimba, kyokka bwe baalaba okuzuukira kw’Omulokozi, baalina okwatula nti abo bakatonda ba bulimba, era nti Mukama yekka ye wa mazima, Kigambo kya Kitaffe, eyali Mukama n’ow’okufa. 7. Olw’ensonga eno yazaalibwa era n’alabika ng’Omuntu, n’afa, n’azuukira, ng’azikiza n’okubikka emirimu gy’abantu bonna abaasooka n’egigye, abantu gye baali bawugulirwa yonna, alyoke abakomyewo okuva eyo, n’abayigiriza ku Kitaawe ow’amazima, nga ye kennyini bw’agamba nti: “Najja kunoonya n’okulokola abaabula.”

fields.title: Yajja okusikiriza amaaso g’omuntu agaali ku by’omubiri gadde gy’ali ng’omuntu
fields.body_html:
§16. Kale yajja okusikiriza amaaso g’omuntu agaali gasibiddwa ku by’omubiri gadde gy’ali ng’omuntu, bw’atyo amutuuse okumumanya nga Katonda.

Kubanga amagezi g’abantu bwe gaali gakkiridde ddala mu bintu ebiwulirwa n’omubiri, Kigambo yeekweka ng’alabikira mu mubiri, alyoke, ng’Omuntu, akyuse abantu badde gy’ali, n’obusimu bwabwe abusimbe ku ye, era, abantu bwe banaamulabanga okuva olwo ng’Omuntu, abakakase olw’emirimu gye yakola nti si Muntu yekka, wabula era Katonda, era Kigambo era Amagezi ga Katonda ow’amazima. 2. Kino era kye kimu Pawulo ky’ategeeza bw’agamba nti: “mubeerenga n’emirandira mu kwagala nga mukunywereddemu, mulyoke mubeerenga n’amaanyi awamu n’abatukuvu bonna, okusobola okutegeera obugazi, n’obuwanvu, n’obugulumivu n’okukka wansi ebiri mu kwagala kwa Kristo. Njagala mutegeere okwagala kwa Kristo okusukkiridde okutegeera kwonna, mulyoke musobole okutegeerera ddala Katonda bw’ali.” 3. Kubanga Kigambo bwe yeeraga buli wamu, waggulu ne wansi, mu buziba ne mu bugazi—waggulu, mu bitonde; wansi, mu kufuuka omuntu; mu buziba, mu magombe; ne mu bugazi, mu nsi—ebintu byonna bijjuziddwa okumanya Katonda. 4. Kale olw’ensonga eno, era, teyatuukiriza mangu ddala nga yaakajja ssaddaaka ye ku lwa bonna, ng’awaayo omubiri gwe eri okufa n’aguzuukiza, kubanga mu ngeri eyo yandibadde yeefudde atalabika. Naye yeefuula alabika ekimala olw’ebyo bye yakola, ng’abeera mu gwo, era ng’akola emirimu egy’engeri eyo, era ng’alaga obubonero obw’engeri eyo, ne bimumanyisa nga si Muntu nate, wabula nga Katonda Kigambo. 5. Kubanga mu kufuuka kwe Omuntu, Omulokozi yalina okutuukiriza emirimu ebiri egy’okwagala; okusooka, mu kuggya okufa ku ffe n’okutuzza obuggya; ekyokubiri, ye atalabika era atalengerwa, mu kweyoleka n’okwemanyisa olw’emirimu gye nti ye Kigambo kya Kitaffe, era Omufuzi era Kabaka w’ebintu byonna.

fields.title: Okufuuka omuntu tekwakugira Kigambo kubeera buli wamu
fields.body_html:
§17. Engeri okufuuka omuntu gye kutaakugira Kigambo kubeera buli wamu, era bwe kutaakendeeza Butukuvu bwe. (Ekyokulabirako ky’Enjuba.)

Kubanga teyali, nga bwe kiyinza okulowoozebwa, ng’aggaliddwa mu mubiri, era bwe yali mu mubiri, teyali nga taliiwo awalala; era bwe yali atambuza omubiri, ebintu byonna tebyalekebwa nga tebiriimu kukola kwe na kulabirira kwe; wabula, ekisinga okwewuunyisa, nga Kigambo bwe yali, so nga tewali kimuzingiramu, ye kennyini ye yazingiramu ebintu byonna; era nga bw’abeera mu bitonde byonna, ate ng’ayawukana mu bubeerawo bwe ku bintu byonna, era ng’ali mu bintu byonna olw’amaanyi ge ye,—ng’ateekateeka ebintu byonna, era ku byonna ne mu byonna ng’alaga okulabirira kwe, era ng’awa obulamu buli kintu n’ebintu byonna, ng’azingiramu byonna awatali kuzingirwamu, wabula ng’abeera mu Kitaffe yekka ddala era mu buli ngeri,—2. bw’atyo, ne bwe yali mu mubiri gw’omuntu ng’aguwa obulamu ye kennyini, yali, awatali kwekontana, ng’awa obulamu n’ebintu byonna, era yali mu buli kikolwa ky’obutonde, era yali bweru wa byonna, era ne bwe yamanyibwanga okuva mu mubiri olw’emirimu gye, ate yeeyolekanga n’okuva mu kukola kw’ebintu byonna. 3. Kaakano, mulimu gwa mmeeme okulaba n’ebiri ebweru w’omubiri gwayo, mu kulowooza, naye nga tekola kintu bweru wa mubiri gwayo, wadde okutambuza olw’okubeerawo kwayo ebintu ebiri ewala n’omubiri. Kwe kugamba, omuntu bw’alowooza ku bintu ebiri ewala, ekyo tekibitambuza wadde okubijjulula; era singa omuntu atuula mu nnyumba ye n’alowooza ku bintu eby’omu ggulu, ekyo tekyandimusobozesezza kutambuza njuba wadde okukyusa eggulu. Naye alaba nga bitambula era nga biriwo, kyokka nga tasobola kubikolako kintu. 4. Kaakano, Kigambo kya Katonda mu buntu bwe teyali bw’atyo; kubanga teyali musibe wa mubiri gwe, wabula ye yennyini ye yali agukozesa, n’atabeera mu gwo mwokka, wabula yali ddala mu buli kintu, era ng’ali bweru wa byonna, ng’abeera mu Kitaffe yekka. 5. Era kino kye kyali eky’ekyewuunyo, nti mu kiseera kye kimu yali atambula ng’omuntu, era nga Kigambo ng’awa obulamu ebintu byonna, era ng’Omwana ng’abeera ne Kitaffe. N’olwekyo ne Embeerera bwe yamuzaala teyafuna nkyukakyuka yonna, era olw’okubeera mu mubiri [ekitiibwa kye] tekyakendeera: wabula, okwawukana ku ekyo, n’omubiri yagutukuza. 6. Kubanga ne mu kubeera mu bintu byonna tagabana ku butonde bwabyo, wabula ebintu byonna, okwawukana ku ekyo, ye abiwa obulamu n’abiwanirira. 7. Kubanga singa n’enjuba, gye yatonda, era gye tulaba, bw’etambula mu ggulu, teyonoonebwa olw’okukwata ku mibiri egy’oku nsi, era tezikizibwa kizikiza, wabula okwawukana ku ekyo yo kennyini ebyakira era n’ebitukuza, kale kisinga nnyo nti Kigambo kya Katonda omutukuvu ennyo, Omutonzi era Mukama w’enjuba, teyayonoonebwa olw’okumanyibwa mu mubiri; wabula, ng’atavunda, yawa obulamu era n’atukuza n’omubiri, ogwali ogufa mu bwagwo: “Kristo teyakola kibi wadde okwogera ebyobukuusa.”,” bwe kityo Ekyawandiikibwa bwe kyogera, “wadde okwogera ebyobukuusa.”

fields.title: Engeri Kigambo era Amaanyi ga Katonda gy’akolera mu bikolwa bye eby’obuntu
fields.body_html:
§18. Engeri Kigambo era Amaanyi ga Katonda gy’akolera mu bikolwa bye eby’obuntu: mu kugoba dayimooni, mu Byamagero, mu Kuzaalibwa kwe mu Mbeerera.

Noolwekyo, abawandiisi abaaluŋŋamizibwa bwe boogera ku nsonga eno nti yalya era yazaalibwa, tegeera nti omubiri, ng’omubiri, gwe gwazaalibwa, ne guliisibwa emmere egituukirira ng’obutonde bwagwo bwe buli, so nga Katonda, Kigambo yennyini, eyagattibwa n’omubiri, bwe yali ateekateeka ebintu byonna, era olw’emirimu gye yakola mu mubiri yeeraga nti si muntu, wabula Katonda Kigambo. Naye ebyo byogerwa ku ye, kubanga omubiri gwennyini ogwalya, ogwazaalibwa, era ogwabonaabona, gwali gwa Mukama yekka so si gwa mulala: era kubanga, bwe yafuuka omuntu, kyali kigwana ebyo okwogerwa ku ye ng’omuntu, okulaga nti yalina omubiri mu mazima, so si mu kulabika obulabisi. 2. Naye nga bwe yamanyibwa okuva mu bintu bino nti yali ali mu mubiri, bw’atyo n’okuva mu mirimu gye yakola mu mubiri yeemanyisa okuba Omwana wa Katonda. Kyeyava n’akoowoola Abayudaaya abatakkiriza nti; “Obanga sikola ebyo Kitange by’ayagala nkole, kale temunzikiriza; naye obanga nkola by’ayagala, newaakubadde Nze temunzikiriza waakiri mukkirize ebyo bye nkola mulyoke mutegeere nti Kitange ali mu Nze, era nange ndi mu Kitange.” 3. Kubanga nga bwe kiri nti, wadde nga talabika, amanyibwa okuyita mu mirimu gy’obutonzi; bw’atyo, bwe yafuuka omuntu, ng’ali mu mubiri nga talabika, kiyinza okumanyibwa okuva mu mirimu gye nti oyo asobola okukola bino si muntu, wabula Maanyi era Kigambo kya Katonda. 4. Kubanga okulagira kwe emizimu emibi, n’okugobebwa kwagyo, ekikolwa kino si kya muntu, wabula kya Katonda. Oba ani eyamulaba ng’awonya endwadde ezikwata ekika ky’omuntu, ayinza okumulowooza okuba omuntu so si Katonda? Kubanga yalongoosa abagenge, yatambuza abalema, yaggula amatu ga bakiggala, yazibula amaaso ga bamuzibe, era mu bigambo ebitono yagoba ku bantu endwadde zonna n’obunafu bwonna: era okuva mu bikolwa ebyo kyali kisoboka n’eri omulabi asinga obwa bulijjo okulaba obwakatonda bwe. Kubanga ani eyamulaba ng’awa abantu abaazaalibwa nga balina ekibulamu ekyo kye baali babulwa, era ng’azibula amaaso g’omuntu eyazaalibwa nga muzibe, ataandikitegedde nti obutonde bw’abantu bwali bumufugirwa, era nti ye yali Omukozi wabwo era Omutonzi wabwo? Kubanga oyo eyawa omuntu ekyo kye yali tafunanga okuva lwe yazaalibwa, kyeyoleka bulungi nti, ateekwa okuba Mukama n’ow’okuzaalibwa kw’abantu okw’obutonde. 5. Noolwekyo, ne ku ntandikwa, bwe yali akka gye tuli, yeekolera omubiri gwe okuva mu Mbeerera, alyoke awe bonna obukakafu obutali butono obw’obwakatonda bwe, nti oyo eyabumba guno ye Mutonzi n’ow’ebintu ebirala byonna. Kubanga ani, bw’alaba omubiri nga guva mu Mbeerera yekka awatali musajja, ayinza okulemwa okutegeera nti oyo alabikira mu gwo ye Mutonzi era Mukama w’emibiri emirala? 6. Oba ani, bw’alaba amazzi nga gakyusibwa ne gafuuka omwenge, alemwa okutegeera nti oyo eyakola kino ye Mukama era Omutonzi w’amazzi gonna? Kubanga olw’ensonga eno yatambula ne ku nnyanja nga Mukama waayo, n’atambulirako ng’ali ku lukalu, okuwa abo abaakiraba obukakafu bw’obwami bwe ku bintu byonna. Era mu kuliisa ekibiina ekinene bwe kityo ku mmere ntono, n’okuleeta ye kennyini ekisukkiridde awataali kintu, ne kiba nti emigaati etaano gyakkusa abantu enkumi ttaano, ne bafikkawo bingi, yeeraga nga mulala ki, wabula Mukama yennyini alabirira ebintu byonna?

fields.title: Omuntu, obutonde bwe butaamukyusa, yalina okuyigirizibwa okumanya Katonda olw’obuntu obwo obutukuvu
fields.body_html:
§19. Omuntu, obutonde bwe butaamukyusa, yalina okuyigirizibwa okumanya Katonda olw’Obuntu obwo obutukuvu, obwakatonda bwabwo obutonde bwonna bwe bwayatula, okusingira ddala mu Kufa kwe.

Naye ebyo byonna kyalabika kirungi Omulokozi okubikola; okuva abantu bwe baali balemereddwa okumanya okulabirira kwe okwalagibwa mu bintu byonna, era nga balemereddwa okutegeera obwakatonda bwe obwalagibwa mu bitonde, waakiri okuva mu mirimu gy’omubiri gwe baddemu okulaba, era okuyita mu ye bafune ekirowoozo ku kumanya Kitaffe, nga bategeera, nga bwe nnasoose okugamba, okuva mu bintu ebitonotono okulabirira kwe ku byonna. 2. Kubanga ani eyalaba obuyinza bwe ku mizimu emibi, oba ani eyalaba emizimu emibi nga gyatula nti ye Mukama waagyo, aliddamu okubuusabuusa mu mutima gwe obanga ono ye Mwana era Magezi era Maanyi ga Katonda? 3. Kubanga yaleetera n’ebitonde okumenya obusirise: mu ekyo nti ne mu kufa kwe, eky’ekyewuunyo okwogera, oba okusingawo mu buwanguzi bwe bwennyini ku kufa—kwe kugamba Omusaalaba—ebitonde byonna byali byatula nti oyo eyalabisibwa n’abonaabona mu mubiri teyali muntu buntu, wabula Omwana wa Katonda era Omulokozi wa bonna. Kubanga enjuba yakweka amaaso gaayo, ensi n’ekankana, n’ensozi ne zaatika: abantu bonna ne bakwatibwa entiisa. Kaakano ebyo byalaga nti Kristo ku Musaalaba yali Katonda, so nga ebitonde byonna byali baddu be, era nga bijulira olw’okutya kwabyo okubeerawo kwa Mukama waabyo. Bw’atyo, kale, Katonda Kigambo yeeraga eri abantu olw’emirimu gye. Naye eddaala lyaffe eriddako liteekwa okunnyonnyola n’okwogera ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwe obw’omubiri n’olugendo lwe, era ku ngeri y’okufa kw’omubiri gwe; okusingira ddala kubanga kino kye kifundikwa ky’okukkiriza kwaffe, era abantu bonna awatali kwawula bakyogerako buli kiseera: olyoke omanye nti n’okuva mu kino Kristo amanyibwa nga Katonda era Omwana wa Katonda, n’obutakendeera n’akatono.

fields.title: Tewali n’omu eyali asobola okuwa obutavunda
fields.body_html:
§20. Kale tewali n’omu eyali asobola okuwa obutavunda, okuggyako oyo eyatonda; tewali n’omu kuzza buggya kifaananyi kya Katonda, okuggyako Ekifaananyi kye kyennyini; tewali n’omu kuwa bulamu, okuggyako Obulamu; tewali n’omu kuyigiriza, okuggyako Kigambo. Era ye, okusasula ebbanja lyaffe ery’okufa, yalina n’okutufiirira, n’azuukira ng’ebibala byaffe ebibereberye okuva mu ntaana. Noolwekyo Omubiri gwe gwalina okuba ogufa; naye ogwavunda, Omubiri gwe tegwayinza kuba.

Kale twogedde, mu kitundu, nga bwe kyasoboka, era nga ffe bwe twasobola okutegeera, ensonga y’okulabika kwe mu mubiri; nti tekyali mu buyinza bwa mulala yenna okufuula ekivunda obutavunda, okuggyako Omulokozi yennyini, eyatonda ebintu byonna okuva mu bwereere ku lubereberye; era nti tewali mulala yenna eyali asobola okutonda obuggya ekifaananyi kya Katonda mu bantu, okuggyako Ekifaananyi kya Kitaffe; era nti tewali mulala yenna eyali asobola okufuula ekifa obutafa, okuggyako Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, ye Bulamu bwennyini; era nti tewali mulala yenna eyali asobola okuyigiriza abantu ku Kitaffe, n’okuzikiriza okusinza ebifaananyi, okuggyako Kigambo, ateekateeka ebintu byonna, era ye yekka Omwana omu yekka ow’amazima owa Kitaffe. 2. Naye okuva bwe kyali kyetaagisa n’ebbanja eryali ku bonna okusasulwa: kubanga, nga bwe nnasoose okugamba, kyali kibagwanira bonna okufa, era olw’ensonga eyo ddala yajja mu ffe: olw’ekigendererwa ekyo, oluvannyuma lw’obukakafu bw’obwakatonda bwe okuva mu mirimu gye, ate n’awaayo ssaddaaka ye ku lwa bonna, ng’awaayo Yeekaalu ye eri okufa mu kifo kya bonna, okusooka okusumulula abantu n’okubafuula ab’eddembe okuva mu kusobya kwabwe okw’edda, era n’okweraga nti asinga n’okufa amaanyi, ng’alaga omubiri gwe ogutavunda, ng’ebibala ebibereberye eby’okuzuukira kwa bonna. 3. Era temwewuunya bwe tuddiŋŋana emirundi mingi ebigambo bye bimu ku nsonga y’emu. Kubanga okuva bwe twogera ku kuteesa kwa Katonda, kyetuva tunnyonnyola amakulu ge gamu mu ngeri ezisukka mu emu, tuleme kulabika nga tulekayo ekintu, ne tuvunaanibwa olw’okunnyonnyola okutamala: kubanga kirungi okugumiikiriza okunenyezebwa olw’okuddiŋŋana okusinga okulekayo ekintu kyonna ekyandibadde kiwandiikiddwa. 4. Kale omubiri, nga bwe gwagabana obutonde bwe bumu ne bonna, kubanga gwali mubiri gwa muntu, wadde nga olw’ekyamagero ekitaliiko kye kifaananako gwabumbibwa mu mbeerera yekka, naye olw’okuba gwali gufa, gwalina n’okufa, nga gufaanana ne bannaagwo. Naye olw’okugattibwa kwa Kigambo nagwo, tegwakyali wansi w’okuvunda ng’obutonde bwagwo bwe bwali, wabula olwa Kigambo eyali azze okubeera mu gwo gwateekebwa ewala okuvunda gye kutatuuka. 5. Bwe kityo ebyamagero bibiri ne bibaawo omulundi gumu, nti okufa kwa bonna kwatuukirizibwa mu mubiri gwa Mukama, era nti okufa n’okuvunda byaggibwawo ddala olwa Kigambo eyagattibwa nagwo. Kubanga waaliwo obwetaavu bw’okufa, era okufa kwali kuteekwa okubonaabonerwamu ku lwa bonna, ebbanja eryali ku bonna lisasulwe. 6. Kyeyava, nga bwe nnasoose okugamba, Kigambo, okuva bwe kyali nga tekisoboka gy’ali kufa, kubanga yali tafa, yeetwalira omubiri ogusobola okufa, alyoke aguweeyo ng’ogugwe mu kifo kya bonna, era ng’abonaabona, olw’okugattibwa kwe nagwo, ku lwa bonna, “azikirize oyo alina amaanyi ag’okufa, ye Setaani,” era “awe eddembe abo bonna abaali bamaze obulamu bwabwe bwonna mu buddu olw’entiisa y’okufa.”

fields.title: Okufa kwazikirizibwa olw’okufa kwa Kristo
fields.body_html:
§21. Okufa kwazikirizibwa olw’okufa kwa Kristo. Kale lwaki Kristo teyafiira mu kyama, oba mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa okusingawo? Teyali wansi wa kufa okw’obutonde, wabula yalina okufiira mu mikono gy’abalala. Kale lwaki yafa? Nedda, wabula olw’ekigendererwa ekyo kyennyini kye yajjira, era singa si ekyo, teyandisobodde kuzuukira.

Kale, kaakano ng’Omulokozi wa bonna afudde ku lwaffe, ffe abakkiriza mu Kristo tetukyafa kufa nga bwe kyali edda, ng’okulabula kw’amateeka bwe kwali; kubanga omusango ogwo gukomye; wabula, okuvunda bwe kukoma ne kuggibwawo olw’ekisa ky’Okuzuukira, okuva kaakano tuvunduka buvunduki, ng’obutonde obufa obw’emibiri gyaffe bwe buli, mu kiseera Katonda ky’ateekedde buli muntu, tulyoke tusobole okufuna okuzuukira okusingako obulungi. 2. Kubanga ng’ensigo ezisuulibwa mu ttaka, tetuzikirira olw’okuvunduka, wabula, nga tusigiddwa mu ttaka, tulizuukira, okufa nga kuzikiriziddwa olw’ekisa ky’Omulokozi. Kyekiva Pawulo ow’omukisa, eyafuulibwa omukakasa w’Okuzuukira eri bonna, agamba nti: “Kubanga omubiri guno oguvunda gwa kufuuka ogutavunda, era omubiri guno ogufa gwa kufuuka ogutafa. Omubiri guno oguvunda bwe gulifuuka ogutavunda, ogufa ne gufuuka ogutafa, olwo Ekyawandiikibwa ne kiryoka kituukirira ekigamba nti, Okufa kuwanguddwa. Ggwe kufa, obuwanguzi bwo buluwa? Ggwe kufa, amaanyi go agalumya galuwa?” 3. Kale, omuntu ayinza okugamba nti, singa kyali kyetaagisa gy’ali okuwaayo omubiri gwe eri okufa mu kifo kya bonna, lwaki teyagwesuulako ng’omuntu mu kyama, mu kifo ky’okutuuka n’okukomererwa? Kubanga kyandibadde kisinga okumugwanira okwesuulako omubiri gwe mu kitiibwa, okusinga okugumiikiriza okufa ng’okwo mu buswavu. 4. Kaakano, nziramu nti, mwetegereze obanga ensonga eyo si ya buntu bwokka, so nga Omulokozi kye yakola kya bwakatonda ddala era, olw’ensonga nnyingi, kisaanira obwakatonda bwe. Okusooka, kubanga okufa okutuuka ku bantu kubatuukako nga bwe kukwatagana n’obunafu bw’obutonde bwabwe; kubanga, nga tebasobola kubeerera mu mbeera emu, bavunduka mu biseera. Kyekiva n’endwadde zibakwata, ne balwala ne bafa. Naye Mukama si munafu, wabula ye Maanyi ga Katonda era Kigambo kya Katonda era Bulamu bwennyini. 5. Kale, singa yali yeesuddeko omubiri gwe awantu mu kyama, ku kitanda, ng’abantu bwe bakola, kyandirowoozeddwa nti naye yakikola olw’obunafu bw’obutonde bwe, era kubanga mu ye temwali kisingawo ku kiri mu bantu abalala. Naye okuva bwe yali, okusooka, Obulamu era Kigambo kya Katonda, era nga kyali kyetaagisa, ekyokubiri, okufa ku lwa bonna okutuukirizibwa, olw’ensonga eno, ku ludda olumu, kubanga ye yali obulamu n’amaanyi, omubiri gwafuna amaanyi mu ye; 6. so nga ku ludda olulala, okuva okufa bwe kwali kuteekwa okubaawo, teyakwetwalira yekka, wabula yakufuna okuva mu mikono gy’abalala; omukisa ogw’okutuukiriza ssaddaaka ye. Kubanga tekyali kisaanira, era, Mukama okulwala, oyo eyawonya endwadde z’abalala; era tekyali kituufu omubiri ogwo okuggwaamu amaanyi, omwo mw’ayita okuwa amaanyi n’abalala abanafu. 7. Kale lwaki teyaziyiza kufa, nga bwe yaziyiza obulwadde? Kubanga olw’ekyo kye yalina omubiri, era tekyali kisaanira kukuziyiza, Okuzuukira kuleme kulemesebwa, so nga n’obulwadde nabwo tekyali kisaanira kusooka kufa kwe, kireme kulowoozebwa nti bunafu ku ludda lw’oyo eyali mu mubiri. Kale teyalumwa njala? Yee; yalumwa enjala, nga bwe kikwatagana n’engeri z’omubiri gwe. Naye teyafa njala, olwa Mukama eyali agwambadde. Kyekiva, ne bwe yafa okununula bonna, naye omubiri gwe tegwavunda.. Kubanga [omubiri gwe] gwazuukira nga mulamba ddala, kubanga omubiri gwali gwa Bulamu bwennyini so si gwa mulala.

fields.title: Naye lwaki teyakuuma mubiri gwe obutagwa mu mikono gy’Abayudaaya
fields.body_html:
§22. Naye lwaki teyakuuma mubiri gwe obutagwa mu mikono gy’Abayudaaya, bw’atyo n’akuuma obutafa bwagwo? (1) Kyali kimugwanira obuteereetako kufa ye kennyini, naye era n’obutakwewala. (2) Yajja okufuna okufa okwali kugwanidde abalala, n’olwekyo kwalina okumutuukako okuva ebweru. (3) Okufa kwe kwalina okuba okukakafu, okukakasa amazima g’Okuzuukira kwe. Era, teyayinza kufa olw’obunafu, aleme okusekererwa mu kuwonya kwe abalala.

Naye kyandibadde kirungi, omuntu ayinza okugamba, okwekweka enkwe z’Abayudaaya, alyoke akuume omubiri gwe obutafa n’akatono. Kale omuntu ng’oyo abuulirwe nti kino nakyo tekyali kisaanira Mukama. Kubanga nga bwe kitaali kisaanira Kigambo kya Katonda, ng’ye Bulamu, okuleeta okufa ku mubiri gwe ye kennyini, bw’atyo era tekyali kituufu kudduka kufa okwaleetebwa abalala, wabula okukugoberera okutuusa okukuzikiriza, era olw’ensonga eyo, mu ngeri ey’obutonde, teyesuulako mubiri gwe ku bubwe, era teyadduka Bayudaaya bwe baamusalira enkwe. 2. Naye kino tekyalaga bunafu ku ludda lwa Kigambo, wabula, okwawukana ku ekyo, kyamulaga nga Mulokozi era Bulamu; mu ekyo nti yalindirira okufa alyoke akuzikirize, era n’ayanguwa okutuukiriza okufa okwamuweebwa olw’obulokozi bwa bonna. 3. Era ekirala, Omulokozi yajja kutuukiriza si kufa kwe ye, wabula okufa kw’abantu; kyeyava n’atesuulako mubiri gwe olw’okufa okwe ku bubwe—kubanga ye yali Bulamu era nga talina kufa—wabula yafuna okufa okwava eri abantu, alyoke akuggirewo ddala bwe kwamusisinkana mu mubiri gwe ye. 4. Nate, n’okuva mu bino wammanga omuntu ayinza okulaba amagezi agaali mu mubiri gwa Mukama okutuuka ku nkomerero eno. Mukama yali afaayo nnyo ku kuzuukira kw’omubiri kwe yali agenda okutuukiriza. Kubanga kye yali agenda okukola kwe kukulaga ng’ekijjukizo ky’obuwanguzi ku kufa, n’okukakasa bonna nti yali amazeewo okuvunda, era nti emibiri gyabwe tegirivunda okuva olwo; era ng’omusingo gw’ekyo n’obukakafu bw’okuzuukira okutegekeddwa bonna, yakuuma omubiri gwe nga teguvunze. 5. Kale, nate, singa omubiri gwe gwalwala, Kigambo n’ayawukana nagwo mu maaso ga bonna, kyandibadde tekisaana oyo eyawonya endwadde z’abalala okuleka ekikozesebwa kye ye okuggwaawo olw’obulwadde. Kubanga okugoba kwe endwadde z’abalala kwandikkiririziddwa kutya singa yeekaalu ye ye yalwala mu ye? Kubanga oba yandisekereddwa nga talina busobozi kugoba ndwadde, oba singa yali asobola, naye n’atakikola, yandirowoozeddwa okuba nga tafaayo ku balala nabo.

fields.title: Kyali kyetaagisa okufa mu lwatu olw’enjigiriza y’Okuzuukira
fields.body_html:
§23. Kyali kyetaagisa okufa mu lwatu olw’enjigiriza y’Okuzuukira.

Naye ne singa, awatali bulwadde bwonna era awatali bulumi bwonna, yali akwese omubiri gwe mu kyama era yekka “mu nkiso!,” oba mu ddungu, oba mu nnyumba, oba wonna wonna, n’oluvannyuma n’alabika mangu ago n’agamba nti yali azuukiziddwa mu bafu, yandirabise eri bonna ng’ayogera bufere, era by’ayogera ku Kuzuukira byandisinzeeko okubuusibwabuusibwa, kubanga tewaaliwo n’omu ddala ow’okujulira okufa kwe. Kaakano, okufa kuteekwa okusooka okuzuukira, kubanga tekwandibadde kuzuukira singa okufa tekwasooka; kale singa okufa kw’omubiri gwe kwabaawo wonna mu kyama, okufa nga tekulabikira ddala era nga tekubaddewo mu maaso ga bajulirwa, n’Okuzuukira kwe kwandibadde kukwekeddwa era nga tekuliiko bukakafu. 2. Oba lwaki, so nga bwe yazuukira yalangirira Okuzuukira, yandisazeewo okufa kwe kubeere mu kyama? Oba lwaki, so nga yagoba emizimu emibi mu maaso ga bonna, n’azibula omuntu eyazaalibwa nga muzibe, n’akyusa amazzi ne gafuuka omwenge, alyoke akkirizibwe olw’ebyo nti ye Kigambo kya Katonda, teyandiraze butonde bwe obufa nga butavunda mu maaso ga bonna, alyoke akkirizibwe nti ye yennyini ye Bulamu? 3. Oba abayigirizwa be bandifunye batya obuvumu okwogera ku Kuzuukira, singa tebaali basobola kugamba nti yasooka kufa? Oba bandikkiriziddwa batya, nga bagamba nti okufa kwasooka okubaawo ate oluvannyuma Okuzuukira, singa tebaalina ng’abajulirwa b’okufa kwe abantu be baali boogera nabo n’obuvumu? Kubanga singa, ne nga bwe kyali, okufa kwe n’Okuzuukira bwe byabaawo mu maaso ga bonna, Abafalisaayo ab’omu kiseera ekyo baagaana okukkiriza, ne bawaliriza n’abo abaali balabye Okuzuukira okukwegaana, kale, ddala, singa ebyo byali bibaddewo mu kyama, nsonga mmeka ez’obutakkiriza ze bandiyiiyizza? 4. Oba enkomerero y’okufa, n’obuwanguzi ku kwo byandikakasiddwa bitya, singa teyakuyita mu maaso ga bonna n’akulaga nga kufudde, nga kuggiddwawo okuva olwo olw’obutavunda bw’omubiri gwe?

fields.title: Ebibuuzo ebirala biddibwamu nga bukyali
fields.body_html:
§24. Ebibuuzo ebirala biddibwamu nga bukyali. Teyeerondera ngeri ya kufa kwe; kubanga yalina okulagibwa nga Muwanguzi w’okufa mu ngeri zaakwo zonna oba mu ngeri yonna: (ekyokulabirako ky’omumeggi omulungi). Okufa okwalondebwa okumuswaza kwafuuka Ekijjukizo ky’obuwanguzi ku kufa: era kwakuuma omubiri gwe nga tegwawulwamu.

Naye ebyo abalala bye bandiyinzizza okwogera, tuteekwa okubyanukula nga bukyali. Kubanga oboolyawo omuntu ayinza okugamba bw’ati: Singa kyali kyetaagisa okufa kwe okubaawo mu maaso ga bonna, era n’abajulirwa, olugero lw’Okuzuukira kwe nalwo lulyoke lukkirizibwe, kyandibadde kirungi waakiri yeerondere okufa okw’ekitiibwa, waakiri yewale obuswavu bw’Omusaalaba. 2. Naye singa yakola n’ekyo, yandiwadde ensonga ey’okumuteebereza nti teyalina maanyi ku buli kufa, wabula ku kufa kwe yeerondera kwokka; era bwe kityo nate wandibaddewo ensonga ey’obutakkiriza ku Kuzuukira nga bwe kyandibadde. Bwe kityo okufa kwatuuka ku mubiri gwe, si okuva gy’ali ye, wabula okuva mu nteekateeka z’abalabe, okufa kwonna kwe bandiwadde Omulokozi, akuggirewo ddala. 3. Era ng’omumeggi ow’ekitiibwa, omukugu ennyo era omuzira, bw’atalondamu yekka abo b’agenda okumeggana nabo, aleme kuleetera bantu kuteebereza nti atya abamu ku bo, wabula akirekera abalabi okulonda, naddala bwe baba abalabe be, alyoke amegge oyo yenna gwe bamuteeka mu maaso, era akkirizibwe nti abasinga bonna; bw’atyo n’Obulamu bwa bonna, Mukama waffe era Omulokozi, Kristo yennyini, teyeerondera kufa olw’omubiri gwe, aleme kulabika ng’atya okufa okulala; wabula yakkiriza ku Musaalaba, n’agumiikiriza, okufa okwaleetebwa abalala, era okusingira ddala abalabe be, kwe baalowooza nti kwa ntiisa era kwa buswavu era tekugumiikirizika; bwe kityo n’okwo nga kuzikiriziddwa, ye yennyini akkirizibwe nti ye Bulamu, era n’amaanyi g’okufa gazikirizibwe ddala. 4. Bwe kityo ekintu eky’ekyewuunyo era ekisisimula kibaddewo; kubanga okufa, kwe baalowooza okuleeta ng’obuswavu, ddala kwafuuka ekijjukizo ky’obuwanguzi ku kufa kwennyini. Kyeyava teyafa ng’okufa kwa Yokaana, ng’atemwako omutwe, era, nga Isaaya, teyasalibwamu bitundu n’omusumeeno; alyoke ne mu kufa akuume omubiri gwe nga tegwawulwamu era nga mulamba ddala, era waleme kubaawo nsonga eweebwa abo abandyagadde okwawulamu Ekkanisa.

fields.title: Lwaki Omusaalaba, mu ngeri zonna ez’okufa?
fields.body_html:
§25. Lwaki Omusaalaba, mu ngeri zonna ez’okufa? (1) Yalina okwetikka ekikolimo ku lwaffe. (2) Ku gwo yagolola emikono gye okugatta bonna, Abayudaaya n’Abaamawanga, mu ye. (3) Yawangula “omukulu w’obuyinza obw’omu bbanga, omwoyo ogwa Setaani, ogufuga abajeemu bonna.” mu kitundu kye ye, ng’alongoosa ekkubo erigenda mu ggulu era ng’atuggulirawo enzigi ez’edda.

Bwe tutyo bwe tuddamu abo ab’ebweru abeetuumira empaka. Naye singa abamu ku bantu baffe nabo babuuza, si lwa kwagala mpaka, wabula lwa kwagala kuyiga, lwaki yabonaabona okufa mu ngeri endala yonna okuggyako ku Musaalaba, naye abuulirwe nti tewaali ngeri ndala okuggyako eno eyali ennungi gye tuli, era nti kyali kirungi Mukama okubonaabona kino ku lwaffe. 2. Kubanga singa yajja ye kennyini okwetikka ekikolimo ekyatuteekebwako, yandisobodde atya okuba nti “yafuuka ekikolimo ku lwaffe, kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti, “Akolimiddwa buli awanikiddwa ku muti.”,” singa teyafuna kufa okwateekebwawo olw’ekikolimo? era ogwo gwe Musaalaba. Kubanga kino kye kyawandiikibwa ddala nti: “Akolimiddwa buli awanikiddwa ku muti.” 3. Nate, singa okufa kwa Mukama kwe kununula kwa bonna, era olw’okufa kwe “ekisenge ekya wakati eky’obulabe” kimenyeddwa, era okuyitibwa kw’amawanga ne kutuukirizibwa, yandituyise atya gy’ali, singa teyakomererwa? Kubanga ku musaalaba kwokka omuntu w’afiira ng’emikono gye egoloddwa. Kyekyava kisaanira Mukama okugumiikiriza n’ekyo n’okugolola emikono gye, n’omukono ogumu awalule abantu ab’edda, n’omulala abo abava mu Baamawanga, n’abagatta bombi mu ye. 4. Kubanga kino kye yayogera ye kennyini, ng’alaga okufa okw’engeri ki kwe yali agenda okununuliramu bonna: “Bwe ndiwanikibwa okuva mu nsi, ndiwalulira bonna gye ndi.”,” bw’agamba, “ndiwalulira bonna gye ndi.” 5. Era nate, singa Setaani, omulabe w’ekika kyaffe, bwe yagwa okuva mu ggulu, abungeetera mu bbanga lyaffe erya wansi, era eyo ng’afuga emyoyo banne, nga bannaabwe mu bujeemu, takoma ku kukola bya bulimba okuyita mu yo mu abo abalimbibwa, wabula agezaako n’okuziyiza abo abalinnya (era ku kino Omutume agamba nti: “omukulu w’obuyinza obw’omu bbanga, omwoyo ogwa Setaani, ogufuga abajeemu bonna”); so nga Mukama yajja okusuula wansi Setaani, n’okulongoosa ebbanga n’okututegekera ekkubo okulinnya mu ggulu, ng’Omutume bwe yagamba nti: “eriyita mu lutimbe, gwe mubiri gwe”—era kino kyali kiteekwa okuba mu kufa—kale, kufa kwa ngeri ki endala kwe kyandiyinzizza okubaawo, okuggyako okwo okwabeerawo mu bbanga, kwe kugamba omusaalaba? kubanga oyo yekka atuukirizibwa ku musaalaba y’afiira mu bbanga. Kyekyava kyali kisaanira ddala Mukama okubonaabona okufa kuno. 6. Kubanga bwe yawanikibwa bw’atyo yalongoosa ebbanga okuva mu bubi bwa Setaani ne bwa dayimooni ez’engeri zonna, nga bw’agamba nti: “Nalaba Setaani ng’agwa okuva mu ggulu ng’okumyansa kw’eraddu;” n’aggulawo ekkubo eriggya okulinnya mu ggulu nga bw’agamba nate nti: “Mweggulewo, mmwe bawankaaki! Muggulwewo, mmwe enzigi ez’edda.” Kubanga si Kigambo yennyini eyali yeetaaga okuggulirwawo enzigi, ng’ye Mukama wa bonna; era tewaali na kimu ku mirimu gye ekyali kiggaliddwa eri Omutonzi waakyo; wabula ffe twali tukyetaaga, ffe be yasitula waggulu olw’omubiri gwe. Kubanga nga bwe yaguwaayo eri okufa ku lwa bonna, bw’atyo olw’ogwo yaddamu n’ategeka ekkubo eririnnya mu ggulu.

fields.title: Ensonga lwaki yazuukira ku Lunaku Olwokusatu
fields.body_html:
§26. Ensonga lwaki yazuukira ku Lunaku Olwokusatu. (1) Si mangu, kubanga awo okufa kwe okwa ddala kwandiwakanyiziddwa, era (2) si luvannyuma; (a) okukuuma nti omubiri gwe gwe gumu, (b) obutalwisa bayigirizwa be nga babuusabuusa, era (c) obutalinda bajulirwa b’okufa kwe kusaasaana, oba okujjukira kwakwo kuggwaawo.

Kale okufa ku Musaalaba ku lwaffe kulabise nga kusaanidde era nga kugwanidde, n’ensonga yaakwo eraze nga ya magezi mu buli ngeri; era kiyinza okugambibwa mu butuufu nti tewaali ngeri ndala okuggyako Omusaalaba obulokozi bwa bonna mwe bwali bugwanidde okubeerawo. Kubanga ne mu ngeri eno—ne ku Musaalaba—teyeekweka; wabula, okwawukana ennyo ku ekyo, bwe yali aleetera ebitonde okujulira okubeerawo kw’Omutonzi waabyo, teyaleka yeekaalu ey’omubiri gwe okumala ebbanga ddene, wabula bwe yamala okugulaga nti gufudde, olw’okufa okukwatagana nagwo, amangu ago n’aguzuukiza ku lunaku olwokusatu, ng’atwala, ng’akabonero k’obuwanguzi n’omujaguzo ku kufa, obutavunda n’obutabonaabona ebyava ku mubiri gwe. 2. Kubanga yali asobola, ne mangu ddala nga yaakafa, okuzuukiza omubiri gwe n’agulaga nga mulamu; naye kino nakyo Omulokozi, mu kulengera ewala okw’amagezi, teyakikola. Kubanga omuntu yandigambye nti teyafa n’akatono, oba nti okufa tekwamukwatako ddala, singa yalaga Okuzuukira amangu ago. 3. Oboolyawo, nate, singa ebbanga wakati w’okufa kwe n’okuzuukira kwe lyali lya nnaku bbiri zokka, ekitiibwa ky’obutavunda bwe kyandibadde tekyeyoleka bulungi. Kale omubiri gulyoke gukakasibwe nti gwali gufudde, Kigambo yalindako olunaku lumu olwa wakati, era ku lwokusatu n’agulaga bonna nga gutavunda. 4. Kale, okufa ku Musaalaba kulyoke kukakasibwe, yazuukiza omubiri gwe ku lunaku olwokusatu. 5.
