Naye aleme okubuusibwabuusibwa, singa yaguzuukiza nga gumaze ebbanga ddene era nga guvunze ddala, ng’alinga eyaguwaanyisa n’omubiri omulala—kubanga omuntu era yandiyinzizza, olw’ebbanga eriyiseewo, obutakkiriza ky’alaba, n’okwerabira ebyabaawo—olw’ensonga eno teyalinda kusukka nnaku ssatu; era teyalwisa nga babuusabuusa abo be yali abuulidde ku Kuzuukira: 6. wabula ekigambo bwe kyali kikyavuga mu matu gaabwe, n’amaaso gaabwe nga gakyalindirira, n’amagezi gaabwe nga gakyabuusabuusa, era abo abaamutta nga bakyali balamu ku nsi, era nga bali mu kifo ekyo era nga basobola okujulira okufa kw’omubiri gwa Mukama, Omwana wa Katonda yennyini, oluvannyuma lw’ebbanga ery’ennaku ssatu, yalaga omubiri gwe, ogwali gufudde, nga gwa butafa era gwa butavunda; era kyalabikira bonna nti omubiri tegwafa olw’obunafu bwonna obw’obutonde bwa Kigambo eyali abeera mu gwo, wabula mu gwo okufa kulyoke kuggibwewo olw’amaanyi g’Omulokozi.

fields.title: Enkyukakyuka Omusaalaba gwe gwaleeta mu nkolagana y’Okufa n’Omuntu
fields.body_html:
§27. Enkyukakyuka Omusaalaba gwe gwaleeta mu nkolagana y’Okufa n’Omuntu.

Kubanga nti okufa kuzikiriziddwa, era nti Omusaalaba gufuuse obuwanguzi ku kwo, era nti tekukyalina maanyi wabula kufudde ddala, kino si bukakafu butono, oba wabula bujulizi bweyolefu, nti abayigirizwa ba Kristo bonna bakunyooma, era nti bonna bakulumba so tebakyakutya; wabula olw’akabonero k’Omusaalaba n’olw’okukkiriza mu Kristo bakulinnyirira ng’ekifu. 2. Kubanga edda, okujja kw’Omulokozi okw’obwakatonda nga tekunnabaawo, okufa kwali kwa ntiisa ne eri abatukuvu, era bonna baakaabiranga abafu ng’abazikiridde. Naye kaakano Omulokozi bw’amaze okuzuukiza omubiri gwe, okufa tekukyali kwa ntiisa; kubanga bonna abakkiriza Kristo bakulinnyirira ng’ekitali kintu, era basinga kwagala kufa okusinga okwegaana okukkiriza kwabwe mu Kristo. Kubanga bamanyi ddala nti bwe bafa tebazikirira, wabula mu butuufu [batandika] okuba abalamu, era bafuuka abatavunda olw’Okuzuukira. 3. Era Setaani oyo eyali yeeyagalira mu kufa n’ettima, kaakano obulumi bwakwo bwe bwasumululwa, ye yekka eyasigala ng’afudde ddala. Era obukakafu bw’ekyo kye kino: abantu nga tebannakkiriza Kristo, okufa bakulaba ng’ekintu eky’entiisa, era bakutya ng’abatiitiizi. Naye bwe bamala okukyukira mu kukkiriza ne mu kuyigiriza kwa Kristo, okufa bakunyooma nnyo ne kiba nti bakwanguyirira n’obunyiikivu, ne bafuuka abajulirwa b’Okuzuukira Omulokozi kwe yatuukiriza ku kwo. Kubanga nga bakyali bato mu myaka banguwa okufa, era si basajja bokka, naye n’abakazi beetendeka okukulwanyisa nga beefuga mu mubiri. Okufa kunafuye nnyo ne kiba nti n’abakazi abaalimbibwanga kwo edda, kaakano bakusekerera ng’ekifu era ekisannyalade. 4. Kubanga nga omufuzi omukambwe bw’awangulwa kabaka owa nnamaddala, n’asibibwa emikono n’ebigere, olwo bonna abayitawo ne bamusekerera, nga bamukuba empi era nga bamuvuma, nga tebakyatya busungu bwe n’obukambwe bwe, olwa kabaka oyo amuwangudde; bwe kityo, okufa bwe kwawangulwa Omulokozi ku Musaalaba ne kuswazibwa, ne kusibibwa emikono n’ebigere, bonna abali mu Kristo, nga bayitawo, bakulinnyirira, era nga bajulira Kristo bakusekerera, nga bakuduulira, era nga boogera ekyo ekyawandiikibwa edda ku kwo: “Ggwe kufa, obuwanguzi bwo buluwa? Ggwe kufa, amaanyi go agalumya galuwa?”

fields.title: Ekyewuunyo kino kiteekwa okugezesebwa mu bumanyirivu
fields.body_html:
§28. Ekyewuunyo kino kiteekwa okugezesebwa mu bumanyirivu. Abo abakibuusabuusa bafuuke Abakristaayo.

Kale kino bukakafu butono obw’obunafu bw’okufa? oba kirango kitono eky’obuwanguzi Omulokozi bwe yakutuukako, abavubuka n’abawala abato abali mu Kristo bwe banyooma obulamu buno ne beegezaamu okufa? 2. Kubanga omuntu mu buzaaliranwa atya okufa n’okusaanawo kw’omubiri; naye waliwo kino ekisinga okwewuunyisa: oyo eyambadde okukkiriza kw’Omusaalaba anyooma n’ekyo ekitiisa mu buzaaliranwa, era ku lwa Kristo tatya kufa. 3. Era nga bwe kiri nti omuliro gulina obuzaaliranwa obw’okwokya, singa omuntu agamba nti waliwo ekintu ekitatya kwokya kwagwo, wabula ekyo kye kiraga nti gwe munafu — nga asibesitosi ow’omu Buyindi bw’agambibwa okukola — olwo oyo atakkiriza lugero olwo, bw’aba ayagala okulugezesa, mu ngeri yonna, bw’amala okwambala ekintu ekyo ekitayokebwa n’akwata ku muliro, amangu ago akakasa obunafu obwogerwako ku muliro: 4. oba singa omuntu yenna ayagala okulaba omufuzi omukambwe ng’asibiddwa, mu ngeri yonna bw’agenda mu nsi ne mu bwakabaka bw’oyo eyamuwangula, ayinza okulaba omusajja oyo, eyali entiisa eri abalala, ng’afuuliddwa omunafu; bwe kityo omuntu bw’aba akyali mukakanyavu mu butakkiriza ne bwe wabaddewo obukakafu bungi bwe butyo, era ne bwe wabaddewo abangi bwe batyo abafuuse abajulizi mu Kristo, era ne bwe wabaddewo okunyooma okufa okulagibwa buli lunaku abo abaatiikirivu mu Kristo, era singa endowooza ye ekyabuusabuusa obanga okufa kwafuulibwa obwereere ne kukoma, akola bulungi okwewuunya ekintu ekinene bwe kityo, kyokka aleme kuguguba mu butakkiriza, wadde okukakanyala mu maaso g’ekyo ekyeyoleka bwe kityo. 5. Naye nga oyo alina asibesitosi bw’amanya nti omuliro tegulina maanyi ga kukyokya, era nga oyo ayagala okulaba omufuzi omukambwe ng’asibiddwa bw’agenda mu bwakabaka bw’oyo eyamuwangula, bwe kityo n’oyo atakkiriza buwanguzi ku kufa akkirize okukkiriza kwa Kristo, ayingire mu kuyigiriza kwe, era aliraba obunafu bw’okufa n’obuwanguzi ku kwo. Kubanga bangi abaali abatakkiriza era abasekerezi edda, oluvannyuma baakkiriza, ne banyooma okufa ne batuuka n’okufuuka abajulizi ku lwa Kristo yennyini.

fields.title: Wano waliwo ebivaamu eby’ekitalo
fields.body_html:
§29. Wano waliwo ebivaamu eby’ekitalo, n’ensibuko emala okubinnyonnyola, Omusaalaba, nga enjuba okuvaayo bwe kinnyonnyola omusana gw’emisana.

Kale obanga olw’akabonero k’Omusaalaba n’olw’okukkiriza mu Kristo okufa kulinnyiriddwa, kiteekwa okweyoleka mu maaso g’entebe y’amazima nti tewali mulala wabula Kristo yennyini eyalaga ebijjukizo by’obuwanguzi n’ebijaguzo ku kufa, n’akuggyako amaanyi gaakwo gonna. 2. Era obanga edda okufa kwali kwa maanyi, era olw’ensonga eyo nga kwa ntiisa, naye kaakano oluvannyuma lw’okujja kw’Omulokozi n’okufa n’Okuzuukira kw’omubiri gwe kunyoomebwa, kiteekwa okweyoleka nti okufa kwafuulibwa obwereere ne kuwangulwa Kristo yennyini eyalinnya ku Musaalaba. 3. Kubanga nga, oluvannyuma lw’ekiro, enjuba bw’evaayo, ensi yonna n’etangazibwa yo, tekiri kya kubuusabuusa nti enjuba ye yabunyisa ekitangaala kyayo wonna, era ye yagoba ekizikiza n’ewa ebintu byonna ekitangaala; bwe kityo, kaakano okufa bwe kunyoomebwa ne kulinnyirirwa wansi w’ebigere, okuva Omulokozi lwe yeeyoleka mu mubiri okw’obulokozi n’okufa kwe ku Musaalaba ne bibaawo, kiteekwa okweyoleka ddala nti Omulokozi yennyini eyalabikira mu mubiri, ye yafuula okufa obwereere, era ye alaga obubonero bw’obuwanguzi ku kwo buli lunaku mu bayigirizwa be. 4. Kubanga omuntu bw’alaba abantu, abanafu mu buzaaliranwa, nga babuukira okufa, nga tebatya kuvunda kwakwo wadde okukka mu Magombe, wabula n’emmeeme enyiikivu nga bakusoomooza; era nga tebeekandagga olw’okubonyaabonyezebwa, wabula, ku lwa Kristo, nga balonda okwanguyirira okufa okusinga obulamu ku nsi, oba omuntu bw’alaba n’amaaso ge abasajja n’abakazi n’abaana abato nga banguyirira okufa ne bakubuukira olw’eddiini ya Kristo; ani omusirusiru bw’atyo, oba ani atakkiriza bw’atyo, oba ani alemaye mu birowoozo bw’atyo, n’atalaba n’ategeera nti Kristo, abantu gwe bajulira, ye yennyini awa buli omu obuwanguzi ku kufa, ng’akuggyako amaanyi gaakwo gonna mu buli omu ku abo abakwata okukkiriza kwe era abalina akabonero k’Omusaalaba. 5. Kubanga oyo alaba omusota nga gulinnyiriddwa wansi w’ebigere, naddala ng’amanyi obukambwe bwagwo obw’edda, takyabuusabuusa nti gufudde era nti amaanyi gaagwo gaggweerawo ddala, okuggyako ng’alina endowooza enkyamu era nga n’ebiwulizi by’omubiri gwe tebiri bulungi. Kubanga ani alaba empologoma ng’abaana bagizannyisa, n’atalaba nti oba efudde oba amaanyi gaayo gonna gaggwaawo? 6. Kale nga bwe kisoboka okulaba n’amaaso amazima g’ebyo byonna, bwe kityo, kaakano okufa bwe kuzannyirirwa ne kunyoomebwa abakkiriza mu Kristo, omuntu yenna aleme kuddamu kubuusabuusa, wadde okuba atakkiriza, nti okufa kwafuulibwa obwereere Kristo, era nti okuvunda kw’okufa kwazikirizibwa ne kukomezebwa.

fields.title: Amazima g’okuzuukira gakakasibwa n’ebikolwa
fields.body_html:
§30. Amazima g’okuzuukira gakakasibwa n’ebikolwa: (1) obuwanguzi ku kufa obwogeddwako waggulu: (2) Ebyewuunyo by’Ekisa mulimu gw’Oyo Omulamu, gw’Oyo ali Katonda: (3) obanga bakatonda (nga bwe kigambibwa) ba ddala era balamu, kale n’okusingawo Oyo amenyaamenya amaanyi gaabwe mulamu.

Kale bye tumaze okwogera si bukakafu butono nti okufa kwafuulibwa obwereere, era nti Omusaalaba gwa Mukama ke kabonero k’obuwanguzi ku kwo. Naye ku Kuzuukira kw’omubiri okutuuka ku butafa Kristo kwe yatuukiriza oluvannyuma, ye Mulokozi wa bonna era Obulamu obwa nnamaddala obwa bonna, obukakafu obw’ebikolwa bweyoleka okusinga ebigambo eri abo abalina amaaso g’amagezi amalamu. 2. Kubanga obanga, ng’ensonga zaffe bwe zaalaga, okufa kwafuulibwa obwereere, era olwa Kristo bonna bakulinnyirira, kale n’okusingawo ye yennyini ye yasooka okukulinnyirira n’omubiri gwe, n’akufuula obwereere. Naye bwe kiba nti okufa kwattibwa ye, kiki ekyandibaddewo okuggyako omubiri gwe okuzuukira, n’okulagibwa ng’ekijjukizo ky’obuwanguzi ku kufa? oba okufa kwandiraze kutya nti kwafuulibwa obwereere singa omubiri gwa Mukama tegwazuukira? Naye obanga obukakafu buno obw’Okuzuukira bulabika ng’obutamala eri omuntu yenna, akakasibwe ebyogerwa ne mu ebyo ebibaawo mu maaso ge. 3. Kubanga omuntu bw’afa taba na maanyi ga kukola kintu, wabula obuyinza bwe bukoma ku ntaana ne buggwaawo okuva olwo; era ebikolwa n’obuyinza ku bantu by’abalamu bokka; buli ayagala, alabe era asale omusango, ng’ayatula amazima okuva mu ebyo ebirabika. 4. Kubanga kaakano Omulokozi bw’akola ebintu ebinene bwe bityo mu bantu, era buli lunaku mu ngeri etalabika asendasenda ekibiina ekinene bwe kityo okuva ku njuyi zonna, mu abo ababeera mu Buyonaani ne mu nsi endala, okujja mu kukkiriza kwe, era bonna okugondera okuyigiriza kwe, waliwo omuntu yenna akyabuusabuusa obanga Omulokozi yatuukiriza Okuzuukira, era obanga Kristo mulamu, oba wabula ye yennyini bwe Bulamu? 5. Oba kiri kya mufu okufumita emitima gy’abantu, ne beegaana amateeka ga bajjajjaabwe ne bavunnamira okuyigiriza kwa Kristo? Oba, singa takyakola (kubanga kino kye ky’omufu), ayinza atya okuziyiza okukola kw’abo abakola era abalamu, omwenzi n’atakyayenda, n’omutemu n’atakyatta, n’omukozi w’ebibi n’atakyali mululu, n’atatya Katonda n’afuuka atya Katonda okuva olwo? Oba, singa tazuukidde wabula afudde, agoba atya, n’ayigganya, n’asuula wansi bakatonda abo ab’obulimba abatakkiriza be bagamba nti balamu, ne dayimooni ze basinza? 6. Kubanga Kristo w’ayatulirwa, n’okukkiriza kwe, eyo okusinza ebifaananyi kwonna kumaamulwa, n’obulimba bwonna obw’emyoyo emibi bubikkulwa, era tewali mwoyo gusobola kugumira na linnya lye, wabula ne bwe guliwulira obuwulizi gudduka ne gubula. Naye omulimu guno si gwa mufu, wabula gwa oyo omulamu — era naddala gwa Katonda. 7. Okusingira ddala, kyandibadde kya kusekererwa okugamba nti emyoyo gye yagoba n’ebifaananyi bye yafuula obwereere biramu, naye ye abigoba, era olw’amaanyi ge n’abiziyiza n’okulabika, weewaawo, era bonna gwe bayatula okuba Omwana wa Katonda, nti afudde.

fields.title: Obanga Amaanyi ke kabonero k’obulamu
fields.body_html:
§31. Obanga Amaanyi ke kabonero k’obulamu, kiki kye tuyiga mu bunafu bw’ebifaananyi, mu bulungi oba mu bubi, ne mu maanyi agawaliriza aga Kristo n’ag’Akabonero k’Omusaalaba? Kino kikakasa nti Okufa ne dayimooni byaggyibwako obufuzi bwabyo. Okukwatagana kw’ensonga eno ey’ebikolwa n’eyo eva mu Kristo yennyini bw’ali.

Naye abo abatakkiriza Kuzuukira beewa bokka obukakafu obw’amaanyi obubasinga, obanga mu kifo ky’emyoyo gyonna ne bakatonda be basinza okugoba Kristo, gwe bagamba nti afudde, Kristo ye, mu ngeri endala, ye abalaga bonna nti bafu. 2. Kubanga obanga kya mazima nti omufu tasobola kukola kintu, naye Omulokozi buli lunaku akola emirimu mingi bwe gityo, ng’asika abantu eri okutya Katonda, ng’asendasenda eri empisa ennungi, ng’ayigiriza ku butafa, ng’abatuusa ku kwegomba ebintu eby’omu ggulu, ng’abikkula okumanya Kitaffe, ng’assa amaanyi mu bantu ag’okusisinkana okufa, ng’ayolekera buli omu, era ng’agoba obutatya Katonda obw’okusinza ebifaananyi, so nga bakatonda n’emyoyo by’abatakkiriza tebisobola kukola na kimu ku ebyo, wabula byeraga nti bifu mu maaso ga Kristo, ekitiibwa kyabyo nga kifuuliddwa obunafu n’obutaliimu; naye olw’akabonero k’Omusaalaba obulogo bwonna buyimirizibwa, n’obufumu bwonna bufuulibwa obwereere, n’ebifaananyi byonna birekebwa ne bisuulibwa, na buli kwegomba okutafugika kuziyizibwa, era buli muntu ayimusa amaaso okuva ku nsi okutunula mu ggulu: ani gwe tuyinza okwogera nti afudde? Kristo, akola emirimu mingi bwe gityo? Naye okukola si kwa mufu. Oba oyo atakola kintu n’akatono, wabula agalamidde ng’atalina bulamu? ekyo mu butuufu kye ky’ebifaananyi n’emyoyo, nga bifu bwe biri. 3. Kubanga Omwana wa Katonda “mulamu era akola,” era akola buli lunaku, era aleeta obulokozi bwa bonna. Naye okufa buli lunaku kukakasibwa nti kwaggyibwako amaanyi gaakwo gonna, n’ebifaananyi n’emyoyo bikakasibwa okuba nti bye bifu so si Kristo, ne kiba nti okuva kaakano tewali muntu ayinza kuddamu kubuusabuusa Kuzuukira kw’omubiri gwe. 4. Naye oyo atakkiriza Kuzuukira kw’omubiri gwa Mukama kirabika nga tamanyi maanyi ga Kigambo n’Amagezi ga Katonda. Kubanga obanga yeetwalira omubiri n’akatono, era — mu kukwatagana okw’amagezi, ng’ensonga zaffe bwe zaalaga — n’agufuula gugwe, Mukama yandigukozeeko ki? oba enkomerero y’omubiri yandibadde ki, Kigambo bwe yamala okugukkako? Kubanga tegwalina kya kukola okuggyako okufa, kubanga gwali gwa kufa, era gwali gwa kuweebwayo eri okufa ku lwa bonna: era olw’ekigendererwa ekyo Omulokozi kye yava agwekolera. Naye kyali tekisoboka gwo okusigala nga gufudde, kubanga gwali gufuuliddwa yeekaalu y’obulamu. N’olwekyo, wadde gwafa ng’ogufa, gwaddamu okuba omulamu olw’Obulamu obwali mu gwo; era emirimu gye kabonero k’Okuzuukira kwagwo.

fields.title: Naye ani anaamulaba ng’azuukidde, alyoke akkirize?
fields.body_html:
§32. Naye ani anaamulaba ng’azuukidde, alyoke akkirize? Nedda, Katonda bulijjo talabika era amanyibwa olw’emirimu gye gyokka: era wano emirimu giwowoggana okukikakasa. Bw’oba tokkiriza, tunula ku abo abakkiriza, otegeere obwakatonda bwa Kristo. Dayimooni zikiraba kino, wadde abantu nga bazibe. Ensonga ezoogeddwako okutuusa kaakano mu bufunze.

Naye obanga, olw’okuba talabika, okuzuukira kwe kwennyini tekukkirizibwa, kiseera ddala abo abagaana okukkiriza okwegaana n’entambula y’Obutonde yennyini. Kubanga kye kintu kya Katonda ekimwawula, okuba nga talabika ate nga amanyibwa olw’emirimu gye, nga bwe kyamala okwogerwa waggulu. 2. Kale obanga emirimu tegiriiwo, bakola bulungi obutakkiriza ekitalabika. Naye obanga emirimu giwowoggana era ne gikiraga lwatu, lwaki balonda okwegaana obulamu obweyolefu bwe butyo obuva mu Kuzuukira? Kubanga ne bwe baba nga balemaye mu magezi gaabwe, naye n’ebiwulizi by’omubiri eby’ebweru abantu bayinza okulaba amaanyi n’obwakatonda bwa Kristo ebitayinza kuwakanyizibwa. 3. Kubanga ne muzibe w’amaaso, wadde nga talaba njuba, naye bw’akwata ku bbugumu enjuba ly’ereeta, amanya nti waliwo enjuba waggulu w’ensi. Bwe batyo n’abatuwakanya, ne bwe baba nga tebannakkiriza, nga bakyali bazibe eri amazima, naye waakiri nga bamanyi amaanyi ge okuyita mu balala abakkiriza, baleme kwegaana obwakatonda bwa Kristo n’Okuzuukira kwe yatuukiriza. 4. Kubanga kyeyoleka nti singa Kristo afudde, teyandisobodde kugoba dayimooni n’okunyaga ebifaananyi; kubanga emyoyo tegyandigondedde mufu. Naye obanga gigobebwa lwatu olw’okuyatula erinnya lye, kiteekwa okweyoleka nti tafudde; naddala nga emyoyo, egiraba n’ebyo abantu bye batalaba, gyandisobodde okumanya singa Kristo afudde ne gimugaana obuwulize bwonna. 5. Naye kaakano, abantu abatatya Katonda kye batakkiriza, emyoyo gikiraba — nti ye Katonda, — era kyegiva gidduka ne gigwa ku bigere bye, nga gyogera ddala bye gyayogera bwe yali mu mubiri: “Nkumanyi gwe Mutukuvu wa Katonda;” era, “Woowe! Otwagaza ki, ggwe Omwana wa Katonda! Nkwegayiridde tombonyaabonya!” 6. Kale nga dayimooni bwe zimwatula, n’emirimu gye nga gimujulira buli lunaku, kiteekwa okweyoleka, era omuntu yenna aleme kuwakanya mazima n’obukakanyavu, nti Omulokozi yazuukiza omubiri gwe, era nti ye Mwana wa Katonda ow’amazima, ng’ava gy’ali, nga bw’ava ewa Kitaawe, ye Kigambo kye, n’Amagezi ge, n’Amaanyi ge, eyeetwalira omubiri mu mirembe egy’oluvannyuma olw’obulokozi bwa bonna, n’ayigiriza ensi ebya Kitaffe, n’afuula okufa obwereere, n’awa bonna obutavunda olw’ekisuubizo ky’Okuzuukira, ng’amaze okuzuukiza omubiri gwe ng’ebibala ebibereberye eby’ekyo, era ng’agulaze olw’akabonero k’Omusaalaba ng’ekijjukizo ky’obuwanguzi ku kufa n’okuvunda kwakwo.

fields.title: Obutakkiriza bw’Abayudaaya n’okusekerera kw’Abayonaani
fields.body_html:
§33. Obutakkiriza bw’Abayudaaya n’okusekerera kw’Abayonaani. Abasooka basirisibwa Ebyawandiikibwa byabwe bo. Obunnabbi obukwata ku kujja kwe nga Katonda era nga Muntu.

Kale ebintu bwe biri bwe bityo, era Okuzuukira kw’omubiri gwe n’obuwanguzi Omulokozi bwe yafuna ku kufa nga bikakasiddwa lwatu, kaakano katunenye obutakkiriza bw’Abayudaaya n’okusekerera kw’Abaamawanga. 2. Kubanga zino, oboolyawo, ze nsonga Abayudaaya kwe balagira obutakkiriza, so nga Abaamawanga baseka, nga banenya obutasaana bw’Omusaalaba, n’obw’Ekigambo kya Katonda okufuuka omuntu. Naye ensonga zaffe tezirirwa kulwanagana na bombi, naddala nga obukakafu bwe tulina ku bo bweyoleka ng’emisana. 3. Kubanga Abayudaaya mu butakkiriza bwabwe bayinza okuwakanyizibwa okuva mu Byawandiikibwa, bo bennyini bye basoma; kubanga ekyawandiikibwa kino n’ekirala, era, mu bufunze, Ekyawandiikibwa kyonna ekyaluŋŋamizibwa, kiwowoggana ku bintu bino, nga n’ebigambo byakyo byennyini bwe biraga mu bungi. Kubanga bannabbi baalanga edda ku kyewuunyo ky’Omuwala Atamanyi Musajja n’okuzaala kwe, nga bagamba nti: “Laba omuwala atamanyi musajja aliba olubuto, alizaala omwana wabulenzi, era aliyitibwa Emmanweri. Amakulu gaalyo nti, Katonda ali naffe.” 4. Naye Musa, omukulu ddala, era gwe bakkiriza nti ayogera amazima, ku kufuuka omuntu kw’Omulokozi, bwe yalaba nga ebyogeddwa bikulu, era ng’akakasizza amazima gaabyo, yabiwandiika mu bigambo bino: “Emmunyeenye eriva ewa Yakobo; n’omuntu aliva mu Isirayiri, era alibetenta abakulu ba Mowaabu.” Era nate: “Eweema zo nga nnungi, Ayi Yakobo, ebifo byo mw’obeera, Ayi Isirayiri! Ziri ng’ensuku ezisiikiriza, ng’ennimiro ku mabbali g’omugga, era ng’eweema Mukama ze yasimba, ng’emivule egiri okumpi n’amazzi. Omuntu aliva mu zzadde lye, era aliba mukama w’amawanga mangi.” Era nate, Isaaya: “Omwana nga tannamanya kugamba nti, ‘Taata’, oba ‘Maama’, alitwala amaanyi g’e Ddamasiko n’omunyago gwe Samaliya mu maaso ga kabaka w’e Bwasuli.” 5. Kale nti omuntu alirabika, kyalangibwa mu bigambo ebyo. Naye nti Oyo agenda okujja ye Mukama wa bonna, era bakiranga nate bwe bati: “Laba, Mukama yeebagadde ku kire ekidduka ennyo ajja mu Misiri. Ne bakatonda b’e Misiri balijugumira.” Kubanga n’okuva eyo Kitaffe kw’amuyitira okudda, ng’agamba nti: “Nayita Omwana wange okuva mu Misiri.”

fields.title: Obunnabbi obukwata ku kubonaabona kwe n’okufa kwe mu byonna ebyakwetooloola
fields.body_html:
§34. Obunnabbi obukwata ku kubonaabona kwe n’okufa kwe mu byonna ebyakwetooloola.

Era n’okufa kwe tekwasirikirwa: wabula kwogerwako mu Byawandiikibwa ebitukuvu, era lwatu nnyo ddala. Kubanga omuntu yenna aleme okukyama olw’obutayigirizibwa ku bintu ebyabaawo ddala, tebaatya kwogera na nsonga y’okufa kwe, — nti tagufuna ku lulwe, wabula olw’obutafa n’obulokozi bwa bonna, — n’enkwe z’Abayudaaya ku ye, n’ebivume bye yafuna mu mikono gyabwe. 2. Kale bagamba nti: “Omuntu ali mu biwundu, era amanyi okugumira obunafu, kubanga amaaso ge gakyusiddwa: yanyoomebwa, ne tutamuyitamu ka buntu. Yeetikka ebibi byaffe, era alumwa ku lwaffe; ate nga twalowooza nti ali mu kulumwa, ne mu biwundu, ne mu kubonyaabonyezebwa; naye yafumitibwa olw’okusobya kwaffe, era n’anafuyizibwa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwaffe. Yeetikka ekibonerezo ffe tusobole okubeera n’emirembe. Ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya.” Ai, wewuunye okwagala n’ekisa kya Kigambo, nti ku lwaffe anyoomebwa, ffe tulyoke tuweebwe ekitiibwa. “Kubanga ffenna,” bwe kigamba, “twawaba ng’endiga; omuntu yali awabye mu kkubo lye; era Mukama yamuwaayo olw’ebibi byaffe; era tayasamya kamwa ke, kubanga yayisibwa bubi. Yali ng’omwana gw’endiga ogutwalibwa okuttibwa, era ng’endiga bwesirika obusirisi mu maaso g’abo abagisalako ebyoya bwesirika, bw’atyo bwe yasirika: mu kutoowazibwa kwe omusango gwe gwaggyibwawo.” 3. Oluvannyuma, omuntu yenna aleme okulowooza, olw’okubonaabona kwe, nti muntu buntu, Ekyawandiikibwa Ekitukuvu kisooka okugaana endowooza z’abantu, ne kirangirira amaanyi (agaakola) ku lulwe, n’enjawulo y’obuzaaliranwa bwe bw’ogeraageranya naffe, nga kigamba nti: “Naye ani amanyi ku bye zadde lye? Kubanga obulamu bwe buggyibwa ku nsi. Olw’obubi bw’abantu yatwalibwa mu kufa. Era ndiwaayo ababi mu kifo ky’okuziikibwa kwe, n’abagagga mu kifo ky’okufa kwe; kubanga teyazza musango wadde akamwa ke okwogera eby’obulimba. Era Mukama alimulongoosa okuva mu biwundu bye.”

fields.title: Obunnabbi obukwata ku Musaalaba
fields.body_html:
§35. Obunnabbi obukwata ku Musaalaba. Engeri obunnabbi buno gye butuukirizibwamu mu Kristo yekka.

Naye, oboolyawo, ng’omaze okuwulira obunnabbi obukwata ku kufa kwe, oyagala okuyiga n’ebyo ebyogerwa ku Musaalaba. Kubanga na kino tekyabuusibwa: abantu abatukuvu bakyolesa lwatu nnyo. 2. Kubanga okusooka Musa akiranga, era n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka, bw’agamba nti: “Mulilaba Obulamu bwammwe nga buwanikiddwa mu maaso gammwe, so temulikkiriza.” 3. Era oluvannyuma, bannabbi abaamuddirira bakijulira, nga bagamba nti: “Naye nze, ng’omwana gw’endiga ogutaliiko musango gwe batwala okuttibwa, saakimanya; banteesaako olukwe olubi, nga bagamba nti, Mujje tusuule omuti ku mmere ye, era tumutemere ddala ave ku nsi y’abalamu.” 4. Era nate: “Banfumise ne bawummula ebibatu byange n’ebigere byange, babala amagumba gange gonna, bagabana engoye zange; era ekyambalo kyange bakikubira akalulu.” 5. Kale okufa okuyimusibwa waggulu era okubeera ku muti, tekuyinza kuba kulala wabula Omusaalaba: era nate, tewali kufa kulala omuntu mw’afumitibwa emikono n’ebigere, okuggyako ku Musaalaba kwokka. 6. Naye okuva olw’okujja kw’Omulokozi mu bantu amawanga gonna nago ku njuyi zonna gaatandika okumanya Katonda, nsonga eno nayo tebaagireka nga tebagyogeddeko: wabula ensonga eno nayo eyogerwako mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu. Kubanga “Walibaawo,” bw’agamba, “muzzukulu wa Yese, n’oyo alisituka okufuga Abaamawanga, era mu ye mwe muliba essuubi lyabwe.” Kino kitono ku bukakafu bw’ebyo ebyabaawo. 7. Naye Ebyawandiikibwa byonna bijjudde okuwakanya obutakkiriza bw’Abayudaaya. Kubanga ani ku basajja abatuukirivu ne bannabbi abatukuvu, ne bajjajja ab’edda, abaawandiikibwa mu Byawandiikibwa ebitukuvu, eyali azaaliddwa mu mubiri okuva mu muwala atamanyi musajja yekka? Oba mukazi ki eyali amala yekka awatali musajja okufuna olubuto lw’omuntu? Aberi teyazaalibwa Adamu, Enoka Yaredi, Nuuwa Lameka, ne Ibulayimu Teera, Isaaka Ibulayimu, Yakobo Isaaka? Yuda teyazaalibwa Yakobo, ne Musa ne Alooni Amulaamu? Samwiri teyazaalibwa Erukaana, Dawudi teyazaalibwa Yese, Sulemaani teyazaalibwa Dawudi, Keezeekiya teyazaalibwa Akazi, Yosiya teyazaalibwa Amosi, Isaaya teyazaalibwa Amozi, Yeremiya teyazaalibwa Kirukiya, Ezeekyeri teyazaalibwa Buuzi? Buli omu teyalina kitaawe eyamuleeta mu bulamu? Kale ani oyo azaalibwa omuwala atamanyi musajja yekka? Kubanga nnabbi yakuza nnyo akabonero kano. 8. Oba kuzaalibwa kwa ani emmunyeenye ey’omu bbanga kwe yakulembera, okulangirira eri ensi oyo eyazaalibwa? Kubanga Musa bwe yazaalibwa, bazadde be baamukweka: Dawudi teyamanyibwa, wadde abo ab’omu kitundu kye, kubanga ne Samwiri omukulu teyamumanya, wabula yabuuza obanga Yese yalina omwana omulala. Ibulayimu nate yamanyibwa baliraanwa be ng’omusajja omukulu oluvannyuma lw’okuzaalibwa kwe. Naye ku kuzaalibwa kwa Kristo omujulirwa teyali muntu, wabula emmunyeenye mu ggulu eryo mwe yali ng’akka.

fields.title: Obunnabbi obukwata ku bufuzi bwa Kristo, okuddukira e Misiri, n’ebirala
fields.body_html:
§36. Obunnabbi obukwata ku bufuzi bwa Kristo, okuddukira e Misiri, n’ebirala.

Naye kabaka ki eyali abaddewo, nga tannaba na maanyi ga kuyita kitaawe oba nnyina, eyafuga n’awangula abalabe be? Dawudi teyatuula ku nnamulondo ng’aweza emyaka amakumi asatu, ne Sulemaani, bwe yali amaze okukula n’afuuka omuvubuka? Yekoyaasi teyatandika kufuga ng’alina emyaka musanvu, ne Yosiya, kabaka eyajja oluvannyuma, n’afuna obufuzi ng’alina emyaka nga musanvu? Era naye ku myaka egyo baali basobola okuyita kitaawe oba nnyina. 2. Kale ani oyo eyali afuga era ng’anyaga abalabe be kumpi nga tannazaalibwa? Oba kabaka ki ow’engeri eyo eyali abaddewo mu Isirayiri ne mu Yuda — Abayudaaya, abaanoonyereza ku nsonga eno, batubuulire — amawanga gonna mwe gaateeka essuubi lyago ne gafuna emirembe, mu kifo ky’okubeera abalabe baabwe ku njuyi zonna? 3. Kubanga Yerusaalemi kyonna kye kyamala nga kiyimiridde, waaliwo olutalo olutakoma wakati waabwe, era gonna gaalwanyisa Isirayiri; Abaasuli baabanyigiriza, Abamisiri baabayigganya, Abababulooni baabalumba; era, eky’ekitalo, n’Abasuuli baliraanwa baabwe baabalwanyisa. Oba Dawudi teyalwanyisa Abamowaabu, n’akuba Abasuuli, Yosiya teyeekuuma baliraanwa be, ne Keezeekiya teyakankana olw’okwewaana kwa Sennakeribu, n’Abamaleki tebaalwanyisa Musa, n’Abamoli tebaamuziyiza, n’abatuuze b’e Yeriko tebeesimba okulwanyisa Yoswa mutabani wa Nuuni? Era, mu bufunze, endagaano z’omukwano tezaaliwo wakati w’amawanga ne Isirayiri. Kale kisaanidde okulaba oyo amawanga gwe galiteekamu essuubi lyago. Kubanga oyo ateekwa okubaawo, kubanga tekisoboka nnabbi kwogera bulimba. 4. Naye ani ku bannabbi abatukuvu oba ku bajjajja ab’edda eyafiira ku Musaalaba olw’obulokozi bwa bonna? Oba ani eyafumitibwa n’azikirizibwa olw’okuwonya bonna? Oba ani ku basajja abatuukirivu, oba ku bakabaka, eyaserengeta e Misiri, ne kiba nti bwe yajja ebifaananyi by’e Misiri ne bigwa? Kubanga Ibulayimu yagendayo, naye okusinza ebifaananyi kwali kukyabunye wonna. Musa yazaalibwayo, naye okusinza okw’obulimba kw’abantu kwali kukyaliyo.

fields.title: Zabbuli 22
fields.body_html:
§37. Zabbuli 22:16, n’ebirala. Obukulu bw’okuzaalibwa kwe n’okufa kwe. Okutabulwa kw’ebiragulo ne dayimooni mu Misiri.

Oba ani ku abo abawandiikibwa mu Byawandiikibwa eyafumitibwa mu mikono ne mu bigere, oba eyawanikibwa n’akatono ku muti, n’aweebwayo ssaddaaka ku musaalaba olw’obulokozi bwa bonna? Kubanga Ibulayimu yafa, ng’amaliriza obulamu bwe ku kitanda; Isaaka ne Yakobo nabo baafa nga bazzizza ebigere byabwe ku kitanda; Musa ne Alooni baafiira ku lusozi; Dawudi mu nnyumba ye, nga tewali lukwe abantu lwe baamusalira; mazima yayigganyizibwa Sawulo, naye yakuumibwa n’atalumizibwa. Isaaya yasalibwamu ebitundu bibiri n’omusumeeno, naye teyawanikibwa ku muti. Yeremiya yavumibwa nnyo, naye teyafa ng’asaliddwa omusango; Ezeekyeri yabonaabona, kyokka si ku lw’abantu, wabula okulaga ebyo ebyali bigenda okutuuka ku bantu. 2. Nate, bano, ne bwe baabonaabona, baali bantu abafaanana bonna mu buzaaliranwa bwabwe obwa bonna; naye oyo Ebyawandiikibwa gwe birangirira nti abonaabona ku lwa bonna ayitibwa si muntu buntu, wabula Obulamu bwa bonna, newaakubadde nga mu butuufu yali ng’abantu mu buzaaliranwa. Kubanga “Mulilaba,” bwe kigamba, “Obulamu bwammwe nga buwanikiddwa mu maaso gammwe;” era “ani amanyi ku bye zadde lye?” Kubanga omuntu ayinza okumanya olulyo lw’abatukuvu bonna, n’alunnyonnyola okuva ku ntandikwa, era buli omu gwe yazaalibwako; naye okuzaalibwa kw’Oyo ali Obulamu, Ebyawandiikibwa bikwogerako ng’okutayinza kunnyonnyolwa. 3. Kale ani oyo Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu gwe byogerako bino? Oba ani omukulu bw’atyo ne bannabbi ne bamulagulako ebintu ebinene bwe bityo? Tewali mulala, kaakano, asangibwa mu Byawandiikibwa wabula Omulokozi wa bonna, Kigambo kya Katonda, Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Kubanga ye yava mu muwala atamanyi musajja n’alabika ng’omuntu ku nsi, era okuzaalibwa kwe mu mubiri tekuyinza kunnyonnyolwa. Kubanga tewali ayinza kwogera kitaawe mu mubiri, kubanga omubiri gwe teguva mu musajja, wabula mu muwala atamanyi musajja yekka; 4. ne kiba nti tewali ayinza kunnyonnyola kuzaalibwa kwa Mulokozi mu mubiri okuva mu musajja, nga omuntu bw’ayinza okuwandiika olulyo lwa Dawudi ne Musa ne bajjajja bonna. Kubanga ye yaleetera n’emmunyeenye okulaga okuzaalibwa kw’omubiri gwe; kubanga kyali kisaanidde Kigambo, ng’akka okuva mu ggulu, okuba n’emmunyeenye ye okuva mu ggulu, era kyali kisaanidde Kabaka w’Obutonde, bw’alabika, okutegeerwa lwatu obutonde bwonna. 5. Laba, yazaalibwa mu Buyudaaya, abantu ne bava e Buperusi okujja okumusinza. Ye yawangula dayimooni abalabe be n’okusinza ebifaananyi ng’ataneeyoleka mu mubiri. Abakaafiiri bonna okuva mu buli kitundu, nga beegaana obulombolombo bwa bajjajjaabwe n’obutatya Katonda bw’ebifaananyi, kaakano bateeka essuubi lyabwe mu Kristo, ne beewandiisa wansi we, ekintu ky’oyinza okulaba n’amaaso go. 6. Kubanga obutatya Katonda bw’Abamisiri tebwakoma ku kiseera kirala kyonna, okuggyako Mukama wa bonna, ng’alinga eyeebagadde ekire, bwe yaserengeta eyo mu mubiri n’afuula obwereere obulimba bw’ebifaananyi, n’akyusa bonna ne bajja gy’ali, era okuyita mu ye eri Kitaffe. 7. Ye yakomererwa ku musaalaba enjuba n’obutonde bwonna nga bye bajulirwa, ne mu maaso g’abo abaamutta: era olw’okufa kwe obulokozi bwatuuka ku bonna, era obutonde bwonna bwanunulibwa. Ye Bulamu bwa bonna, era ye eyawaayo omubiri gwe ng’endiga eri okufa mu kifo kyabwe, olw’obulokozi bwa bonna, newaakubadde nga Abayudaaya tebakikkiriza.

fields.title: Obunnabbi obulala obweyolefu obukwata ku kujja kwa Katonda mu mubiri
fields.body_html:
§38. Obunnabbi obulala obweyolefu obukwata ku kujja kwa Katonda mu mubiri. Ebyamagero bya Kristo tebyali bibaddewo.

Kubanga obanga balowooza nti obukakafu buno tebumala, kale bakakasibwe waakiri n’ensonga endala, eziva mu bigambo bya Katonda bo bennyini bye balina. Kubanga ani bannabbi gwe boogerako nti: “Neeraga abo abaali tebannoonya, ne ndabika eri abo abatambuulirizaako: Nagamba nti, ‘Ndi wano, Ndi wano,’ eri eggwanga eryali litakoowoola linnya lyange; Nagolola emikono gyange eri eggwanga ekkakanyavu era abantu abeewaggula.” 2. Kale ani, omuntu ayinza okubuuza Abayudaaya, oyo eyeeyoleka? Kubanga obanga ye nnabbi, kale bagambe ddi lwe yakwekebwa, oluvannyuma n’alabika nate. Era nnabbi ki ono, ataalabika bulabisi okuva mu kukwekebwa, wabula era eyagolola emikono gye ku Musaalaba? Mazima tewali n’omu ku batuukirivu, okuggyako Kigambo kya Katonda yekka, oyo, atalina mubiri mu buzaaliranwa, eyalabikira ku lwaffe mu mubiri n’abonaabona ku lwa bonna. 3. Oba obanga na kino tekibamala, kale basirisibwe waakiri obukakafu obulala, nga balaba amaanyi gaabwo ag’okukakasa bwe geeyoleka. Kubanga Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti: “Muzzeemu amaanyi emikono eminafu, n’amaviivi agajugumira mugagumye. Mugumye abalina omwoyo omunafu; mubeere n’amaanyi temutya: laba, Katonda waffe asasula omusango; alijja atulokole. Olwo amaaso g’abazibe galiraba, era n’amatu ga bakiggala galigguka; olwo omulema alibuuka ng’ennangaazi, n’olulimi lw’abatayogera luliyogera bulungi.” 4. Kale kiki kye bayinza okwogera ku kino, oba bayinza batya okukyolekera n’akatono? Kubanga obunnabbi buno tebulaga bulazi nti Katonda alijja wano, wabula bulangirira obubonero n’ekiseera eky’okujja kwe. Kubanga bakwataganya bazibe okuddamu okulaba, n’abalema okutambula, ne bakiggala okuwulira, n’olulimi lw’abatayogera okwogera obulungi, n’Okujja kwa Katonda okugenda okubaawo. Kale bagambe ddi obubonero ng’obwo lwe bwali bubaddewo mu Isirayiri, oba wa mu Buyudaaya ekintu ng’ekyo we kyali kibaddewo. 5. Naamani, eyali omugenge, yalongoosebwa, naye tewali kiggala eyawulira wadde omulema eyatambula. Eriya yazuukiza omufu; ne Erisa bw’atyo; naye tewali eyazaalibwa nga muzibe eyazibuka amaaso. Kubanga mazima ddala, okuzuukiza omufu kintu kinene, naye si kye kimu n’ekyamagero Omulokozi kye yakola. Kyokka, obanga Ekyawandiikibwa tekyabuusa ku mugenge, ne ku mwana wa nnamwandu eyali afudde, mazima, singa kyali kibaddewo omulema naye n’atambula ne muzibe n’azibuka amaaso, ebyafaayo tebyandirese kwogera na kino. Kale okuva bwe kiri nti tewali kyogerwa mu Byawandiikibwa, kyeyoleka nti ebintu bino byali tebibaddewo n’akatono edda. 6. Kale byabaawo ddi, okuggyako Kigambo kya Katonda yennyini bwe yajja mu mubiri? Oba yajja ddi, bwe kitali nti abalema baatambula, n’abatayogera ne boogera bulungi, ne bakiggala ne bawulira, n’abaazaalibwa nga bazibe ne bazibuka amaaso? Kubanga kino kyennyini kye Abayudaaya abaakiraba mu biro ebyo baayogera, kubanga baali tebawulirangako bintu bino nga bibaddewo mu kiseera ekirala kyonna: “Ensi kasookedde ebaawo tewalabikangawo yali azibudde maaso ga muntu eyazaalibwa nga muzibe wa maaso. Kale omuntu ono singa teyava wa Katonda ekyo teyandikisobodde.”

fields.title: Mulindirira omulala?
fields.body_html:
§39. Mulindirira omulala? Naye Danyeri alanga ekiseera ddala. Ebiwakanya kino biggyibwawo.

Naye oboolyawo, nga nabo tebasobola kulwanyisa bulijjo bintu ebyeyoleka lwatu, baligamba, nga tebeegaanye ebyawandiikibwa, nti ebintu bino bakyabirindirira, era nti Kigambo kya Katonda tannajja. Kubanga kino kye bakomekkereza okwogera buli kiseera, nga tebaswala kukakanyala mu maaso g’ebintu ebyeyoleka lwatu. 2. Naye ku nsonga eno emu, okusinga zonna, baliwakanyizibwa n’okusingawo, si mu mikono gyaffe, wabula mu gya Danyeri omugezi ennyo, alamba ekiseera ddala, n’okujja kw’Omulokozi okw’obwakatonda, ng’agamba nti: “Wiiki nsavu ze ziweereddwa abantu bo n’ekibuga kyo ekitukuvu okukomya ebikolwa byabwe ebibi, n’okussa envumbo ku bibi, n’okusangula obutali butuukirivu, n’okutangiririrwa olw’ebikolwa ebitali bya butuukirivu, n’okuleeta obutuukirivu obutaliggwaawo, n’okussa envumbo ku kwolesebwa ne ku nnabbi, n’okufuka amafuta ku asinga obutukuvu; era olimanya n’otegeera okuva ekigambo lwe kiriva okuzzaawo n’okuzimba Yerusaalemi okutuusa ku Kristo Omufuzi” 3. Oboolyawo ku bunnabbi obulala bayinza n’okufuna eby’okwekwasa ne bayimiriza ebyawandiikibwa okutuusa mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Naye kiki kye bayinza okwogera ku kino, oba bayinza okukyolekera n’akatono? Kubanga wano Kristo si y’ayogerwako yekka, naye n’oyo agenda okufukibwako amafuta alangirirwa nti si muntu buntu, wabula Asinga Obutukuvu; era Yerusaalemi kiriyimirira okutuusa lw’alijja, era okuva olwo, nnabbi n’okwolesebwa biggwaawo mu Isirayiri. 4. Dawudi yafukibwako amafuta edda, ne Sulemaani ne Keezeekiya; naye kyokka, Yerusaalemi n’ekifo byali biyimiridde, era bannabbi baali balagula: Gaadi ne Asafu ne Nasani; era, oluvannyuma, Isaaya ne Koseya ne Amosi n’abalala. Era nate, abantu bennyini abaafukibwako amafuta baayitibwa batukuvu, so si Asinga Obutukuvu. 5. Naye obanga beekwasa obusibe, ne bagamba nti olw’obusibe obwo Yerusaalemi kyali tekikyaliwo, kale kiki kye bayinza okwogera ne ku bannabbi? Kubanga mu butuufu abantu bwe baasooka okuserengeta e Babulooni, Danyeri ne Yeremiya baaliyo, era Ezeekyeri ne Kaggayi ne Zekkaliya baali balagula.

fields.title: Ensonga (1) okuva mu kukoma kw’obunnabbi n’okuzikirizibwa kwa Yerusaalemi
fields.body_html:
§40. Ensonga (1) okuva mu kukoma kw’obunnabbi n’okuzikirizibwa kwa Yerusaalemi, (2) okuva mu kukyuka kw’Abamawanga, era nga bakyukira Katonda wa Musa. Kiki ekikyasigaddeyo Masiya ky’alina okukola, Kristo ky’atakoze?

Kale Abayudaaya bazannya buzannyi, era ekiseera kye twogerako, kye bateeka mu biseera ebigenda okujja, kituuse dda. Kubanga nnabbi n’okwolesebwa byakoma ddi mu Isirayiri, okuggyako Kristo bwe yajja, Omutukuvu w’Abatukuvu? Kubanga kabonero, era bukakafu bukulu, obw’okujja kwa Kigambo kya Katonda, nti Yerusaalemi tekikyayimiridde, so tewakyali nnabbi ayimusibwa wadde okwolesebwa okubabikkulirwa,—era ekyo kya bulijjo ddala. 2. Kubanga Oyo eyali alangibwa bwe yamala okujja, kwali kwetaaga ki nate okubaawo omulala amulanga? Amazima bwe gaali gatuuse, ekisiikirize kyali kyetaagibwa ki nate? Kubanga eno ye yali ensonga y’okulagula kwabwe kwonna,—kwe kugamba, okutuusa Obutuukirivu obw’amazima lwe bwandizze, n’Oyo eyali agenda okununula ebibi bya bonna. Era eno ye yali ensonga Yerusaalemi kye kyava kiyimirira okutuusa olwo—kwe kugamba, babe nga eyo bagezesebwa mu bifaananyi by’ebigenda okujja, ng’okwetegekera ebya nnamaddala. 3. Kale Omutukuvu w’Abatukuvu bwe yajja, kya bulijjo okwolesebwa n’obunnabbi ne bissibwako akabonero, n’obwakabaka bwa Yerusaalemi ne bukoma. Kubanga bakabaka baali ba kufukibwako amafuta mu bo okutuusa Omutukuvu w’Abatukuvu lw’alifukibwako amafuta; era Yakobo alagula nti obwakabaka bw’Abayudaaya bwali bwa kunywera okutuusa ku Ye, bw’ati:—“Omufuzi taliggwaawo mu Yuda, wadde Omulangira mu ntumbwe ze, okutuusa ekyo ekimuterekeddwa lwe kirijja; era ye ge masuubi g’amawanga.” 4. Era n’Omulokozi yennyini kyeyava ayogerera waggulu n’agamba nti: “Amateeka gonna era n’obunnabbi byonna byayogera okutuukira ddala ku Yokaana.” Kale singa kaakano mu Bayudaaya mulimu kabaka oba nnabbi oba okwolesebwa, bakola bulungi okwegaana Kristo eyajja. Naye obanga tewali kabaka wadde okwolesebwa, wabula okuva mu kiseera ekyo obunnabbi bwonna bwassibwako akabonero, n’ekibuga ne yeekaalu ne biwambibwa, lwaki tebatya Katonda bwe batyo era bakakanyavu bwe batyo, ne balaba ebibaddewo, ate ne beegaana Kristo, Oyo eyabituukiriza byonna? Oba lwaki, bwe balaba n’abakaafiiri nga baleka ebifaananyi byabwe, ne bateeka essuubi lyabwe, okuyita mu Kristo, ku Katonda wa Isirayiri, beegaana Kristo, eyazaalibwa okuva mu kikolo kya Yese mu mubiri era okuva olwo ye Kabaka? Kubanga singa amawanga gaali gasinza Katonda omulala, ne gatayatula Katonda wa Ibulayimu ne Isaaka ne Yakobo ne Musa, kale nate, bandibadde bakola bulungi okugamba nti Katonda tannajja. 5. Naye obanga Abamawanga bassaamu ekitiibwa Katonda y’omu eyawa Musa amateeka n’asuubiza Ibulayimu, era ekigambo kye Abayudaaya kye baanyooma,—lwaki tebamanyi, oba okusinga lwaki beesalirawo obutamanya, nti Mukama eyalangibwa Ebyawandiikibwa yayakira ensi, n’agirabikira mu kifaananyi eky’omubiri, ng’Ekyawandiikibwa bwe kyagamba nti: “Mukama ye Katonda, y’atwakiza omusana;” era nate: “Yabatumira ekigambo kye, n’awonya endwadde zaabwe;” era nate: “Si mubaka, si malayika, wabula Mukama yennyini ye yabalokola?” 6. Embeera yaabwe eyinza okugeraageranyizibwa ku y’omuntu atali mu magezi ge, alaba ensi ng’eyakiddwa enjuba, naye ne yeegaana enjuba egyakira. Kubanga kiki ekirala oyo gwe balindirira ky’alina okukola, bw’alijja? Okuyita abakaafiiri? Naye bamaze dda okuyitibwa. Okukomya obunnabbi, ne kabaka, n’okwolesebwa? Ekyo nakyo kyamala dda okutuukirira. Okwanika obutatya Katonda obw’okusinza ebifaananyi? Bwamala dda okwanikibwa n’okusalirwa omusango. Oba okuzikiriza okufa? Kwamala dda okuzikirizibwa. 7. Kale kiki ekitannatuukirira, Kristo ky’alina okukola? Kiki ekisigadde nga tekituukiridde, Abayudaaya kaakano kye bandisinzidde obutakkiriza nga tebabonerezebwa? Kubanga obanga, nkigamba,—era kino kye tulaba ddala,—tewakyali mu bo kabaka wadde nnabbi wadde Yerusaalemi wadde ssaddaaka wadde okwolesebwa, wabula n’ensi yonna ejjudde okumanya Katonda, n’Abamawanga, nga baleka obutatya Katonda bwabwe, kaakano baddukira eri Katonda wa Ibulayimu, okuyita mu Kigambo, ye Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, kale kiteekwa okweyoleka, ne eri abo abakakanyavu ennyo, nti Kristo yajja, era nti yayakiza ddala bonna n’omusana gwe, n’abawa okuyigiriza okw’amazima era okw’obwakatonda ku bikwata ku Kitaawe. 8. Kale omuntu ayinza mu bwenkanya okuwakanya Abayudaaya n’ensonga zino n’endala okuva mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu.

fields.title: Okuddamu Abayonaani
fields.body_html:
§41. Okuddamu Abayonaani. Bo bakkiriza Kigambo (Logos)? Obanga yeeyoleka mu nteekateeka y’Obutonde bwonna, lwaki si mu Mubiri gumu? kubanga omubiri gw’omuntu kitundu ku kyo kyonna ekyo kye kimu.

Naye omuntu tayinza kulema kwewuunya nnyo Abamawanga, abaseka ekitali kya kusaagirwamu, so nga bo bennyini tebawulira buswavu bwabwe, bwe batalaba nti babutaddewo mu kifaananyi ky’emiti n’amayinja. 2. Naye, kubanga ensonga yaffe teyinza kubulwa bukakafu obulaga, kale tubaswaze nabo ku nsonga ez’amagezi,—okusingira ddala okuva ku ebyo naffe bye tulaba. Kubanga kiki ku ludda lwaffe ekitaliimu magezi, oba ekisaanira okusekererwa? Kye kyokka nti tugamba nti Kigambo yalabisibwa mu mubiri? Naye kino nabo bajja kwegatta naffe okukkiriza nti kyabaawo awatali kintu kya busirusiru, bwe banaalaga nti mikwano gy’amazima. 3. Kale obanga beegaana nti waliwo Kigambo kya Katonda n’akatono, bakikola bwereere, nga basekerera kye batamanyi. 4. Naye obanga bakkiriza nti waliwo Kigambo kya Katonda, era nti ye mufuzi w’obutonde bwonna, era nti mu ye Kitaffe mwe yatondera ebitonde, era nti olw’Okulabirira kwe byonna bifuna omusana n’obulamu n’okubaawo, era nti afuga byonna, ne kiba nti okuva mu bikolwa by’okulabirira kwe amanyibwa, era okuyita mu ye ne Kitaffe,—mbeegayiridde mulowooze, oba nga tebeesekerera bokka nga tebamanyi. 5. Abafirosoofo b’Abayonaani bagamba nti obutonde bwonna mubiri munene; era bagamba bulungi. Kubanga tubulaba n’ebitundu byabwo nga bintu ebitegeerwa obusimu bwaffe. Kale obanga Kigambo kya Katonda ali mu Butonde bwonna, nga gwe mubiri, era yeegatta n’ekyo kyonna n’ebitundu byakyo byonna, kiki ekyewuunyisa oba ekitaliimu magezi singa tugamba nti yeegatta n’omuntu naye. 6. Kubanga singa kyali kya busirusiru ye okuba mu mubiri n’akatono, era kyandibadde kya busirusiru okwegatta n’ekyo kyonna, n’okuwa ebintu byonna omusana n’okutambula olw’okulabirira kwe. Kubanga n’ekyo kyonna mubiri. 7. Naye obanga kimusaanira okwegatta n’obutonde bwonna, n’okumanyibwa mu kyo kyonna, kiteekwa okumusaanira n’okulabika mu mubiri gw’omuntu, era nti ku bw’oyo gufune omusana era gukole. Kubanga olulyo lw’abantu kitundu ku kyo kyonna wamu n’ebirala. Era obanga tekisaana ekitundu okulondebwa okuba ekikozesebwa kye okuyigiriza abantu ku bwakatonda bwe, kiteekwa okuba ekya busirusiru ennyo nti amanyibwa ne mu butonde bwonna.

fields.title: Okwegatta kwe n’omubiri kwesigamye ku nkolagana ye n’Obutonde bwonna
fields.body_html:
§42. Okwegatta kwe n’omubiri kwesigamye ku nkolagana ye n’Obutonde bwonna. Yakozesa omubiri gw’omuntu, kubanga omuntu gwe yali ayagala okwebikkulira.

Kubanga nga bwe kiri, omubiri gwonna bwe guba nga gulamusibwa era nga guyakizibwa omuntu, singa omuntu agamba nti kya busirusiru amaanyi g’omuntu okuba ne mu kagere, yanditwaliddwa ng’omusirusiru; kubanga, ng’akkiriza nti abunye era akola mu mubiri gwonna, ate n’awakanya okuba nti ali ne mu kitundu; bw’atyo n’oyo akkiriza era akakasa nti Kigambo kya Katonda ali mu Butonde bwonna, era nti byonna biyakizibwa era bitambuzibwa ye, tasaanidde kulowooza nti kya busirusiru omubiri gw’omuntu ogumu nagwo okufuna okutambula n’omusana okuva gy’ali. 2. Naye obanga kiri bwe kityo kubanga olulyo lw’abantu kintu kitonde era kyakolebwa okuva mu bwereere, kye bava balowooza nti okulabika kw’Omulokozi mu muntu, kwe twogerako, tekusaana, kiseera kituuse bamugobe ne mu bitonde; kubanga nabyo byaleetebwa mu kubaawo Kigambo okuva mu bwereere. 3. Naye obanga, newakubadde ebitonde kintu ekyakolebwa, si kya busirusiru Kigambo okuba mu byo, kale era si kya busirusiru okuba mu muntu. Kubanga endowooza yonna gye balina ku kyo kyonna, bateekwa okugikozesa ne ku kitundu. Kubanga n’omuntu, nga bwe nnasoose okugamba, kitundu ku kyo kyonna. 4. Kale tekiri kibi n’akatono Kigambo okuba mu muntu, so nga ebintu byonna bifuna okuva gy’ali omusana gwabyo n’okutambula n’obulamu, nga n’abawandiisi baabwe bwe bagamba nti, “Mu ye mwe tubeera, era mwe tutambulira, era mwe muli obulamu bwaffe.” 5. Kale kiki ekisekererwa mu bye twogera, obanga Kigambo yakozesa ekyo mw’ali, ng’ekikozesebwa okweyoleka? Kubanga singa teyali mu kyo, teyandisobodde kukikozesa; naye obanga twasooka okukkiriza nti ali mu kyo kyonna ne mu bitundu byakyo, kiki ekitakkirizika mu kweyoleka kwe mu ekyo mw’ali? 6. Kubanga olw’amaanyi ge ye yennyini yeegatta ddala na buli kimu n’ebintu byonna, era ateekateeka ebintu byonna awatali kkomo, ne kiba nti tewali yandigambye nti tekisaana ye okwogera, n’okwemanyisa ye yennyini ne Kitaawe, ng’ayita mu njuba, singa yayagala, oba mu mwezi, oba mu ggulu, oba mu nsi, oba mu mazzi, oba mu muliro; kubanga akwatira wamu ebintu byonna omulundi gumu, era mu butuufu tali mu byonna byokka wabula ne mu kitundu ekyogerwako, era eyo yeeyoleka nga talabika. Mu ngeri y’emu tekiyinza kuba kya busirusiru obanga, ng’ateekateeka ekyo kyonna nga bw’akola, era ng’awa ebintu byonna obulamu, era ng’ayagadde okwemanyisa okuyita mu bantu, yakozesa omubiri gw’omuntu ng’ekikozesebwa kye okwolesa amazima n’okumanya kwa Kitaffe. Kubanga n’obuntu kitundu kya ddala ku kyo kyonna. 7. Era nga Amagezi g’okutegeera, agabunye mu muntu yenna, bwe gayolesebwa ekitundu ky’omubiri, kwe kugamba olulimi, awatali muntu n’omu agamba, ndowooza, nti ekikula ky’amagezi kikkakkanyizibwa olw’ekyo, bwe kityo singa Kigambo, abunye mu bintu byonna, yakozesa ekikozesebwa eky’obuntu, kino tekiyinza kulabika nga tekisaana. Kubanga, nga bwe nnasoose okugamba, obanga tekisaana okukozesa omubiri ng’ekikozesebwa, tekisaana ne okuba mu Kyonna.

fields.title: Yajja mu kifaananyi ky’omuntu okusinga mu kifaananyi ekirala ekisingako ekitiibwa
fields.body_html:
§43. Yajja mu kifaananyi ky’omuntu okusinga mu kifaananyi ekirala ekisingako ekitiibwa, kubanga (1) yajja kulokola, so si kwewuunyisa ; (2) omuntu yekka mu bitonde ye yali ayonoonye. Abantu bwe bataakkiriza kumanya bikolwa bye mu Butonde bwonna, yajja n’akolera mu bo ng’Omuntu; mu kitundu kye baali beekomeddemu.

Kaakano, singa babuuza nti, Kale lwaki teyalabikira mu bitundu by’ebitonde ebirala ebisingako ekitiibwa, n’akozesa ekikozesebwa ekisingako ekitiibwa, ng’enjuba, oba omwezi, oba emmunyeenye, oba omuliro, oba empewo, mu kifo ky’omuntu obuntu? bamanye nti Mukama teyajja kwerabisa, wabula okuwonya n’okuyigiriza abaali babonaabona. 2. Kubanga ekkubo ly’oyo agenderera okwerabisa liba, okulabika obulabisi, n’okuwuniikiriza abalaba; naye eri oyo anoonya okuwonya n’okuyigiriza ekkubo liri, si kubeera wano bubeezi, wabula okwewaayo okuyamba abali mu bwetaavu, n’okulabika nga abamwetaaga bwe basobola okukigumiikiriza; aleme, olw’okusukka ku bye beetaaga ababonaabona, okutawaanya ddala abo abamwetaaga, n’afuula okulabika kwa Katonda okutaliiko kye kubagasa. 3. Kaakano, tewali kintu mu bitonde kyali kibuze ku ndowooza zaakyo ku Katonda, okuggyako omuntu yekka. Kale, enjuba, newakubadde omwezi, newakubadde eggulu, newakubadde emmunyeenye, newakubadde amazzi, newakubadde empewo tebyava mu nteekateeka yaabyo; wabula nga bimanyi Omukozi waabyo era Omufuzi waabyo, Kigambo, bisigala nga bwe byatondebwa. Naye abantu bokka, nga bamaze okugaana ekirungi, ne beeyiiyiza ebintu ebitaliimu mu kifo ky’amazima, era ekitiibwa ekisaanira Katonda, n’okumumanya kwabwe, babiwadde dayimooni n’abantu mu kifaananyi ky’amayinja. 4. N’olwensonga, kale, kubanga tekyandisaanidde Bulungi bwa Katonda okubuusa amaaso ensonga enzito bw’etyo, so nga abantu tebaasobola kumutegeera ng’ateekateeka era ng’akulembera ekyo kyonna, yeetwalira ng’ekikozesebwa ekitundu ku kyo kyonna, omubiri gwe ogw’obuntu, ne yeegatta nagwo, abantu bwe baali batasobola kumutegeera mu kyo kyonna, baleme kulemwa kumumanya mu kitundu; era bwe baali batasobola kutunula waggulu eri amaanyi ge agatalabika, basobole, waakiri, okuva ku ekyo ekibafaanana okutuuka gy’ali mu kulowooza n’okumufumiitirizaako. 5. Kubanga, nga bwe bali abantu, bajja kusobola okumanya Kitaawe amangu era butereevu okuyita mu mubiri ogw’engeri y’emu nabo n’okuyita mu bikolwa eby’obwakatonda ebyakolerwa mu gwo, nga bageraageranya ne bategeera nti si bya muntu, wabula bikolwa bya Katonda, ebikolebwa ye. 6. Era singa kyali kya busirusiru, nga bwe bagamba, Kigambo okumanyibwa okuyita mu bikolwa by’omubiri, mu ngeri y’emu kyandibadde kya busirusiru okumanyibwa okuyita mu bikolwa by’obutonde bwonna. Kubanga nga bw’ali mu bitonde, naye nga tagabana ku kikula kyabyo n’akatono, wabula ebintu byonna bye bigabana ku maanyi ge; bw’atyo bwe yakozesa omubiri ng’ekikozesebwa kye teyagabana ku mpisa yonna ey’omubiri, wabula, okwawukana ku ekyo, ye yennyini yatukuza n’omubiri. 7. Kubanga obanga ne Plato, ayatiikirivu ennyo mu Bayonaani, agamba nti omukozi waabwo, bwe yalaba obutonde bwonna nga bukubibwa omuyaga, era nga buli mu kabi ak’okukka mu kifo eky’akavuyo, atuula ku nkasi y’omwoyo n’ajja okubudduukirira n’atereeza ennaku zaabwo zonna; kiki ekitakkirizika mu kye twogera, nti, olulyo lw’abantu bwe lwali mu nsobi, Kigambo yakka ku lwo n’alabika ng’omuntu, alulokole mu muyaga gwalwo olw’okulukulembera kwe n’obulungi bwe?

fields.title: Nga Katonda bwe yatonda omuntu n’ekigambo, lwaki tamuzza buggya n’ekigambo?
fields.body_html:
§44. Nga Katonda bwe yatonda omuntu n’ekigambo, lwaki tamuzza buggya n’ekigambo? Naye (1) okutonda okuva mu bwereere kwawukana ku kuddaabiriza ekyo ekyaliwo edda. (2) Omuntu yaliwo ng’alina obwetaavu obutegeerekeka, nga bwetaaga eddagala eritegeerekeka. Okufa kwali kusimbiddwa mu buzaaliranwa bw’omuntu: kale Ye yali ateekwa okuzingira obulamu ku buzaaliranwa bw’omuntu. N’olwekyo Kigambo yafuuka omuntu alyoke asisinkane okufa era akuwangulire mu kitundu kye kwali kwewambidde. (Ekyokulabirako ky’essubi n’asibesito.)

Naye oboolyawo, nga baswadde ne bakkiriziganya na kino, bajja kwagala okugamba nti Katonda, singa yali ayagala okutereeza n’okulokola olulyo lw’abantu, yandibadde akikola na kiragiro bulagizi, awatali kigambo kye kutwala mubiri, mu ngeri y’emu ddala nga bwe yakola edda, bwe yabaleeta okuva mu bwereere. 2. Ku kuwakanya kwabwe kuno okuddamu okw’amagezi kwandibadde: nti edda, nga tewali kintu kiriwo n’akatono, ekyali kyetaagibwa okukola buli kimu kyali kiragiro n’okwagala obwagazi okukikola. Naye omuntu bwe yamala okutondebwa, era obwetaavu ne bwetaagisa okuwonyezebwa, si kw’ebyo ebyali bitaliiwo, wabula kw’ebyo ebyali bimaze okubaawo, kyali kigoberera bulungi nti Omusawo era Omulokozi alabikire mu ekyo ekyali kimaze okubaawo, alyoke awonye n’ebyo ebyaliwo. Olw’ensonga eyo, kale, yafuuka omuntu, n’akozesa omubiri gwe ng’ekikozesebwa eky’obuntu. 3. Kubanga singa lino teryali kkubo ttuufu, Kigambo, ng’asazeewo okukozesa ekikozesebwa, yandirabise atya? oba yandikiggye wa, okuggyako mu abo abaali bamaze okubaawo, era abeetaaga obwakatonda bwe okuyita mu omu abafaanana? Kubanga si bintu ebitaliiwo bye byali byetaaga obulokozi, ekiragiro obulagizi ne kimala, wabula omuntu, eyali amaze okubaawo, yali agenda mu kuvunda n’okuzikirira. Kale kyali kya bulijjo era kituufu Kigambo okukozesa ekikozesebwa eky’obuntu n’okwebikkula buli wantu. 4. Eky’okubiri, olina okumanya kino nakyo, nti okuvunda okwali kutandise tekwali bweru wa mubiri, wabula kwali kugunywereddeko; era kyali kyetaagisa nti, mu kifo ky’okuvunda, obulamu bugunywereko; bwe kityo, nga okufa bwe kwazaalibwa mu mubiri, n’obulamu buzaalibwe mu gwo. 5. Kaakano singa okufa kwali bweru wa mubiri, kyandibadde kisaana n’obulamu okuzaalibwa ebweru waagwo. Naye obanga okufa kwali kwezingiridde ku mubiri era nga kugufuga ng’ekyegasse nagwo, kyali kyetaagisa n’obulamu okwezingira ku mubiri, omubiri bwe gutyo, nga gwambadde obulamu mu kifo kyakwo, gwambule okuvunda. Ate era, newakubadde nga Kigambo yandizze bweru wa mubiri, so si mu gwo, okufa kwandiwanguddwa ye, mu ngeri etuukagana ddala n’obuzaaliranwa, kubanga okufa tekulina buyinza ku Bulamu; naye okuvunda okwali kunywerera ku mubiri kwandisigadde mu gwo nga bwe kwali. 6. Olw’ensonga eyo Omulokozi mu magezi yeyambaza omubiri, omubiri bwe gwezingirwa ku Bulamu, guleme okwongera, nga gwa kufa, okubeera mu kufa, wabula, nga gwambadde obutafa, okuva olwo guzuukire era gusigale nga tegufa. Kubanga, bwe gwamala okwambala okuvunda, tegwandisobodde kuzuukira okuggyako nga gwambadde obulamu. Era okufa nakwo tekwandisobodde, olw’obuzaaliranwa bwakwo, okulabika, okuggyako mu mubiri. Kyeyava yeyambaza omubiri, alyoke asange okufa mu mubiri, akusangule. Kubanga Mukama yandikakasiddwa atya n’akatono okuba Obulamu, singa teyalamusa ekyali eky’okufa? 7. Era nga bwe kiri, nti essubi lyokebwa omuliro mu buzaaliranwa bwalyo, singa (okusooka) omuntu aziyiza omuliro okutuuka ku ssubi, newakubadde nga teryokebwa, naye essubi lisigala, newakubadde bwe kityo, nga ssubi buli, nga litya okutiisibwa kw’omuliro—kubanga omuliro gulina obuzaaliranwa obw’okulimalawo; so nga omuntu (okw’okubiri) bw’alyetoolooza asibesito omungi, ekintu ekigambibwa okuba eddagala eriziyiza omuliro, essubi teriba nate na kutya muliro, kubanga likuumibwa olw’okwetooloolwa ekintu ekitayokebwa; 8. mu ngeri y’emu ddala omuntu ayinza okugamba, ku bikwata ku mubiri n’okufa, nti singa okufa kwaziyizibwa okutuuka ku mubiri n’ekiragiro obulagizi ku ludda lwe, gwandisigadde nga gwa kufa era nga guvunda, ng’obuzaaliranwa bw’emibiri bwe buli; naye, ekyo kireme kubaawo, gwayambala Kigambo kya Katonda atalina mubiri, era bwe gutyo tegukyatya kufa wadde okuvunda, kubanga gulina obulamu ng’ekyambalo, era okuvunda kuggibwawo mu gwo.

fields.title: Bwe kityo nate buli kitundu ky’obutonde kyolesa ekitiibwa kya Katonda
fields.body_html:
§45. Bwe kityo nate buli kitundu ky’obutonde kyolesa ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Obutonde, omujulirwa w’Omutonzi waabwo, buwa (olw’ebyamagero) obujulirwa obw’okubiri eri Katonda eyafuuka Omuntu. Obujulirwa bw’Obutonde, obwali bukyamiziddwa ekibi ky’omuntu, bwe butyo bwakakibwa okudda ku mazima. Ensonga zino bwe zitamala, Abayonaani batunuulire ebyabaawo.

N’olwekyo, mu ngeri esaanira, Kigambo kya Katonda yatwala omubiri era yakozesa ekikozesebwa eky’obuntu, alyoke alamuse n’omubiri, era nga bw’amanyibwa mu bitonde olw’ebikolwa bye bw’atyo akole ne mu muntu, era yeeyoleke buli wamu, nga talese kintu kyonna nga kyereere obwakatonda bwe, n’okumumanya. 2. Kubanga nzizaawo, era nziramu kye nnasoose okwogera, nti Omulokozi yakola kino, nga bw’ajjuza ebintu byonna ku njuyi zonna olw’okubeerawo kwe, bw’atyo ajjuze ebintu byonna n’okumumanya, ng’Ekyawandiikibwa eky’obwakatonda nakyo bwe kigamba nti: “Ensi eribeera ejjudde okumanya Mukama Katonda.” 3. Kubanga omuntu bw’anaatunula obutunuzi waggulu mu ggulu, alaba Entegeka yaalyo, oba bw’ataasobola kuyimusa maaso ge eri eggulu, wabula eri omuntu yekka, alaba amaanyi ge, agatageraageranyizika n’ag’abantu, agalagibwa olw’ebikolwa bye, n’ayiga nti ye yekka mu bantu ye Katonda Kigambo. Oba omuntu bw’abuze mu dayimooni, era ng’abatya, ayinza okulaba omuntu ono ng’abagoba, n’asalawo nti ye Mukama waabwe. Oba omuntu bw’akka n’atuuka ku mazzi, n’alowooza nti ge Katonda,—nga Abamisiri, okugeza, bwe bassaamu amazzi ekitiibwa,—ayinza okulaba obuzaaliranwa bwago nga bukyusibwa ye, n’ayiga nti Mukama ye Mutonzi w’amazzi. 4. Naye omuntu bw’aba akkiridde ddala n’emagombe, n’ayimirira ng’atya abazira abakkayo, ng’abatwala nga bakatonda, kyokka ayinza okulaba ekyabaawo eky’Okuzuukira kwa Kristo n’obuwanguzi ku kufa, n’asalawo nti ne mu bo Kristo yekka ye Katonda ow’amazima era Mukama. 5. Kubanga Mukama yakwata ku bitundu byonna eby’obutonde, n’abiwonya era n’abiggya mu bulimba bwonna; nga Pawulo bw’agamba nti: “Bwe yeeyambulako abafuzi n’ab’obuyinza, yawangulira ku Musaalaba:” waleme kubaawo muntu n’omu ayinza n’akatono okulimbibwa nate, wabula buli wamu asange Kigambo kya Katonda ow’amazima. 6. Kubanga bw’atyo omuntu, ng’azingiziddwa ku buli ludda, era ng’alaba obwakatonda bwa Kigambo nga bweyanjuluzza buli wamu, kwe kugamba, mu ggulu, mu magombe, mu muntu, ku nsi, takyali mu kabi ka kulimbibwa ku bikwata ku Katonda, wabula asinza Kristo yekka, era okuyita mu ye atuuka ku kumanya Kitaffe mu butuufu. 7. Kale, olw’ensonga zino, ez’amagezi, Abamawanga nabo mu luwalo lwabwe bajja kuswazibwa naffe mu bwenkanya. Naye singa balowooza nti ensonga tezimala kubaswaza, bakakase ebyo bye twogera waakiri olw’ebintu ebyeyoleka eri amaaso ga bonna.

fields.title: Okunyoomoka, okuva ku kiseera ky’okufuuka omuntu kw’Ekigambo
fields.body_html:
§46. Okunyoomoka, okuva ku kiseera ky’okufuuka omuntu kw’Ekigambo, okw’okusinza ebifaananyi, obulaguzi, enfumo z’abakatonda, amaanyi ga dayimooni, obulogo, n’obufirosoofo bw’Abamawanga. Era nga bwe kiri nti okusinza okw’edda kwali kwa kifo kimu kyokka era nga buli kumu kwa kwekka, okusinza Kristo kwa buli wantu era kwa ngeri emu.

Abantu baatandika ddi okuleka okusinza ebifaananyi, okuggyako okuva Katonda, Kigambo kya Katonda ow’amazima, lwe yajja mu bantu? Oba obulaguzi mu Bayonaani, ne buli wamu, bwakoma ddi ne bufuuka obwereere, okuggyako Omulokozi bwe yeeyoleka ku nsi? 2. Oba abo abayitibwa bakatonda n’abazira mu bayiiya b’ennyimba baatandika ddi okulagibwa nga baali bantu buntu abafa, okuggyako okuva Mukama lwe yazimba obuwanguzi bwe ku kufa, n’akuuma omubiri gwe yali atutte nga tegukwatibwa kuvunda, ng’aguzuukiza mu bafu? 3. Oba obulimba n’eddalu lya dayimooni byatandika ddi okunyoomebwa, okuggyako amaanyi ga Katonda, Kigambo, Mukama w’ebyo byonna nabyo, bwe yeetoowaza olw’obunafu bw’omuntu, n’alabika ku nsi? Oba obukugu n’amasomero g’obulogo byatandika ddi okulinnyirirwa, okuggyako okulabika okw’obwakatonda okwa Kigambo bwe kwabaawo mu bantu? 4. Era, mu kigambo kimu, amagezi g’Abayonaani gaafuuka ddi obusirusiru, okuggyako Amagezi ga Katonda ag’amazima bwe geeyoleka ku nsi? Kubanga edda ensi yonna na buli kifo byakyamizibwa olw’okusinza ebifaananyi, era abantu tebaatwala kintu kirala wabula ebifaananyi nga bakatonda. Naye kaakano, mu nsi yonna, abantu baleka obulimba bw’ebifaananyi, ne baddukira eri Kristo; era, nga bamusinza nga Katonda, okuyita mu ye bajja ku kumanya ne Kitaffe oyo gwe baali batamanyi. 5. Era, ekyewuunyisa, nga bwe kiri nti ebyali bisinzibwa byali bya ngeri nnyingi era bingi nnyo, era buli kifo nga kirina ekifaananyi kyakyo, era oyo eyali atwalibwa nga katonda mu bo teyalina buyinza kusomoka kugenda mu kifo ekiriraanyeewo, okusendasenda abo ab’amawanga agaliraanyeewo okumusinza, wabula yaweerezebwanga buzibu ne mu bantu be bennyini; kubanga tewali mulala yasinzanga katonda wa muliraanwa we—wabula, buli muntu yanywerera ku kifaananyi kye, ng’alowooza nti ye mukama wa byonna;—Kristo yekka y’asinzibwa nga y’omu era y’omu mu mawanga gonna; era obunafu bw’ebifaananyi kye butaasobola kukola—kwe kugamba, okusendasenda ne abo abaali babeera kumpi,—kino Kristo yakikola, ng’asendasenda si abo abali kumpi bokka, wabula ensi yonna ddala, okusinza Mukama omu era y’omu, era okuyita mu ye Katonda, ye Kitaawe.

fields.title: Obulaguzi obungi,—okulabikirwa okw’okulowooza obulowooza mu bifo ebitukuvu
fields.body_html:
§47. Obulaguzi obungi,—okulabikirwa okw’okulowooza obulowooza mu bifo ebitukuvu, &c., bigobebwa akabonero k’Omusaalaba. Bakatonda ab’edda balagibwa nga baali bantu buntu. Obulogo bwanikibwa. Era nga bwe kiri nti Obufirosoofo bwasobola okusendasenda obubiina obutono obulondemu era obw’ekifo kimu kyokka ku by’Obutafa, n’obulungi,—abantu ab’amagezi amatono basimbye mu bibiina eby’ekkanisa ennyingi enkola y’obulamu obusukkulumye ku butonde.

Era nga bwe kiri nti edda buli kifo kyali kijjudde obulimba bw’obulaguzi, era obulaguzi bw’e Delphi n’e Dodona, n’e Bœotia n’e Lukiya n’e Libiya n’e Misiri n’obwa Kabiri, n’omukazi omulaguzi Pythia, byassibwangamu ekitiibwa olw’okulowooza kw’abantu, kaakano, okuva Kristo lwe yatandika okubuulirwa buli wamu, n’eddalu lyabwe lyakoma era tewali n’omu mu bo akyalagula. 2. Era nga bwe kiri nti edda dayimooni baalimbanga okulowooza kw’abantu, nga beesenza mu nzizi oba mu migga, mu miti oba mu mayinja, era bwe batyo ne balimba abataalina magezi olw’obukujjukujju bwabwe; kaakano, oluvannyuma lw’okukyala okw’obwakatonda okwa Kigambo, obulimba bwabwe bukomye. Kubanga olw’Akabonero k’Omusaalaba, omuntu ne bw’akakozesa obukozesa, agoba obulimba bwabwe. 3. Era nga edda abantu baatwalanga nga bakatonda Zeus ne Cronos ne Apollo n’abazira aboogerwako mu bayiiya b’ennyimba, ne bakyama mu kubassaamu ekitiibwa; kaakano Omulokozi bw’amaze okulabika mu bantu, abo abalala balagiddwa nga baali bantu abafa, era Kristo yekka y’akkiriziddwa mu bantu nga Katonda ow’amazima, Kigambo kya Katonda. 4. Era omuntu yandyogedde ki ku bulogo obwassibwangamu ekitiibwa mu bo? nti nga Kigambo tannabeera mu ffe bwali bwa maanyi era nga bukola mu Bamisiri, ne mu Bakaludaaya, ne mu Bayindi, era nga buleetera abo abaabulaba okutya; naye olw’okubeerawo kw’Amazima, n’Okulabika kwa Kigambo, nabwo bwawakanyizibwa ddala, ne bufuulibwa obwereere ddala. 5. Naye ku bikwata ku magezi g’Abamawanga, n’okwewaana okw’amaloboozi amangi okw’abafirosoofo, ndowooza tewali yandyetaaze nsonga yaffe, kubanga ekyewuunyo kiri mu maaso ga bonna, nti newakubadde abagezi mu Bayonaani baali bawandiise bingi bwe bityo, era nga tebaasobola kusendasenda wadde abatono okuva mu kitundu kyabwe, ku by’obutafa n’obulamu obw’empisa ennungi, Kristo yekka, olw’olulimi olwa bulijjo, era okuyita mu bantu abataali bakugu mu kwogera, mu nsi yonna asendasenze ekkanisa enzijuvu ez’abantu okunyooma okufa, n’okufaayo ku by’obutafa; okubuusa amaaso eby’ekiseera n’okukyusa amaaso gaabwe eri ebitaggwaawo; obutafaayo ku kitiibwa kya ku nsi n’okufuba olw’eky’omu ggulu kyokka.

fields.title: Ebirala ebyabaawo
fields.body_html:
§48. Ebirala ebyabaawo. Okwefuga okw’Ekikristaayo okw’abawala embeerera n’abeefiiriza. Abajulizi. Amaanyi g’Omusaalaba ku dayimooni n’obulogo. Kristo olw’Amaanyi ge yeeraga okuba asukka omuntu, asukka omulogo, asukka omwoyo. Kubanga bino byonna bimugondera ddala. N’olwekyo ye Kigambo kya Katonda.

Kaakano ensonga zaffe zino si bigambo bugambo, wabula zirina mu bumanyirivu obwa ddala omujulirwa w’amazima gaazo. 2. Kubanga ayagala, ayambuke alabe obukakafu bw’empisa ennungi mu bawala embeerera aba Kristo ne mu balenzi abakuuma obulongoofu obutukuvu, n’obukakafu bw’obutafa mu kibiina ekinene bwe kityo eky’abajulizi be. 3. Era ajje oyo ayagala okugezesa mu bumanyirivu bye tumaze okwogera, era mu maaso ddala ag’obulimba bwa dayimooni n’obukumpanya bw’obulaguzi n’ebyewuunyo by’obulogo, akozese Akabonero k’Omusaalaba ogwo ogusekererwa mu bo, era alilaba bwe kiri nti olw’ako dayimooni badduka, obulaguzi bukoma, obulogo bwonna n’obusamize bufuulibwa obwereere. 4. Kale ani, era munene kwenkana wa Kristo ono, oyo olw’Erinnya lye n’Okubeerawo kwe asiikiriza era afuula obwereere ebintu byonna ku buli ludda, era yekka ye w’amaanyi okusinga bonna, era ajjuzizza ensi yonna okuyigiriza kwe? Abayonaani batubuulire, abasanyukira okuseka, ne batakwatibwa nsonyi. 5. Kubanga obanga muntu, kale omuntu omu yasukka atya amaanyi g’abo bonna be batwala bo bennyini nga bakatonda, n’abalaga olw’amaanyi ge nti tebaliimu? Naye singa bamuyita mulogo, kiyinza kitya okuba nti omulogo ye azikiriza obulogo bwonna, mu kifo ky’okubunyweza? Kubanga singa yawangula abalogo abamu, oba omu yekka, kyandibadde kituufu bo okulowooza nti yasinga abalala olw’obukugu obusingako; 6. naye obanga Omusaalaba gwe guwangudde obulogo bwonna ddala, n’erinnya lyabwo ddala, kiteekwa okweyoleka nti Omulokozi si mulogo, kubanga ne dayimooni abo abayitibwa abalogo abalala bamudduka nga Mukama waabwe. 7. Kale ye ani, Abayonaani batubuulire, bano omulimu gwabwe gwokka ogw’amaanyi kwe kusaaga. Oboolyawo bayinza okugamba nti naye yali dayimooni, era nti eyo y’ensonga y’amaanyi ge. Naye bakyogere nga bwe baagala, bajja kusekererwa, kubanga bayinza nate okuswazibwa olw’obukakafu bwaffe obw’edda. Kubanga kiyinzika kitya okuba nti dayimooni ye agoba dayimooni? 8. Kubanga singa yagobanga dayimooni abamu bokka, kyandirowoozeddwa mu butuufu nti olw’omukulu wa dayimooni yawangula abatono, nga Abayudaaya bwe baamugamba bwe baali baagala okumuvuma. Naye obanga, Erinnya lye bwe liyitibwa, eddalu lyonna erya dayimooni lisimbulwa ne ligobebwa, kiteekwa okweyoleka nti wano nawo bakyamye, era nti Mukama waffe era Omulokozi Kristo si, nga bwe balowooza, amaanyi agamu aga dayimooni. 9. Kale, obanga Omulokozi si muntu buntu, wadde mulogo, wadde dayimooni, wabula olw’obwakatonda bwe yennyini afudde obwereere era asiikirizza okuyigiriza okusangibwa mu bayiiya b’ennyimba, n’obulimba bwa dayimooni, n’amagezi g’Abamawanga, kiteekwa okweyoleka era kijja kukkirizibwa bonna, nti ono ye Mwana wa Katonda ow’amazima, ye Kigambo era Amagezi era Amaanyi ga Kitaffe okuva ku lubereberye. Kubanga kino kye kiva n’ebikolwa bye nabyo nga si bikolwa bya muntu, wabula bitegeerwa okuba nga bisukkulumye ku muntu, era nga bikolwa bya Katonda ddala, okuva mu bintu ebyo byennyini, n’okuva mu kugeraageranya n’[abantu abalala bonna].

fields.title: Okuzaalibwa kwe n’Ebyamagero bye
fields.body_html:
§49. Okuzaalibwa kwe n’Ebyamagero bye. Muyita Asclepius, Heracles, ne Dionysus bakatonda olw’ebikolwa byabwe. Mugeraageranye ebikolwa byabwe n’ebibye, n’ebyewuunyo ebyabaawo mu kufa kwe, &c.

Kubanga muntu ki, eyali azaaliddwa, eyeekolera omubiri okuva mu mbeerera yekka? Oba muntu ki eyali awonyezza endwadde ng’ezo nga Mukama wa bonna? Oba ani eyazzaawo ekyali kibulamu mu buzaaliranwa bw’omuntu, n’azibula amaaso g’omuntu eyazaalibwa nga muzibe? 2. Asclepius yafuulibwa katonda mu bo, kubanga yakola eby’obusawo n’azuula eddagala ly’emiddo ery’emibiri emirwadde; nga talyekolera ye yennyini okuva mu ttaka, wabula ng’alizuula olw’okumanya okuggyibwa mu butonde. Naye kino kye ki bw’okigeraageranya n’ebyo Omulokozi bye yakola, kubanga, mu kifo ky’okuwonya ekiwundu, yakyusa obuzaaliranwa bw’omuntu obwasooka, n’azzaawo omubiri nga mulamba. 3. Heracles asinzibwa nga katonda mu Bayonaani kubanga yalwanyisa abantu, bannaabwe abenkana naye, n’azikiriza ensolo enkambwe olw’obukujjukujju. Kino kye ki bw’okigeraageranya n’ebyo Kigambo bye yakola, mu kugoba ku muntu endwadde ne dayimooni n’okufa kwennyini? Dionysus asinzibwa mu bo kubanga yayigiriza omuntu obutamiivu; naye Omulokozi ow’amazima era Mukama wa bonna, olw’okuyigiriza okwefuga, asekererwa abantu bano. 4. Naye ensonga zino tuziveeko. Banaagamba ki ku byamagero ebirala eby’obwakatonda bwe? Mu kufa kw’omuntu ki enjuba mwe yaddugalira n’ensi n’ekankana? Laba ne leero abantu bafa, era baafanga ne mu biro eby’edda. Ekyewuunyo ekyenkana bwe kityo kyali kibaddewo ddi ku bo? 5. Oba, okubuuka ebikolwa ebyakolebwa okuyita mu mubiri gwe, ne nnyogera ku ebyo ebyaddirira okuzuukira kwagwo: okuyigiriza kw’omuntu ki eyali abaddewo kwali kubunye buli wamu, nga kwe kumu, okuva ku nkomerero y’ensi emu okutuuka ku ndala, ne kiba nti okusinzibwa kwe kubuuse mu buli nsi? 6. Oba lwaki, obanga Kristo, nga bwe bagamba, muntu, so si Katonda Kigambo, okusinzibwa kwe tekuziyizibwa bakatonda be balina okuyingira mu nsi emu mwe bali? Oba lwaki, okwawukana ku ekyo, Kigambo yennyini, ng’abeera wano, olw’okuyigiriza kwe akomya okusinzibwa kwabwe era aswaza obulimba bwabwe?

fields.title: Obutaba na maanyi n’okuvuganya kw’Abasofisti byaswazibwa Okufa kwa Kristo
fields.body_html:
§50. Obutaba na maanyi n’okuvuganya kw’Abasofisti byaswazibwa Okufa kwa Kristo. Okuzuukira kwe tekulina kyenkana nakyo wadde mu nfumo z’Abayonaani.

Bangi nga Omuntu ono tannabaawo baali bakabaka n’abafuzi ab’amaanyi ab’ensi, bangi bawandiikiddwa abaali abagezi n’abalogo, mu Bakaludaaya n’Abamisiri n’Abayindi; ani ku bano, nkigamba, si oluvannyuma lw’okufa, wabula ng’akyali mulamu, eyali asobodde okuwangula ennyo bw’atyo n’ajjuza ensi yonna okuyigiriza kwe n’akyusa ekibiina ekinene bwe kityo okuva mu bulimba bw’ebifaananyi, nga Omulokozi waffe bw’akyusizza okuva mu bifaananyi okudda gy’ali? 2. Abafirosoofo b’Abayonaani bawandiise ebitabo bingi mu ngeri esikiriza era n’obukugu bw’ebigambo; kale biki bye baalaga ebinene nga Omusaalaba gwa Kristo? Kubanga amagezi amakubemu ge baayigiriza gaali gasikiriza ekimala okutuusa lwe baafa; naye n’obuyinza bwe baali balabika okuba nabwo nga bakyali balamu bwali bukosebwa okuvuganya kwabwe bokka na bokka; era baalinanga obuggya, ne boogera bubi ku bannaabwe. 3. Naye Kigambo kya Katonda, ekyewuunyisa ennyo, ng’ayigiriza mu lulimi olwa wansi, asiikirizza abasofisti abalondemu; era bw’amaze, okuwalulira bonna gy’ali, okufuula amasomero gaabwe obwereere, ajjuzizza amakanisa ge; era ekyewuunyo kiri nti, bwe yakka ng’omuntu mu kufa, yafuula obwereere ebigambo by’amaloboozi amangi eby’abagezi ku bikwata ku bifaananyi. 4. Kubanga okufa kw’ani okwali kugobye dayimooni? oba okufa kw’ani dayimooni kwe baali batidde, nga bwe baatya okwa Kristo? Kubanga erinnya ly’Omulokozi gye liyitibwa, eyo buli dayimooni agobebwa. Oba ani eyali aggye abantu mu kwegomba kw’omuntu ow’obutonde, ne kiba nti abenzi bafuuka balongoofu, n’abatemu ne batakyakwata kitala, n’abo abaafugibwanga obutiitiizi ne bakola ng’abasajja? 5. Era, mu bufunze, ani eyasendasenda abantu ab’amawanga g’Abannaggwanga n’abakaafiiri mu bifo eby’enjawulo okuleka eddalu lyabwe, n’okufaayo ku mirembe, bwe kitaba Kukkiriza kwa Kristo n’Akabonero k’Omusaalaba? Oba ani omulala eyali awadde abantu obukakafu ng’obwo obw’obutafa, nga Omusaalaba gwa Kristo, n’Okuzuukira kw’Omubiri gwe bwe byakola? 6. Kubanga newakubadde Abayonaani baali bagambye engero ez’obulimba eza buli ngeri, tebaasobola kwegunjira Kuzuukira kwa bifaananyi byabwe,—kubanga tekyabajjira mu birowoozo, oba kiyinzika n’akatono omubiri okubaawo nate oluvannyuma lw’okufa. Era wano omuntu yandikkirizza nnyo obujulirwa bwabwe, kubanga olw’endowooza eno baanise obunafu bw’okusinza ebifaananyi kwabwe, so nga balese ekisoboka nga kiggule eri Kristo, kale okuva wano naye amanyibwe mu bonna nga Mwana wa Katonda.

fields.title: Empisa empya ey’okwefuga
fields.body_html:
§51. Empisa empya ey’okwefuga. Enkyukakyuka y’Embeera z’abantu, ezirongoosebwa era ezitebenkezebwa Obukristaayo.

Kale ani ku bantu, nate, oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwe, oba ng’akyali mulamu, eyayigiriza ku bubeerera, era nti empisa eno teyali nzibu obutasoboka mu bantu? Naye Kristo, Omulokozi waffe era Kabaka wa bonna, yalina amaanyi ag’ekika ekyo mu kuyigiriza kwe ku nsonga eyo, ne kiba nti n’abaana abatannatuuka ku myaka egikkirizibwa amateeka beeyama obubeerera obwo obusukka amateeka. 2. Muntu ki eyali asobodde okutuuka ewala bw’atyo n’ajja mu Basukusi n’Abesiyopya, oba Abaperusi oba Abaameniya oba Abagoti, oba abo be tuwulirako emitala w’ennyanja ennene oba abo abasukka Hyrcania, oba ne Abamisiri n’Abakaludaaya, abantu abafaayo ku bulogo era abalina obulimba bw’eddiini obusukkiridde obutonde era abakambwe mu mpisa zaabwe, n’abuulira n’akatono ku mpisa ennungi n’okwefuga, n’okuwakanya okusinza ebifaananyi, nga Mukama wa bonna bw’akoze, Amaanyi ga Katonda, Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo? 3. Oyo teyabuulira kyokka ng’ayita mu bayigirizwa be, wabula era yasendasenda emitima gy’abantu, okuleka obukambwe bw’empisa zaabwe, n’obutaweereza nate bakatonda ba bajjajjaabwe, wabula okuyiga okumumanya, era okuyita mu ye okusinza Kitaffe. 4. Kubanga edda, nga bakyali mu kusinza ebifaananyi, Abayonaani n’Abannaggwanga baalwanagananga bokka na bokka, era baali bakambwe ddala eri ab’oluganda lwabwe. Kubanga tekyali kisoboka muntu yenna okusomoka ennyanja oba ensi n’akatono, nga tannakwata bitala mu ngalo, olw’entalo zaabwe ezitaggwaawo bokka na bokka. 5. Kubanga obulamu bwabwe bwonna bwatambuzibwanga n’ebyokulwanyisa, era ekitala mu bo kyali kitwala ekifo ky’omuggo, era nga kye kibawanirira mu buli kizibu; era, nga bwe nnasoose okugamba, baali baweereza ebifaananyi, era nga bawaayo ssaddaaka eri dayimooni, so nga newakubadde obulimba bwabwe bwonna obw’okusinza ebifaananyi tebaasobola kuggibwa mu mwoyo guno. 6. Naye bwe bazze mu ssomero lya Kristo, kale, ekyewuunyisa, ng’abantu abaafumitiddwa ddala mu mitima gyabwe, baleseeyo obukambwe bw’obutemu bwabwe era tebakyafaayo ku bya ntalo: wabula byonna biri mu mirembe gye bali, era okuva kaakano ekireeta omukwano kye kibasanyusa.

fields.title: Entalo, &c., ezikumibwa dayimooni, zikkakkanyizibwa Obukristaayo
fields.body_html:
§52. Entalo, &c., ezikumibwa dayimooni, zikkakkanyizibwa Obukristaayo.

Kale ani oyo eyakola kino, oba ani oyo eyagatta mu mirembe abantu abaali bakyawagana, okuggyako Omwana omwagalwa owa Kitaffe, Omulokozi wa bonna, ye Yesu Kristo, oyo olw’okwagala kwe yekka yagumira byonna olw’obulokozi bwaffe? Kubanga n’okuva edda ennyo kyalagulwa ku mirembe gye yali agenda okuleeta, Ekyawandiikibwa we kigamba nti: “ebitala byabwe balibiwesaamu enkumbi, n’amafumu gaabwe bagaweeseemu ebiwabyo. Eggwanga teririyimusa kitala ku ggwanga linnaalyo, so tebalyetegeka kulwana ntalo nate.” 2. Era kino si kya butakkirizika, kubanga ne kaakano Abannaggwanga abo abalina obukambwe obw’obuzaaliranwa mu mpisa zaabwe, nga bakyawaayo ssaddaaka eri ebifaananyi by’ensi yaabwe, balwanagana bokka na bokka n’eddalu, era tebasobola kumala ssaawa emu yokka nga tebalina byakulwanyisa: 3. naye bwe bawulira okuyigiriza kwa Kristo, amangu ago mu kifo ky’okulwana bakyukira okulima, era mu kifo ky’okukwasa emikono gyabwe ebyokulwanyisa bagiyimusa mu kusaba, era mu kigambo kimu, mu kifo ky’okulwanagana bokka na bokka, okuva kaakano beesiba ebyokulwanyisa okulwanyisa Setaani n’emyoyo emibi, nga babawangula olw’okwefuga n’empisa ennungi ez’omwoyo. 4. Kaakano kino mu kiseera kye kimu bukakafu bw’obwakatonda bw’Omulokozi, kubanga abantu kye bataasobola kuyiga mu bifaananyi bakiyize okuva gy’ali; era si kwanika kutono kw’obunafu n’obutaliimu bwa dayimooni n’ebifaananyi. Kubanga dayimooni, nga bamanyi obunafu bwabwe, kyebaava edda baleetera abantu okulwanagana bokka na bokka, baleme, singa balekera awo okuyombagana, okukyuka okulwanyisa dayimooni. 5. Kale, abo abafuuka abayigirizwa ba Kristo, mu kifo ky’okulwanagana bokka na bokka, bayimirira nga basimbye ennyiriri okulwanyisa dayimooni olw’empisa zaabwe n’ebikolwa byabwe ebirungi: era babawangula, ne basekerera omukulu waabwe Setaani; ne kiba nti mu buvubuka beefuga, mu kukemebwa bagumiikiriza, mu kutegana banyiikira, bwe bavumibwa bagumiikiriza, bwe babbibwa tebakitwala nga kikulu: era, newakubadde nga kyewuunyisa, banyooma n’okufa ne bafuuka abajulizi ba Kristo.

fields.title: Ekizimbe kyonna eky’obukaafiiri kimenyebwa omulundi gumu Kristo mu kyama
fields.body_html:
§53. Ekizimbe kyonna eky’obukaafiiri kimenyebwa omulundi gumu Kristo ng’ayogera mu kyama n’omutima gw’omuntu ogw’omunda.

Era okwogera ku bukakafu bumu obulaga obwakatonda bw’Omulokozi, obwewuunyisa ennyo ddala,—muntu ki obuntu, oba omulogo, oba omunyigiriza, oba kabaka, eyali asobodde yekka okulwanyisa abangi bwe batyo, n’okulwana olutalo n’okusinza ebifaananyi kwonna, n’eggye lyonna erya dayimooni, n’obulogo bwonna, n’amagezi gonna ag’Abayonaani, nga byali bikyalina amaanyi, nga bikyakulaakulana era nga bibuzaabuza bonna, n’abiziyiza byonna mu kulumba kumu, nga Mukama waffe bwe yakola, Kigambo kya Katonda ow’amazima, oyo, ng’alaga ensobi ya buli muntu nga talabika, yekka aggya abantu bonna ku byo byonna, ne kiba nti abo abaali basinza ebifaananyi kaakano babirinnyirira, abo abaali bamanyiddwa mu bulogo bookya ebitabo byabwe, n’abagezigezi okunnyonnyola Enjiri bakusinza okusoma okulala kwonna? 2. Kubanga abo be baali basinza babaleka, ate oyo gwe baali baduulira ng’eyakomererwa, kaakano bamusinza nga Kristo, nga bamwatula nti ye Katonda. Era abo abayitibwa bakatonda mu bo bagobebwa akabonero k’omusaalaba, ate Omulokozi eyakomererwa abuulirwa mu nsi yonna nga Katonda era Omwana wa Katonda. Era bakatonda abaasinzibwanga mu Bayonaani bagwa mu kuswala mu mikono gyabwe bennyini, ng’ebitonde eby’ensonyi; ate abo abakkiriza okuyigiriza kwa Kristo babeera mu bulamu obulongoofu okubasinga. 3. Kale, obanga bino n’ebiringa bino bikolwa bya bantu, oyo ayagala k’alage ebikolwa ebifaanana bwe bityo ebyakolebwa abantu ab’edda, atukakase. Naye bwe biba nga, era bwe biri, si bikolwa bya bantu wabula bya Katonda, lwaki abatakkiriza bajeemera Katonda bwe batyo ne batategeera Mukama eyabikola? 4. Kubanga embeera yaabwe eringa omuntu alaba ebikolwa by’obutonzi naye n’atamanya Katonda Omukozi wabyo. Kubanga singa baamanya obwakatonda bwe okuva mu buyinza bwe ku bitonde byonna, bandimanye nti n’ebikolwa Kristo bye yakola mu mubiri si bya bantu, wabula bikolwa by’Omulokozi wa bonna, Kigambo kya Katonda. Era singa baamanya bwe batyo, nga Pawulo bwe yagamba, “tebandikomeredde Mukama ow’ekitiibwa.”

fields.title: Kigambo eyafuuka omuntu, nga bwe kiri ku Katonda Atalabika
fields.body_html:
§54. Kigambo eyafuuka omuntu, nga bwe kiri ku Katonda Atalabika, tumumanyira ku bikolwa bye. Ku byo tutegeera omulimu gwe ogw’okutufuula aba Katonda. Ka tumatire okubalako ebitono ku byo, obungi bwabyo obumasamasa tubulekere oyo ayagala okubitunuulira.

Kale, ng’omuntu bw’aba ayagala okulaba Katonda, atalabika mu buzaaliranwa bwe era atalabibwa n’akatono, bw’asobola okumumanya n’okumutegeera okuva mu bikolwa bye: bw’atyo oyo atasobola kulaba Kristo n’amagezi ge, waakiri amutegeerere ku bikolwa by’omubiri gwe, akebere oba nga bikolwa bya bantu oba bikolwa bya Katonda. 2. Era bwe biba nga bya bantu, k’abiduulire; naye bwe biba nga si bya bantu, wabula bya Katonda, k’akitegeere, aleme okusekerera ekitali kya kusekererwa; wabula asinge kwewuunya nti mu ngeri eya bulijjo bw’etyo ebintu eby’obwakatonda bitubikkuliddwa, era nti olw’okufa obutafa butuuse ku bonna, era nti olwa Kigambo okufuuka omuntu, obulabirizi bwa Katonda obufuga byonna bumanyiddwa, n’Oyo abuwa era Omukozi wabwo, ye Kigambo kya Katonda yennyini. 3. Kubanga yafuuka omuntu tulyoke tufuulibwe aba Katonda; ne yeeyoleka mu mubiri tulyoke tufune okutegeera Kitaffe atalabika; ne agumiikiriza ekyejo ky’abantu tulyoke tusikire obutafa. Kubanga ye yennyini teyakosebwa n’akatono, kubanga tayinza kubonaabona, tavunda, era ye Kigambo ddala era Katonda; naye abantu abaali babonaabona, era be yagumiikiririza ebyo byonna ku lwabwe, yabakuuma n’abalabirira mu butabonaabona bwe. 4. Era, mu bufunze, ebyo Omulokozi bye yatuukiriza olw’okufuuka omuntu, biri bya ngeri eyo era bingi nnyo, nti omuntu bw’aba ayagala okubibala, ayinza okugeraageranyizibwa ku bantu abatunuulira obugazi bw’ennyanja ne baagala okubala amayengo gaayo. Kubanga ng’omuntu bw’atasobola kulaba mayengo gonna n’amaaso ge, kubanga ago agajja gatabula amaaso g’oyo agezaako; bwe kityo n’oyo ayagala okutegeera byonna Kristo bye yatuukiriza mu mubiri, tasobola kubitegeera byonna, wadde ng’abibalirira, kubanga ebyo ebisukka ku birowoozo bye bingi okusinga ebyo by’alowooza nti abitegedde. 5. Kale kirungi obutagezaako kwogera ku byonna, nga omuntu tasobola kwogera bulungi wadde ku kitundu, wabula, oluvannyuma lw’okwogera ku kimu kirala, okukulekera ggwe byonna okubyewuunya. Kubanga byonna bya kitalo kyenkanyi, era yonna omuntu gy’atunuulira amaaso ge, ayinza okulaba ku ludda olwo obwakatonda bwa Kigambo, n’ajjula okutya okw’amaanyi ennyo.

fields.title: Mu bufunze eby’ogeddwa waggulu
fields.body_html:
§55. Mu bufunze eby’ogeddwa waggulu. Okukoma kw’obulaguzi bw’abakaafiiri, &c.: okubuna kw’okukkiriza. Kabaka ow’amazima avuddeyo n’asirisa bonna abaali beetwalidde obufuzi.

Kale kino, oluvannyuma lw’ebyo bye twogedde okutuusa kati, kikugwanira okukitegeera, n’okukitwala ng’omugatte gw’ebyo bye tumaze okwogera, n’okukyewuunya ennyo ddala; kwe kugamba nti, okuva Omulokozi lwe yajja mu ffe, si kuba nti okusinza ebifaananyi tekukyeyongera kyokka, wabula n’okwaliwo kukendeera era kugenda kukoma mpolampola: era si kuba nti amagezi g’Abayonaani tegakyakulaakulana kyokka, wabula n’agaliwo kaakano gaggwaawo: era dayimooni, mu kifo ky’okwongera okulimba abantu n’ebyekiwuduwudu n’obulaguzi n’obulogo, bwe zigezaako wadde okukikola, ziswazibwa akabonero k’omusaalaba. 2. Era okufunza ensonga: laba okuyigiriza kw’Omulokozi bwe kweyongera buli wamu, ate okusinza ebifaananyi kwonna na buli ekiwakanya okukkiriza kwa Kristo bikendeera buli lunaku, ne biggwaamu amaanyi, ne bigwa. Era bw’olaba bw’otyo, sinza Omulokozi, “afuga byonna” era ow’amaanyi, ye Katonda Kigambo; era osalire omusango abo abawangulwa era abaggibwawo ye. 3.
