Kubanga ng’enjuba bw’evaayo, ekizikiza tekikyafuga, era bwe wabaawo ekisigaddewo wonna kigobebwa; bwe kityo, kaakano okulabika kw’obwakatonda kwa Kigambo kya Katonda bwe kutuuse, ekizikiza ky’ebifaananyi tekikyafuga, era ebitundu byonna eby’ensi mu buli ludda bitangaazibwa okuyigiriza kwe. 4. Era nga kabaka bw’aba ng’afuga mu nsi emu nga talabika, wabula ng’abeera waka mu nnyumba ye, emirundi mingi abantu abamu abatalina mpisa, nga bakozesa obubi okwekweka kwe, beelangirira; era buli omu ku bo, nga yeefuula kabaka, alimba abatategeera, era bwe batyo abantu babuzibwabuzibwa erinnya, nga bawulira nti waliwo kabaka, naye nga tebamulaba, waakiri olw’ensonga nti tebasobola kuyingira mu nnyumba; naye kabaka ow’amazima bw’avaayo n’alabika, olwo abalimba abo abatalina mpisa baswazibwa olw’okubeerawo kwe, ate abantu, bwe balaba kabaka ow’amazima, ne baleka abo abaasooka okubabuzaabuza: 5. bwe kityo, emyoyo emibi edda gyalimbanga abantu, nga gyeyambaza ekitiibwa kya Katonda; naye Kigambo kya Katonda bwe yalabikira mu mubiri, n’atumanyisa Kitaawe, olwo ku nkomerero obulimba bw’emyoyo emibi buggibwawo ne bukoma, ate abantu, nga bakyusizza amaaso gaabwe eri Katonda ow’amazima, Kigambo kya Kitaffe, baleka ebifaananyi, era kaakano batandise okumanya Katonda ow’amazima. 6. Kale buno bwe bukakafu nti Kristo ye Katonda Kigambo, era ge maanyi ga Katonda. Kubanga ng’ebintu by’abantu bikoma, ate Ekigambo kya Kristo kibeerera, kyeyoleka eri amaaso gonna nti ekikoma kya kaseera buseera, naye nti Oyo abeerera ye Katonda, era Omwana wa Katonda ow’amazima, Kigambo kye omu yekka eyazaalibwa.

fields.title: Kale noonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa, bw’oba osobola, ojjuze ekifaananyi kino
fields.body_html:
§56. Kale noonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa, bw’oba osobola, bw’otyo ojjuze ekifaananyi kino ekitonotono. Yiga okulindirira Okujja Okw’okubiri n’Okusala Omusango.

Kale kino, ggwe omuntu ayagala Kristo, kibeere kirabo kyaffe gy’oli, ng’ekifaananyi ekisookerwako era olukoloboze, mu bufunze, olw’okukkiriza kwa Kristo n’okulabika kwe okw’obwakatonda gye tuli. Naye ggwe, ng’okozesa omukisa guno, bw’onoosanga ebiwandiiko by’Ebyawandiikibwa, n’obiteekako ebirowoozo byo mu mazima, ojja kuyiga mu byo mu bujjuvu era mu bulambulukufu ennyo ebikwata ku ebyo bye twogedde. 2. Kubanga byayogerwa era ne biwandiikibwa Katonda, ng’ayita mu bantu aboogera ku Katonda. Naye ffe tuwa okwagala kwo okuyiga, nga naffe bwe twaweebwa, ebyo bye twayiga okuva mu bayigiriza abaaluŋŋamizibwa Katonda abaabimanya obulungi, abaafuuka n’abajulizi olw’obwakatonda bwa Kristo. 3. Era ojja kuyiga n’ebikwata ku kulabika kwe okw’okubiri eri ffe, okw’ekitiibwa era okw’obwakatonda ddala, bw’alijja, nga takyali mu bwetoowaze, wabula mu kitiibwa kye,—nga takyali mu ndabika enyoomebwa, wabula mu bukulu bwe,—nga tajja kubonaabona nate, wabula okuva olwo okuwa bonna ekibala ky’omusaalaba gwe, kwe kugamba, okuzuukira n’obutavunda; era nga takyasalirwa musango, wabula okusalira bonna omusango, okusinziira ku ebyo buli muntu bye yakola mu mubiri, oba birungi oba bibi; abalungi we baterekeddwa obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, naye abo abaakola ebibi omuliro ogutaggwaawo n’ekizikiza eky’ebweru. 4. Kubanga bw’atyo ne Mukama yennyini agamba nti: “Okuva ne kaakano mugenda kulaba Omwana w’Omuntu ng’atudde ku mukono ogwa ddyo” ogw’obuyinza, “ng’akomawo ku bire eby’eggulu” mu kitiibwa kya Kitaawe. 5. Era olw’ensonga eyo yennyini waliwo n’ekigambo ky’Omulokozi ekitutegekera olunaku olwo, mu bigambo bino: “Mutunule” era “mweteeketeeke, kubanga Omwana w’omuntu alijjira mu kiseera kye mutamulowoolezaamu.” Kubanga, nga Pawulo omutendereze bw’agamba nti: “Ffe ffenna kitugwanira okulabika mu maaso g’entebe ya Kristo ey’okusalirako omusango, buli muntu asalirwe olw’ebyo bye yakola ng’akyali mulamu, okusinziira ku ebyo bye yakola oba birungi oba bibi.”

fields.title: Okusinga byonna, beera mu bulamu obukusaanyiza okulya ku muti guno
fields.body_html:
§57. Okusinga byonna, beera mu bulamu obukusaanyiza okulya ku muti guno ogw’okumanya n’obulamu, bw’otyo otuuke mu ssanyu ery’olubeerera. Ettendo.

Naye okunoonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa n’okubimanya mu mazima, kyetaagisa obulamu obw’ekitiibwa, n’emmeeme ennongoofu, n’empisa ennungi eziri ng’eza Kristo; amagezi nga gagoberera ekkubo lyago ku byo, gasobole okutuuka ku kye geegomba, n’okukitegeera, okutuuka we kisoboka eri obuntu okuyiga ebikwata ku Kigambo kya Katonda. 2. Kubanga awatali mutima mulongoofu n’okukola obulamu obufaanana obw’abatukuvu, omuntu tayinza n’akatono kutegeera bigambo bya batukuvu. 3. Kubanga ng’omuntu bw’aba ayagala okulaba ekitangaala ky’enjuba, ateekwa okusiimuula n’okutangaaza eriiso lye, nga yeetukuza mu ngeri emu okufaanana ky’ayagala, eriiso, bwe lityo nga lifuuse ekitangaala, lisobole okulaba ekitangaala ky’enjuba; oba ng’omuntu bw’ayagala okulaba ekibuga oba ensi, ateekwa okugenda mu kifo ekyo okukiraba;—bw’atyo oyo ayagala okutegeera endowooza y’abo aboogera ku Katonda ateekwa okusooka okunaaba n’okutukuza emmeeme ye, olw’engeri gy’abeeramu, n’asemberera abatukuvu bennyini ng’agoberera ebikolwa byabwe; bw’atyo, ng’ali wamu nabo mu kutambulira mu bulamu obumu, ategeere n’ebyo Katonda bye yababikkulira, era okuva olwo, ng’agattiddwa nabo ennyo, awone akabi k’aboonoonyi n’omuliro gwabwe ku lunaku olw’okusala omusango, afune ebyo ebiterekeddwa abatukuvu mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, “Eriiso bye litalabangako, n’okutu bye kutawulirangako, n’omutima gw’omuntu kye gutalowoozangako,” ebintu byonna ebitegekeddwa abo abatambulira mu bulamu obw’empisa ennungi, era abaagala Katonda era Kitaffe, mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe: mu oyo era wamu naye, Kitaffe yennyini, wamu n’Omwana yennyini, mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, abeerenga n’ekitiibwa n’obuyinza n’ettendo emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.
